bluejetty:00065958:ios.description:
********************
The game that started the legend of DRAGON QUEST is here at last for mobile devices!
Discover the RPG that won the hearts of two generations!
Enter a fantasy world of sword, magic, and monsters in one standalone package!
Download it once, and there’s nothing else to buy, and nothing else to download!
********************
◆ Prologue
The peace of fair Alefgard has been shattered by the appearance of the nefarious master of the night known as the Dragonlord, and the Sphere of Light which for so long kept the forces of darkness in check has been stolen!
It’s time for you, a young warrior through whose veins flows the blood of the legendary hero Erdrick, to set out on a quest to vanquish the Dragonlord, and save the land from darkness!
◆ Game Features
・First in the Legendary Series
Originally released as Dragon Warrior, you can now experience the classic retro RPG experience that swept up millions of Japanese players back in the Eighties...and never let go!
Become the descendant of the legendary hero Erdrick, and embark on an epic journey through the historic realm of Alefgard, tackling fearsome foes and perplexing puzzles on your way to the dread Dragonlord’s lair!
・Simple, Intuitive Controls
The game’s controls are designed to work perfectly with the vertical layout of any modern mobile device, and the position of the movement button can be changed to facilitate both one- and two-handed play.
・Experience the legendary RPG loved by millions in Japan and worldwide! Created by a legendary trio with the master creator Yuji Horii, the revolutionary synthesizer score and orchestration by Koichi Sugiyama, and art by master manga artist Akira Toriyama (Dragon Ball). 
--------------------
[OS Compatibility]
iOS 12.0 or higher

bluejetty:00073818:ios.description:
Welcome to The Sculpt Society, an innovative Sculpt, Dance Cardio + Strength fitness platform led by celebrity trainer Megan Roup, dedicated to empowering women with transformative workouts. This app is not just about fitness; it's a movement towards feeling confident, strong, and in love with your body.
Our programs cater to all levels, whether you are a beginner or an advanced fitness enthusiast, ensuring everyone can enjoy the benefits of a healthier, more active lifestyle.
Dynamic Workout Routines
The Sculpt Society offers an extensive range of exercises and classes, blending the fun of dance cardio with the efficacy of sculpting workouts. These workouts are designed to make you sweat, smile, and feel invigorated.
Expansive Class Selection
Our app features over 1,000 on-demand classes and multiple LIVE classes each week. These include a variety of workout styles - from low-impact sculpting, to strength building, to high energy dance cardio classes, as well as safe and efficient prenatal and postnatal workouts that help new and expecting mothers keep moving throughout their pregnancy journey. Dive into the tranquility of our yoga sessions, or find your center with our stretch and meditation classes. With new content added regularly, your workout routine will always be fresh and exciting.
The Sculpt Society Method
The Sculpt Society method is unique. We combine powerful sculpting exercises to tone your muscles with easy-to-follow dance cardio, ensuring a fun and effective workout every time. Our goal is to deliver a great workout experience in less than an hour, no matter where you are. This makes it perfect for busy schedules, allowing you to squeeze in a workout session anytime, anywhere.
Our workouts are designed to boost your heart rate and sculpt your way to long, lean muscles. Whether you opt for a quick 10-minute session or a full 45-minute class, you’ll conclude each workout feeling accomplished and sweaty! Within just a few weeks of consistent practice, you'll begin to see results.
For those looking to enhance their workouts, we offer options to incorporate equipment such as hand weights, resistance bands, a Pilates ball, sliders, and ankle weights. These additions can take your workout to the next level, helping you achieve even more significant results.
The Sculpt Society app is incredibly user-friendly and accessible. You can stream our workouts from any device, anywhere in the world. Whether you’re working out at home, traveling, or taking The Sculpt Society to the gym, our mobile workouts are available globally. We understand that internet access can be a challenge sometimes. That's why we've enabled offline viewing. Simply download any video for offline viewing and never miss a workout again.
Join the Community
Join our #TSSfam today and see why The Sculpt Society has become a beloved workout routine for thousands of women worldwide. Start your fitness journey with us, and witness a transformation that goes beyond the physical. To access all our features and content, subscribe to The Sculpt Society on a monthly or yearly basis with an auto-renewing subscription right inside the app. Our pricing is designed to be affordable and varies by region, ensuring it's accessible to everyone.
Terms of Service: https://app.thesculptsociety.com/tos
Privacy Policy: https://app.thesculptsociety.com/privacy
This app is proudly powered by VidApp.
Join us now and redefine your fitness journey with The Sculpt Society!

bluejetty:00123446:ios.description:
Do you love to order food online from your favourite restaurant? Use this app to keep in touch faster, easier and better with the restaurant you eat frequently from. If you are a loyal customer of one of our member-restaurants, this is the online food ordering app for you. 
Features:
- order online your food from your chosen restaurant(s)
- based on location, the app automatically displays the restaurant(s) you order from 
- you can see if restaurant is ready to take orders now and quickly browse their menu
- your contact details will be pre-filled so next time you order easier and faster
- your order confirmation includes pickup/delivery time estimation, provided by the restaurant staff especially for you and your order.
- your order will be confirmed in real time as member restaurants are directly handling your order immediately. 
No middle-man, no confusing call-center, no over-promises. This is just between you and your chosen restaurant.

bluejetty:00159604:ios.description:
TBC Bank Uzbekistan ilovasi — bu istalgan vaqtda moliyaviy masalalarni qulay hal qilishga yordam beradigan mobil onlayn bank. Ilovada to'lov qilish, onlayn kredit olish, kartadan kartaga o'tkazmalar, jismoniy yoki virtual karta buyurish va onlayn omonat ochish imkoni bor.
TBC Bank ilovasida ro'yxatdan o'tishingiz bilanoq mobil bankning barcha funksiyalaridan foydalanishingiz mumkin bo'ladi.
• 100 mln so'mgacha onlayn kredit. Ilovaning o'zida, kafillarsiz, garovsiz va ortiqcha hujjatlarsiz. Kredit olishdan oldin tasdiqlangan stavka bo'yicha ilovadagi kredit kalkulyatorida oylik to'lovlarni hisoblash mumkin.
• 24 oygacha muddatli onlayn omonatlar**. Omonatga har kuni foiz hisoblaymiz va oyda bir marta to'lab beramiz. TBC Bank ilovasiga ulangan istalgan karta orqali omonatni to'ldirish mumkin.
• Pul o'tkazmalari. O'zbekistondagi banklar kartalariga telefon raqami yoki karta raqami orqali pul o'tkazing.
• Onlayn xaridlar va xizmatlarni to'lash uchun Uzcard, Visa va Humo virtual kartalari. Visa Virtual'dan xorijiy to'lovlar uchun, Uzcard va Humo'dan O'zbekistondagi xaridlar uchun foydalanishingiz mumkin.
• Osmon Card kredit kartasi — 50 mln so'mgacha kredit limiti va 55 kungacha imtiyozli davrga ega Humo kartasi. Har qanday xaridni to'lang, imtiyozli davr oxirigacha qarzni qaytarsangiz, foiz to'lamaysiz.
• Onlayn to'lovlar. Mobil aloqa, internet, xizmatlar, kommunal va davlat xizmatlari uchun uydan chiqmasdan to'lov qiling. 
TBC Bank Uzbekistan ilovasidagi bank xizmatlari:
- Bank hisobraqami — bir necha daqiqada onlayn hisobraqam oching va ilovada pulingizni boshqaring.
- Salom Card — komissiyasiz pul o'tkazing, xaridlarni to'lang va foydali bonuslarga ega bo'ling.
- TBC Kredit — onlayn kredit javobini 1 minutda*, yashirin komissiyalarsiz bilib oling.
- Osmon Card — xaridlar uchun qulay kredit karta bilan to'lov qiling va 55*** kungacha foiz to'lamang.
- Pul o'tkazmalari — telefon yoki karta raqami orqali istalgan bank kartalariga darhol pul o'tkazing.
- Onlayn to'lovlar — mashhur xizmatlar va servislar uchun ilovaning o'zida komissiyasiz to'lov qiling.
TBC Bank Uzbekistan ilovasining 6 mln ortiq foydalanuvchisi bor — siz ham qo'shiling! Ilovani hoziroq yuklab oling va mobil bankingning pul o'tkazmalari, to'lovlar, onlayn omonatlar va kreditlar kabi barcha imkoniyatlaridan foydalaning.
*so'nggi 300 000 foydalanuvchi orasida kredit bo'yicha qaror qabul qilishning o'rtacha vaqti. Aniq qaror qabul qilish vaqti mijozning kredit tarixiga bog'liq va 1 daqiqadan kam yoki ko'proq vaqtni olishi mumkin. Foiz stavkasi 28% dan 49% gacha, muddati 3 oydan 36 oygacha, miqdori 300 ming so'mdan 100 million so'mgacha. Kredit shartlari - tbcbank.uz saytida.
**18% dan 22% gacha stavka. Omonatlar shartlari — tbcbank.uz saytida
***Bu xaridlar uchun 30 kungacha (hisobot davri) va qarzni to'lash uchun hisob-kitob sanasidan boshlab 25 kun (to'lov muddati) — jami 55 kungacha foizsiz
© 2020-2026 "TBC BANK" ATB
Yuridik manzil: Toshkent shahri, Fidokor ko'chasi, 10B

bluejetty:00069557:ios.name: Solitaire Crime Stories
bluejetty:00069557:ios.summary: Solitaire Crime Stories is an exciting new Solitaire game which will carry you away into a world of fascinating criminal investigations, colorful characters and stunning locations. Test your skills by completing interesting levels and unrav
bluejetty:00069557:ios.description:
Solitaire Crime Stories is an exciting new Solitaire game which will carry you away into a world of fascinating criminal investigations, colorful characters and stunning locations. Test your skills by completing interesting levels and unraveling the mysteries of the town of Springdale!
 Springdale is a small American town that lives in peace and quiet... but that’s only at first glance. Everyone hides secrets here, secrets that could tear this carefree town apart. Mysterious murders and dark family secrets are only some of the riddles for our young journalist heroine Lana Whitt to unravel. With the support of Assistant Sheriff Bill Maite and your deductive powers, she is ready to go to the very end in her search for the truth. Examine crime scenes, analyze clues and interrogate suspects — a deep dive into the world of real detective work awaits you so you can apprehend the wrongdoers. Forget about your everyday problems and enter a world of investigations, secrets and malevolent plots in this unique virtual detective tale.
 Solitaire Crime Stories is a game about the exciting adventures of journalist Lana Whitt and her assistant Bill. Visit all of the different corners of Springdale and talk to dozens of colorful characters — from pizza delivery men to ruthless gangsters! Get inspired and fascinated by the many stories written in the tradition of the best English detective fiction!
 To solve the crimes, players need to develop their Solitaire playing skills. Solitaire Crime Stories will appeal to both novices and masters of the genre, because the game can provide hours of interesting plays and fascinating puzzles. Powerful boosters will help you complete even the most complex level, letting you to clear the playing field even in the space of a few seconds.
 Tired of investigating? Then meet Max, the cute kitten which is waiting for you, always ready to play and have fun. Complete Solitaire levels to take care of the kitten and play with him, as well as making him new toys and decorations. 
 The many features of Solitaire Crime Stories include:
 - solving fascinating puzzles to find clues and solve crimes
 - visiting unique locations and meeting many interesting characters
 - playing hundreds of levels of Solitaire
 - playing with Max the kitten in a separate game mode
 - playing offline without worrying about an Internet connection
 - enjoying the wonderful graphics, colorful characters and gorgeous locations
 - untangling the knot of mysteries in the town of Springdale
 Lana Whitt is waiting for your help in investigating the crimes that have shaken this little town. Only your Solitaire victories will help her find the trails of cunning criminals! Become a Solitaire master and a talented detective in one in Solitaire Crime Stories!

bluejetty:00168855:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00168855:ios.description:
Here’s the honest description of our game. Don’t say we didn’t warn you. 
This game is sort of like tower defense, but not really. You’re in charge of orcs, fighting off waves of humans. Your goal is to take down the humans' wall that they’re pouring through. Each kill tosses you a bit of gold, which you can use to slightly reduce the time it takes to spawn an orc and upgrade a few things - because who doesn’t love a good grind? 
So, you’ll grind, upgrade, die, collect some stuff, do a few challenges, and, oh yeah, die again. And again. 
And that, my friends, is basically the core gameplay. 
Now, let’s get to the stuff you’re definitely going to love:
 - This game is insanely hard. Like Contra-level hard, but with half the polish. On average, our players need at least eight attempts just to beat the first dungeon.
 - There are fun items you can use, but good luck finding them. Occasionally, you’ll stumble upon a treasure chest that you can unlock - if you watch an ad, of course. Sometimes humans will drop items, and sometimes you’ll get them at the start. We like to keep things unpredictable. 
 - After you finally take down the humans' wall, brace yourself for the final wave. We’ve made this one extra strong just for you, so just when you think you’ve won - surprise! You haven’t. 
 - Each new dungeon resets your upgrades. Sure, you’ll keep your items, but all those painstaking upgrades you made in one dungeon? Gone. 
Jump in and enjoy the frustration. 
We worked really hard to make sure you will!

bluejetty:00143534:ios.summary:
Cooltra e-moped sharing – rent electric mopeds and bikes by the minute in your city. Register in just a few steps and start riding. 
Benefits of Cooltra electric mopeds 
The leading electric moped rental app in Europe 
THE LARGEST FLEET:
bluejetty:00143534:ios.description:
Cooltra e-moped sharing – rent electric mopeds and bikes by the minute in your city. Register in just a few steps and start riding. 
Benefits of Cooltra electric mopeds 
The leading electric moped rental app in Europe 
THE LARGEST FLEET: More than 30,000 electric mopeds are waiting for you. Find us in Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia, Seville, Paris, Milan, Rome, Turin and Lisbon. 
PAY-AS-YOU-GO: Rent your e-moped and pay only for the minutes you need. No complications. 
INSURANCE INCLUDED: Ride with total peace of mind. All trips include comprehensive insurance. 
TWO HELMETS: Each moped comes with two helmets (sizes M and L) for you and your passenger. 
How does e-moped rental work? 
Simple, fast and intuitive. Rent your e-moped right away. 
1. Locate the nearest moped available on the app map and press “Reserve”. 
2. Once you are next to the e-moped, you can “Swipe to start” the trip. All e-mopeds come with two certified helmets, sizes M and L. 
3. Time to ride: press the START button on your e-moped and go. Remember to follow all safety rules and respect other people and vehicles on the road. 
4. When you reach your destination, park correctly, always following the city regulations. 
5. Place the helmet back and in the app “Swipe to finish”. At this point we will ask you to take a photo of the e-moped correctly parked. 
What mobility services will you find? 
Your e-moped rental app wherever you travel. 
1. Shared electtric moped rental in Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia, Seville, Paris, Milan, Rome, Turin and Lisbon. 
2. Shared electric bike rental in Barcelona. 
3. As a Cooltra user, you can also use the felyx e-moped service in Amsterdam, Delft, The Hague, Eindhoven, Haarlem, Rotterdam, Nijmegen, Antwer, Brusels. 
4. Daily and monthly moped and bike rental at more than 100 rental points across Europe: Barcelona, Formentera, Gran Canaria, Granada, Ibiza, Madrid, Malaga, Mallorca, Menorca, Seville, Tenerife, Valencia, Paris, Milan, Rome, Lisbon, Porto and more. 
Affordable prices 
Choose the moped rental option that best fits your needs. 
- Registration is free and, if you invite your friends, you will both get credit and promotions. 
- Take advantage of our Packs and Bundles: a prepaid option where we give you extra free credits. The more you prepay, the more you get in the offer. The ideal way to lower the price per kilometre as much as possible. 
- We created the PASS option: pay to use any Cooltra e-moped or bike for a continuous period of time. With a 24h or 48h PASS you can switch e-mopeds and bikes as many times as you want. This daily e-moped rental is perfect for business trips, long working days, when your own e-moped is in the workshop, or for sightseeing in any Cooltra city. 
Enjoy our promotions 
We constantly share offers and promotions on our social media. Follow us on TikTok @cooltramobility and turn on notifications to stay updated on e-moped rental deals in your city. 
Protecting the environment 
With Cooltra more than 10,000 tons of CO2 have already been saved. Let’s work together for sustainable mobility. 
After 19 years of providing e-moped and bike rental services, we know better than anyone how important safe and easy urban mobility is for you. Download the Cooltra app and start enjoying our electric e-mopeds. 
If you have any questions or feedback about the app, write to us at hello@cooltra.com. 
- App registration requires uploading a photo of a valid driver’s license. 
 ** Vehicle rental is subject to terms of use and availability.

LiftTalk is here for you every step of the way, guiding you through daily life and its complexities. Trusted by thousands of users and professionals, our platform is the preferred choice for those seeking expert guidance. bluejetty:00098106:ios.description:
Pomodoro Technique is a time management method by Francesco Cirillo in the 1980s.
There are six steps in the original technique:
1. Decide on the task to be done.
2. Set the pomodoro timer (traditionally to 25 minutes).
3. Work on the task.
4. End work when the timer rings and put a checkmark on a piece of paper.
5. If you have fewer than four checkmarks, take a short break (3–5 minutes) and then return to step 2; otherwise continue to step 6.
6. After four pomodoros, take a longer break (15–30 minutes), reset your checkmark count to zero, then go to step 1.

Dotterly is the best diamond art pattern maker app on iPhone and iPad. Easily create and print your own DIY diamond painting kits at home with this simple yet powerful app.

IT WORKS LIKE MAGIC
When converting a photo, use our custom-built wizard tool to effortlessly choose the best settings for your image and see the results instantly.
TRACE OVER IMAGES
When drawing your own designs, you can show an image in the background. This can be super helpful as a reference to trace over. You can also show the original image after converting a photo, which makes tidying up your patterns even easier.
MAKE YOUR MASTERPIECE
Once your pattern is finished, simply print it at home as a DIY kit:
1) Print your pattern at home
2) Attach a double-sided adhesive sheet
3) Stick down the drills to the adhesive sheet, just like a normal diamond painting kit
JOIN THOUSANDS OF HAPPY CUSTOMERS...

FAQ
Is the full version a one-time purchase?
Yes. There are no subscriptions. You can create and export as many patterns as you like with the one-time purchase.
Can I unlock my other devices using the same purchase?
Yes. You can unlock the full version on your iPhone, iPad and Mac (M1 chip or later) with just one purchase.
Can I share the purchase with my family?
Yes. Family Sharing is enabled.
Can I sell my patterns?
Yes. You can also add your store details to your PDF exports.
Do I have to buy the materials separately?
Yes. The app is only for creating patterns. You can buy the drills online from Diamond Dotz, Artdot and DiamondDrillsUSA. You can buy the adhesive sheets (double-sided) from Amazon.
Where is my data stored?
Your data is stored on your device. All processing is done locally on your device. Your data is never transmitted to third parties.

bluejetty:00042348:ios.summary:
Transform your business with just a few clicks by accessing the renowned appointment scheduling app, Picktime, right from the palm of your hand.
Picktime is a free online booking system and appointment scheduling software designed to help
bluejetty:00042348:ios.description:
Transform your business with just a few clicks by accessing the renowned appointment scheduling app, Picktime, right from the palm of your hand.
Picktime is a free online booking system and appointment scheduling software designed to help small businesses manage their appointments, classes, group bookings, rental reservations, and staff. With Picktime, salons, gyms, doctors, cleaning businesses, consultants, tutors, and equipment rental businesses can easily manage their schedules and streamline their operations.
Picktime allows you to create a customizable booking page where customers can easily book their appointments, classes, equipment and events. 
Stay Engaged
Picktime supports automated reminders, so you can minimize no-shows and keep your schedule running smoothly. Not only that, but users can also customize the reminder mail so that your client never misses an appointment again. 
Manage Bookings in a Flash
Change of plans or rescheduling? Picktime can handle it all in the twinkle of an eye. Rescheduling, cancellations, no show, or late entry Picktime understands it all and has made it easier for your clients to rebook. 
Plus, with Picktime's class/group booking feature, you can easily schedule bookings for multiple clients in the same time slot. It also supports attendance tracking, so you can keep track of which clients have attended their appointments.
Contactless Payment & Invoice
Picktime allows you to accept payments online using PayPal or Stripe, so your clients can conveniently pay for their appointments in advance. It's not limited to simple transactions, generating invoices effortlessly for the services undertaken.
It also supports multiple locations so you can manage appointments across different branches of your business.
Look Around
With Picktime's recurring bookings feature, you can schedule appointments that repeat at regular intervals, such as weekly or monthly. 
How often do you have time to stop and check who's the most diligent person on your staff or who's doing nothing but sitting around? The Picktime's Round Robin feature ensures the automatic distribution with a fair share of bookings, so no one in your team gets overburdened. 
Picktime also supports automatic timezone conversion, so clients can see your availability in their timezone, making booking appointments easier.
Picktime's waitlist feature allows you to automatically add clients to the waitlist if a time slot is full, so you can quickly fill any cancellations or no-shows. 
Unique integrations
Picktime integrates with Google, Apple, and Outlook calendars, so you can easily sync your schedule across different platforms. Most businesses don't even require physical existence to complete a service. You can also schedule virtual meetings to connect with your clients remotely. Picktime offers integration with all your favourite apps, including - Video Meetings, Calendars, Booking Widgets, CRMs, Email Marketing, and more.
Work Safely and Securely
Built-in app security protects your data on the device and in transit while using the client's trusted industry leader platform. We have created a process through which users can limit their staff's access to the data and control and edit the admin rights. 
Picktime's resource feature allows you to schedule your resources and make the rental process more accessible. You can also generate detailed reports on your business operations to gain insights into your performance and make data-driven decisions.
Check out our complete feature list and plans at www.picktime.com 
Picktime is free, easy to set up, and fully customizable to meet your unique business needs. Download Picktime today and start streamlining your booking and scheduling processes!
Our team is always at your service! For more information and support, contact us through our website in-app chat or email us at support@picktime.com

bluejetty:00163762:ios.name: Hydro-Québec
bluejetty:00163762:ios.summary:
With the Hydro-Québec app, follow track the status of an outage, access information about your account and track your electricity consumption. 
Power outages 
The tool to find out more about ongoing outages and planned service interruption
bluejetty:00163762:ios.description:
With the Hydro-Québec app, follow track the status of an outage, access information about your account and track your electricity consumption. 
Power outages 
The tool to find out more about ongoing outages and planned service interruptions. 
• Track the service status for any addresses you want at any time. 
• Manage the tracking options for any addresses you want. 
• Add a label for the addresses you are tracking: daycare, school, condo, parents. 
• Activate notifications to receive information about the service status and to find out if there are any planned service interruptions at those addresses. 
• Report an outage easily. 
Your consumption 
Your consumption data presented in different ways to help you track, understand and manage your electricity consumption: 
• An overview of your hourly electricity consumption from the previous day 
• An overview of the current period and a forecast of the bill amount 
• Detailed analysis of your electricity consumption, including a breakdown by use 
• Comparison with households similar to yours 
Your account 
Quick access to sign up for services and manage your account. 
• See your account balance and next billing date. 
• See your billing and payment history. 
• Sign up for the Equalized Payments Plan to pay the same amount every month, winter and summer alike, and receive an alert when you use more electricity than anticipated. 
• Sign up for Pre-Authorized Debit and avoid late payments. 
• Turn on notifications to receive billing notices and payment due reminders. 
Determine your home’s profile and get customized recommendations so you can build your action plan and save. You can easily update your profile when necessary. 
Click on “More” to for even more! 
• Options for modifying your home’s profile or for selecting, modifying or adding an account in your Customer Space 
• App settings to turn on the notifications, modify the language and define your connection options, including Continuous connection 
• Quick links to the most commonly used online services 
• Information about how to contact us 
• Information about touring facilities that are open to the public 
• Hydro-Québec news

Automatic Background Removal:
- SnapBG utilizes powerful algorithms and machine learning technology to automatically detect and remove backgrounds from your images. This saves you time and effort, as manual selection is not required.
- Simply upload your image, and SnapBG will intelligently isolate the subject or object from its background.
- 1 touch get white background for photo

bluejetty:00127922:ios.description:
Immerse yourself a World of 3D Matching Magic with Tile Triple 3D!
Tile Triple 3D is a unique and addictive matching puzzle game that is not only fun to play but also helps to relieve stress and train your brain. 
Here's what makes it truly special:
* BOOST YOUR BRAINPOWER: Sharpen your memory, focus, and problem-solving skills as you identify and match identical tiles. Each level presents a new twist, keeping your mind active and engaged.
* RELAX AND DE-STRESS: Escape the daily grind and melt away tension with the game's calm and soothing atmosphere. Enjoy delightful 3D visuals as you match your way to puzzle victory.
* CHALLENGE YOURSELF: Don't underestimate the seemingly simple rules! As you progress, levels become increasingly intricate, demanding strategic thinking and quick reflexes to clear the board before time runs out.
* BECOME A MASTER: Utilize powerful boosters to overcome tricky levels and unlock exciting rewards. Climb the leaderboards and compete with friends to see who reigns supreme in the world of Tile Triple 3D!
* PLAY ANYTIME, ANYWHERE: Take your puzzle passion on the go! Tile Triple 3D is completely free to play and offline-friendly, so you can enjoy it whenever, wherever the mood strikes.
HOW TO PLAY
• Tap to place the 3D tiles into the box. 
• Match three identical tiles to collect them.
• When all tiles are collected, you win!
• Collect all the tiles before the time runs out to win the level.
• Use boosters to help you beat challenging levels.
Join the millions of people who are already enjoying Tile Triple 3D! Download it today and start relaxing and training your brain!
If you have any questions or concerns, let us know, we make sure to help you have the best game experience: support@lihuhugames.com

Change the way you speak to yourself with daily affirmations chosen for the moment.
Build confidence before a hard day, return to self-love when doubt gets loud, find calm before sleep, or give your goals clear language. Explore words for gratitude, mornings, relationships, work, study, health, money, mindfulness and personal growth.

bluejetty:00035224:ios.description:
Step into a world of creativity, style, and adventure in Avatar Boca Queen: Airplane! Create your own avatar, design beautiful spaces, explore the airport, and experience exciting new adventures.
Bring your imagination to life as you customize characters, decorate rooms, and interact with a vibrant world full of fun activities.
Key Features
- Create Your Own Avatar :
Design a unique avatar that represents your style! Choose from many hairstyles, outfits, accessories, and facial features to create a character that truly feels like you. Mix and match styles to build your perfect look.
- Matching Outfit Mini Game :
Test your fashion sense in a fun outfit-matching challenge! Choose the best clothes, shoes, and accessories to match the style and score points. Perfect for players who love fashion and creativity.
- Design and Decorate Your Dream Home : 
Become an interior designer! Customize your house with furniture, lights, tables, decorations, and plants. Create cozy rooms or stylish modern spaces — the choice is yours.
- Explore the Interactive Airport :
Discover an exciting airport world filled with interactive elements. Check in passengers, explore the terminal, and experience the fun atmosphere of travel.
- New Flight Attendant Game :
Become a flight attendant and manage the airplane cabin! Help passengers, serve them during the flight, and make sure everyone has a comfortable trip. Experience what it's like to work in the sky!
Why You'll Love Avatar Boca Queen :
• Create and customize your own avatar
• Design and decorate beautiful houses
• Play fun fashion mini-games
• Explore an interactive airport world
• Experience the new Flight Attendant gameplay
• Endless creativity and storytelling possibilities
Whether you love fashion, design, role-playing, or adventure, Avatar Boca Queen: Airplane offers a fun and relaxing experience for everyone.
Create your story, design your world, and start your adventure today!

bluejetty:00018309:ios.description:
Our mobile banking application provides easy management of your finances on the go for your personal and business accounts – allowing you to check balances, transfer funds, view transactions and make deposits from anywhere, anytime. It's convenient, safe, secure and available to all our online banking users.
With the West Coast Community Bank mobile app, you can do the following:
• Pay bills
• Deposit checks
• View check images
• View deposit history
• Check balances 24/7
• Control credit and debit cards
• Send and receive secure messages
• Change and cancel pending payments
• View pending transactions and recent activity
• Locate West Coast Community Bank branches and ATMs
• Create, cancel and view funds transfers between accounts
• And much more
In addition to the features available to consumer clients (listed above), business and corporate clients can also take advantage of these enhanced functions:
• Business Positive Pay
• Ability to set up multiple users
• Create and approve business bill payments
• Controls to add, remove, and maintain users
• Payment authorization for ACH and wire transactions
• Create single wire payments (domestic and international)
• Create, approve, cancel and view funds transfers between accounts
• Setup and maintain business alerts to monitor activity and mitigate fraud
We do not charge a fee for mobile banking; however, carrier data rates may apply.
Getting started is easy. Simply download the app and sign on with your West Coast Community Bank online banking user credentials. Not yet set up as an online banking user? Contact us to enroll today.
For more information about West Coast Community Bank mobile services, please visit wccb.com or call us: 831.457.5000.
PRIVACY: We are committed to protecting the privacy of your financial information. To learn how we protect your privacy, please visit wccb.com to access our online Privacy Policy. Member FDIC

bluejetty:00006710:android.summary: This QR scanner app will let you scan and read any barcode in a second. Thanks to this barcode reader and QR scanner you will feel comfortable in any environment and will be able to obtain any necessary information in the shortest possible
bluejetty:00006710:android.description:
This QR scanner app will let you scan and read any barcode in a second. Thanks to this barcode reader and QR scanner you will feel comfortable in any environment and will be able to obtain any necessary information in the shortest possible time.
QR codes and barcodes have become omnipresent. They allow us to quickly and conveniently get to know valuable information. When we travel, these codes help us to promptly find the necessary direction, get a brief historical reference about a certain place of attraction or download the train schedule. When we are shopping, they allow us to compare the prices and get access to discount coupons.
The codes help us to compress large volumes of information into a few millimeters of the precious screen space. After you extract it, you will be able to visit diverse websites, resort to profitable offers, connect to a Wi-Fi network without introducing the password and carry out many useful functions.
Which Type of Information Can This QR Code Reader Process
This QR and barcode reader is capable of processing the following types of information provided in the form of a code:
Text
Contacts
Timetable
Wi-Fi
Product
ISBN
URL
Price
Many more
How to Use the App
The algorithm of using the application is genuinely simple:
1. Spot a barcode or a QR code.
2. Point the camera of your device on this code and do not push any buttons — the app does not require any additional commands or clicks.
3. Wait for a second to let the gadget recognize the information.
4. Read the information obtained from the code.
The history of all your scans will be saved automatically. You will be able to come back to any item that you previously scanned at any moment.
Instead of using the camera, you can upload the codes from your gallery.
Advanced Opportunities
Once you download this free QR reader for Android, you will never need to resort to any other scanner barcode app. 
If you find yourself in the dark, just turn on the flashlight to use this QR reader free.
Apart from scanning the codes, you can also generate them. The generator comes especially handy when you need to share your contacts with new friends, acquaintances, partners, clients or colleagues.
Advantages of the App
In addition to the functionality that was described above, this QR code scanner can boast of the following advantages:
1. It is distributed 100% at no cost. You will not need to pay for anything either at the moment of installation or later when upgrading to newer versions.
2. This piece of software is compatible with any Android device, be it a smartphone or tablet, regardless of its brand and model.
3. The app is lightweight, it downloads in a matter of seconds and occupies minimum space in the gadget's memory. It will not make your phone slow down.
4. Thanks to a highly intuitive interface and sleek design, it will take you just a couple of minutes to figure out how this barcode reader functions.
This QR code and barcode scanner will make your life significantly easier. Feel free to install this QR barcode app right now to enjoy its multiple benefits!

SmartLabels is a companion app designed specifically for use with physical SmartLabels QR code stickers. Physical labels are required to utilize the box tracking and inventory features.
--------------------------------------------------
Organize your home, garage, attic, and moving boxes in seconds with SmartLabels, the ultimate QR code storage tracker and home inventory system.
If you are looking for smart labels for storage bins, you have found the perfect solution. Never wonder what’s inside a tote or moving box again. Simply peel, stick, scan, and catalog your belongings using our color-coded scannable QR code stickers.
KEY FEATURES:
• SCAN & CATALOG: Link physical SmartLabels QR code stickers to your digital inventory instantly.
• SMART PHOTO ASSIST: Take a photo of your items and let AI automatically identify, catalog, and list them in your box.
• FAST SEARCH: Search by item name, tag, category, or location to pinpoint exactly where your items are stored. Use the app to scan labels and find your stuff in seconds.
• LOCATION TRACKING: Keep track of items across your garage, attic, basement, shed, or storage unit. 
• CUSTOM FIELDS: Add dates, values, text notes, and toggles for detailed item tracking.
• EXPORT & SHARE: Export your box inventory documents easily for moving, insurance, or personal records.
PERFECT FOR:
- Storage Bins & Totes: Apply QR code labels for storage directly to your plastic bins to identify seasonal decorations, tools, and sports gear without opening the lid.
- Moving & Packing: Label moving boxes and find what you need without unpacking everything.
- Small Business Inventory: Track stock, parts, and supplies efficiently.
Say goodbye to messy bins and wasted time searching for your stuff. Get your scannable labels and upgrade your home organization with SmartLabels today!

Choose from various hairstyles, eyes, noses, mouths, and other features, match your favorite clothes and accessories, and pick your favorite combination from many styles. In BoBo City, you can also have your own room! And you can decorate and furnish the room according to your own tastes and creativity. You can choose furniture, decorations, wallpaper, and flooring to design a cozy, comfortable, and personalized space. Whether it's a minimalist modern style, a cute and pink style, or a warm pastoral style, you can achieve it here!
Start a journey full of joy and memories with BoBo friends!

Explore scenes without rules!
Create lots of character images!
Design and decorate your own room!
A vast array of interactive props!
Exquisite graphics and vivid sound effects!
Regular updates with more areas and characters!
Discover hidden puzzles and rewards!
Supports multi-touch, allowing you to play with friends!

It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Keystone Bank:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes, and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Keystone Bank app, you must be enrolled as a Keystone Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00171423:android.summary:

This system can transform collected data into an
bluejetty:00171423:android.description:
Story Background:
In the year 2234 AD, technology has advanced to an astonishing level. Humanity has developed the ultimate data system known as the DB System through data of unknown origin.
This system can transform collected data into anything in the real world. For example, customizable data pets can be created for children to adopt, providing both safety and affordability; powerful data-driven workers can assist in construction, saving immense amounts of human and material resources. The DB System has revolutionized the world, as data entities can be given their own thoughts and personalities, just like humans.
However, the widespread use of the DB System brings about an unprecedented disaster. The protagonist meets their end in this disaster but is reborn as a robot. To find their lost family, they embark on a journey filled with adventure.
Game Features:
1.Infinite Pets:
Collect over 1000 unique pets, each with distinct attributes. From turtles, rabbits, and charming people to robots, aliens, beasts, dogs, flowers, fish, flying creatures, and sea life, there's something to satisfy every collector's desires.
2.Diverse Professions:
Over 200 profession combinations, such as combining swordsman with magic to create a powerful magic swordsman or combining guard with holy priest to become a paladin. Players can create their own unique gameplay styles.
3.Expansive Maps:
Explore various terrains including plains, deserts, skies, beaches, underwater realms, dungeons, ruins, graves, ice fields, mountains, and palaces, each offering adventure and surprises.
4.Long-Term Development:
Capture and train a variety of pets to adventure alongside you, experiencing a unique and engaging long-term development gameplay.
Internet connection required.
The game is free to play, with in-game purchases for virtual currency, items, and other premium services.
Please be mindful of your gaming time and avoid addiction.
For more news and events, join our official forum and fan page!
Official Fan Page:https://www.facebook.com/STLIStudio
Official Forum:https://www.facebook.com/groups/megadata
If you encounter any issues during gameplay, 
please report them through the fan page. 
The application’s permissions are required for basic game functionality, and we do not collect any personal information from your device.

bluejetty:00034402:ios.name: Infinity Nikki
bluejetty:00034402:ios.summary: Infinity Nikki, developed by Infold Games, is the fifth installment in the Nikki series—a multi-platform open-world game built on the UE5 engine. It's an enchanting experience dedicated to creating and collecting beauty. Nikki, together wit
bluejetty:00034402:ios.description:
Infinity Nikki, developed by Infold Games, is the fifth installment in the Nikki series—a multi-platform open-world game built on the UE5 engine. It's an enchanting experience dedicated to creating and collecting beauty. Nikki, together with Momo, harnesses the power of Whim and ability outfits, facing every challenge with courage and discovering miracles along the way.
[New Main Story Chapter] Golden Dust
The final chapter of the Itzaland main story is now available, along with the new region, Heaven's Reach, open for exploration. Dreams of a golden celebration stir as echoes of the Titan civilization linger... Set out for the Golden City, follow the Mark of the Cycle, and witness the finale of Itzaland's fate!
[Open World] Explore and Discover Unseen Wonders
Step into a vast, living world where every horizon hides a new mystery. Transform through Gigantification to move faster, leap higher, and unleash a thunderous Roar to take on the massive Behemoths. Use the Sticky Claw to glide across the skies and reach hidden spots. With every step, your sense of freedom, discovery, and adventure grows.
[Ingenious Combat] Shape Your Adventure
Nikki's new Archery ability turns combat into a skillful, interactive experience. Use bows to break shields, solve puzzles, and unlock hidden paths, blending exploration and strategy. Choose your Battle Companions for offense or defense roles, allowing you to tailor your own style and approach to every challenge.
[Online Co-op] A Journey Shared, Souls No Longer Walking Alone
Meet Nikkis from parallel worlds and embark on a beautiful adventure together. When the Starbell softly rings, friends will be reunited. Whether walking hand in hand or exploring freely on your own, your journey will be filled with joy every step of the way.
[Home Building] Nikki's Floating Island
Build your dream home on an island of your own. Design every space your way, grow crops, gather stars, raise fish... This is more than an island; it's a living dream woven from Whim.
[Fashion Photography] Capture the World Through Your Lens, Master the Perfect Palette
Mix and match colors and styles to capture the beauty of the world. Use Momo's Camera to customize your favorite filters, settings, and photo styles, preserving each precious moment in a single shot.
An Open-World Styling Fantasy！
Thank you for being interested in Infinity Nikki. We look forward to meeting you in Miraland!

Want to lose belly fat and get toned, defined abs? Too busy for the gym? Six Pack makes your workout journey simple and effective. No equipment needed. Sculpt six pack abs with this workout planner and see real progress in just 30 days. Explore various workouts for all levels and body parts—work out at home or anywhere, anytime. Just a few minutes a day to build the six pack you've always dreamed of!
Workout Plan with Different Levels
Beginner, Intermediate and Advanced Abs Workout - these 3 levels of workout plans help you lose belly fat and build abdominal muscles step by step. Whether you are a beginner or a pro, you can find workouts that are suitable for you. Different exercises are prepared every day to keep it fresh and exciting.
30 Days of Workout Routines
Amazing results will be achieved earlier once you set a clear goal. 6 Pack Abs - Abs Workout helps you set exercise goals by providing systematic and scientific 30-day workout routines. Exercise intensity increases gradually, so you can easily make exercising a daily habit.
Your Personal Trainer at Home
Is hiring a personal trainer too expensive? Have no time to go to the gym? 6 Pack Abs - Abs Workout is your personal trainer at home. Based on the high-intensity circuit training principle, these workouts are as effective as gym workouts.
Animations and Video Guides
6 Pack Abs - Abs Workout has been scientifically proven to help strengthen all your abdominal muscles. With animations and video guides, you can make sure you perform each exercise safely and effectively.
Features
*Sync data to Apple Health

☑️ Radio alarm clock and sleep timer

Smooth and intuitive interface
Regular updates with new stations
Lightweight and optimized app for Android
High audio quality and stable connection

Lightweight ads help fund maintenance and updates.
You can disable them via the ad-free version.
If you like Radio Israel FM, please leave us a rating on the Play Store, it helps us a lot.

Have a suggestion, a missing station, or feedback?
Write to us at appradios@yahoo.fr
, our team will be happy to assist you.
Internet connection required (Wi-Fi, 3G/4G/5G).

bluejetty:00063291:ios.description:
** Winner of 5 Webby Awards - Draw a Stickman Franchise **
** Played over 100 Million Times around the Globe **
Grab your pencil and get ready for the most creative DRAW A STICKMAN adventure yet!
Imagination is the key, as you enter a magical storybook full of mystery and wonder, unusual creatures and enigmatic puzzles! Create your own original stickman and then watch it come to life in DRAW A STICKMAN: EPIC 2! Challenge yourself to unlock every secret, collect every drawing and share your creativity with the world!
BRING YOUR DRAWINGS TO LIFE
Unleash your creativity as you draw a Stickman from your own unique perspective, and then watch your animated hero come to life before your eyes! Make every idea a reality by saving drawings in your Sketchbook, and sharing them with friends!
A NEW STORY
Embark on a perilous journey through time! Draw your Stickman and create a friend! But be warned….disaster falls upon your ally! It’s up to you to become the hero! Maneuver your way through the magical world of EPIC 2 in a quest to save your partner!
YOUR DRAWINGS MATTER
Create and save unlimited drawings in your Sketchbook that comes to life throughout your adventure!
SHARE AND RECEIVE DRAWINGS WITH FRIENDS
With the new share feature, you can now send your creations to your friends. They will then be able to use your drawings in their own epic adventures! 
FIGHT EPIC BATTLES
Face off against inked-out goblins, tongue-lashing frogs, fire-breathing dragons, and BIG bosses! You must use your own strategies to solve intriguing challenges and puzzles, while battling all new villains!
Jump in to this action-packed adventure that allows for endless creativity! 
As you explore each colorful environment, choose from an assortment of drawing pencils and tools to help you successfully overcome every obstacle along the way.
New features and enhancements allow you to choose from a larger color palette, along with a variety of pencil sizes. With the new share feature, send your drawings to your friends! Unlock hidden Color Buddies, locate puzzle pieces, and enjoy new drawing pencils for Wires, Eggs, and Ice! This is an experience like no other, personalized by you!
DRAW A STICKMAN: EPIC 2 is the sequel you’ve been waiting for and is sure to offer hours of entertainment to avid gamers and creative minds alike!

Um aplicativo que te dá estacionamento grátis como benefício pelas suas compras?
Com descontos exclusivos e brindes só cadastrando notas?
Sim, o app do Shopping Metrópole é pra você que ama ser nosso cliente! Com ele é possível encontrar suas lojas e restaurantes favoritos, consultar e garantir ingressos para o cinema e pagar o estacionamento sem filas.
Oferecemos experiências personalizadas:
 * Programa de Benefícios
 Tenha acesso a serviços gratuitos, brindes e sorteios exclusivos. Cadastre suas notas fiscais e ganhe benefícios exclusivos.
 *Pague o estacionamento online
 Para maior comodidade, evite filas e pague o estacionamento direto pelo celular.
 *Compre ingressos de cinema sem filas
 O melhor do cinema está aqui! Confira os filmes em cartaz, consulte horários das sessões e garanta seus ingressos sem filas.
 * Informações e localização de lojas no shopping
 Confira os horários de funcionamento, contatos, serviços disponíveis e a localização das nossas lojas e restaurantes.
 Não fique de fora e tenha um shopping inteiro de opções na sua mão!

bluejetty:00099577:ios.description:
Press play to grow. Your 15-minute daily book cast.
Turn spare moments into real growth with BookCast. We transform must-read nonfiction into 15-minute audio summaries so you can listen anywhere, learn faster, and move
confidently toward your goals.
Why BookCast
Immersive audio. Professional, clear, and pleasant narration.
15-minute insights. No fluff — big ideas with actionable takeaways.
Goal-based picks. Set your aims (career, health, focus) and get personalized recommendations.
A growing library. Explore business, productivity, health, psychology, creativity, and more.
Daily micro-learning. Fresh highlights keep your learning streak strong.
Listen anywhere. Offline play, background mode, and speed control for commutes or workouts.
Smart discovery. Search, curated lists, and book requests when you need something new.
What You’ll Achieve
Read less, understand more. Capture insights in minutes.
Turn idle time into a lasting learning habit.
Replace doom-scrolling with purposeful listening.
Apply ideas right away at work and in life.
Build a personal library of book summaries.
Who It’s For
Busy professionals, creators, teachers, freelancers, students — anyone who wants fast nonfiction insights through audio.
How It Works
Set goals and topics.
Press play on a curated summary.
Learn in 15 minutes with clear ideas.
Apply the takeaways and grow day by day.
Categories You’ll Love
Business & Money – leadership, decisions, investing.
Productivity – focus, habits, time management.
Psychology – mindset, motivation, resilience.
Relationships – communication, empathy, teamwork.
Health – energy, sleep, mental fitness.
Creativity – innovation, storytelling, systems.
Features
Premium audio by professional narrators.
Concise structure with key ideas and examples.
Personalized recommendations that improve as you listen.
Daily Highlight keeps your streak alive.
Offline and background playback.
Powerful search and book requests.
Use BookCast To
Prep fast for meetings or interviews.
Spark ideas for your next project.
Refresh classics in one listen.
Build habits that compound daily.
Your Growth, Your Pace
Not a speed reader? Prefer audio? BookCast meets you where you are with quick, engaging summaries anytime.
Ready to read less and understand more?
Press play to grow. With BookCast, personal growth is always one listen away.
Listen. Learn. Level up.

bluejetty:00014696:ios.summary:
SUMMARY
Manage your business anytime, anywhere using any device plus marketing with your own website. The easiest to use appointment scheduling software.
Templates available for hair salon, nail spa, barber shop, pet shop, personal trainer
bluejetty:00014696:ios.description:
SUMMARY
Manage your business anytime, anywhere using any device plus marketing with your own website. The easiest to use appointment scheduling software.
Templates available for hair salon, nail spa, barber shop, pet shop, personal trainer, fitness class, doctor, tutoring, auto detailing, maid service, nail techs, carpet cleaning, pool cleaning, plumbing, landscaping, tattoo, tour groups, realtors, and other personal service businesses and independent contractors.
YOUR APPOINTMENT BOOK / PLANNER
• Setup recurring appointments
• Set custom times (service time, processing time, finish out time, etc) and pricing for services
• Services already have the business rules you need, for example:
* Have a haircut and color appointment? The finish out is automatically removed
* Have a manicure and pedicure appointment with two different staff members? The services are automatically scheduled at the same time (not back to back)
• Want to override any business rule or move an appointment? No problem, it's as easy as drag and drop.
• Our iPad app and website allow easy drag and drop to move and create new appointments
• View your booking calendar in day, week, or month calendar views
• Plus many other features including: wait-list management, walk-in management, the ability to create overlapping appointments, group parties / private parties, automatically block out off days and holidays, and much more...
POINT-OF-SALE / CREDIT CARD PROCESSING
• Save money with our low credit card processing rates
• Save time doing paperwork with our easy to use interactive reports
• Need a merchant account for each independent staff member? No problem, our software supports multiple merchant accounts
• Our cash drawer feature allows you to keep track of your cash
• Customers can sign with their finger or you can print a receipt to have the customer sign
• Text & email customers beautifully designed receipts
BOOKING REMINDER
• Automatically send appointment reminders and confirmations via text,e-mail or both, specify the time before the appointment you want the reminder to be sent
• Email/Text receipts to clients
• Customize the emails sent to your clients
YOUR DATA
• All your data is backed up (to multiple locations in our safe and secure data center) the moment it is saved. Even if you lose your phone, iPad, and computer your information is still safe and secure.
• Contact us and we'll help you migrate data from another system
WEBSITE
• Customers get a headache-free website under your own domain name (www.your-domain.com).
• You start offering a new service, add a new staff, a staff member leaves? It immediately shows up on your website.
INVENTORY MANAGEMENT
• Automate ordering using our automatic order generator by ordering what you sold over a specific date range, since your last order, or based on a specific desired stock amount which you specify
• Seamlessly email orders to your distributors and product reps
• Easily print orders and product lists
SECURITY
• Role-based security allows you to set what each staff member's access
• Location-based security allows you to set which staff members can login from home to view their schedule
STAFF MANAGEMENT / PAYROLL
• Manage your employees times by creating a schedule they can see on their phone (or any other device) and allows them to clock-in clock-out only from company computers.
• Our easy to use timesheet allow you to track time and manage costs
SUBSCRIBING IN-APP 
• Use the starter version for free, upgrade to the independent package for $9.99/mo or silver business subscription for $39.99/mo; payment is charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase
• Monthly subscriptions automatically renew. You can manage auto-renew of your subscription from your iTunes account settings at http://support.apple.com/kb/ht4098
• For more information visit our privacy policy: www.ScheduleAnyone.com/info/PrivacyPolicy and our terms of service: www.ScheduleAnyone.com/info/ProviderAgreement

bluejetty:00126222:ios.name: Texter: Second Texting Number
bluejetty:00126222:ios.summary: Texter gives you a second phone number for texting on your iPhone. It is a simple and inexpensive way to send and receive text messages and make calls from a separate number, so you can keep your personal number for friends and family. No c
bluejetty:00126222:ios.description:
Texter gives you a second phone number for texting on your iPhone. It is a simple and inexpensive way to send and receive text messages and make calls from a separate number, so you can keep your personal number for friends and family. No contracts, transparent fees.
NO HASSLES
Our numbers come without a contract. You don't need a cell phone plan or another device to use your second phone number.
SIMPLE INSTRUCTIONS
Using your second phone number with Texter is super-simple. Purchase a number, recharge credits, and start messaging and calling.
TRANSPARENT FEES
Texter messaging and calling fees are as transparent as possible. By using the in-app Tariff calculator, you can check the cost per outgoing and incoming calls or messages based on a specific country.
UNRESTRICTED OWNERSHIP
Purchase and keep your number for as long as you need, or release it anytime.
NO ADS
The app doesn't bother you with any advertisement and never shares any of your data. No exceptions!
Use Texter in everyday situations:
• Buying or selling things on Craigslist, eBay, or other e-commerce platforms
• Dating
• Hosting apartments on Airbnb
• Using Uber
• Applying for a job
• Working (e.g. as a second work number) 
Phone numbers available in: USA, Canada, Sweden.
PRICING
Texter is free to download and comes with 20 free credits. Phone numbers and additional credits are available through subscriptions and in-app purchases.
Our standard Subscription Options for phone numbers are weekly, monthly and yearly.
If you choose to get one of our plans then your payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. The cost of the renewal depends on your Subscription Plan.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
When canceling a subscription, your subscription will remain active until the end of the period. Auto-renewal will be disabled but the current subscription will not be refunded.
IMPORTANT: Messages use prepaid credits. Area code availability varies. May not work with SMS shortcode services. Not for 911 or other emergency services.
Text messaging to UK and US numbers is unavailable (UK, US, PR, VI, Guam, and American Samoa).
Text messaging is not available in Africa (Algeria, Angola, Benin, Botswana, Burkina Faso, Burundi, Cameroon, Cape Verde, Central African Republic, Chad, Congo, The Democratic Republic Of The Congo, Cote D’Ivoire, Djibouti, Egypt, Equatorial Guinea, Eritrea, Ethiopia, Gabon, Gambia, Ghana, Guinea, Guinea-Bissau, Kenya, Lesotho, Liberia, Libyan Arab Jamahiriya, Madagascar, Malawi, Mali, Mauritania, Mauritius, Mayotte, Morocco, Mozambique, Namibia, Niger, Nigeria, Reunion Island, Rwanda, Sao Tome And Principe, Senegal, Seychelles, Sierra Leone, Somalia, South Africa, South Sudan, Sudan, Swaziland, United Republic Of Tanzania, Togo, Tunisia, Uganda, Western Sahara, Zambia, Zimbabwe) and Dominican Republic.
If you like Texter app, we would love if you left a great review in the App Store! Just a couple of kind words or a simple star rating helps a lot!
Privacy Policy: https://legal.apptoro.support/hc/en-us/articles/4417734791057
Terms of Use: https://legal.apptoro.support/hc/en-us/articles/4417344441617

bluejetty:00150198:ios.description:
Welcome to Aspect!
Over the next 21 days, you will work with a metabolic expert, to learn how your body works, by understanding how your gut reacts to various stimuli. You will see the impact certain foods, actions and states of mind can affect your glucose levels, and therefore your physical and mental well being.
Glucose has been scientifically proven to have a direct impact on quite a few aspects of our daily life. 
By using a continuous glucose monitor, our award winning app experience and other science-backed tools, we’ll be able to better understand how glucose has been impacting things like your sleep, stress, weight, energy levels, immune response, mood, and really so much more. 
Together, we’ll be uncovering the potential for you to live a higher quality of life that you feel confident about.
On this 21 day journey, you will be guides by our Aspect Certified personal metabolic expert, they will guide you through the entire experience including the process of applying the sensor, using the app, understanding your readings, and of course will help guide you into actually integrating these learnings that will benefit you for years to come.
At the end of the 21 day period, you’ll receive a fully personalized report on 
The ways your body responded to the experiments we explored, how you can better achieve your goals and recommendations for what you can do on your own to feel better everyday so that you can continue make sustainable progress that you feel positive about.
We can't wait to get started, how about you?
DISCLAIMERS:
THIS APP IS NOT MEANT TO PROVIDE MEDICAL SERVICES, IF YOU HAVE A MEDICAL CONDITION, PLEASE CONSULT WITH YOUR PHYSICIAN.
APPLE HEALTHKIT
This app can integrate to Apple HealthKit so your metabolic expert can find correlations between your blood glucose and other factors like exercise.

bluejetty:00014916:ios.name: Zoom for BlackBerry
bluejetty:00014916:ios.summary: Only download this app if you are a BlackBerry Technology customer. Specifically designed for the BlackBerry Dynamics secure mobility platform, this app allows both Zoom and BlackBerry Technology customers to take advantage of Zoom feature
bluejetty:00014916:ios.description:
Only download this app if you are a BlackBerry Technology customer. Specifically designed for the BlackBerry Dynamics secure mobility platform, this app allows both Zoom and BlackBerry Technology customers to take advantage of Zoom features in a secure BlackBerry MDM deployment. 
If you are not a BlackBerry Technology customer, you can download the main Zoom iOS application from the iTunes store here: 
https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/zoom-cloud-meetings/id546505307?ls=1&mt=8
Stay connected wherever you go – start or join a secure meeting with flawless video and audio, instant screen sharing, and cross-platform instant messaging - for free! 
Zoom is #1 in customer satisfaction and the best unified communication experience on mobile.
It's super easy! Install the free Zoom app, click on "New Meeting," and invite up to 100 people to join you on video! Connect with anyone on iPad, iPhone, other mobile devices, Windows, Mac, Zoom Rooms, H.323/SIP room systems, and telephones.
VIDEO MEETINGS FROM ANYWHERE
-Best video meeting quality
-Easily join a meeting or start an instant meeting with phone, email, or company contacts
-Virtual backgrounds on iPhone 8, iPad 5, iPad Pro and all later models
COLLABORATE ON THE GO
-Best iPhone and iPad content and mobile screen sharing quality
-Co-annotate over shared content
-Real-time whiteboard collaboration on iPad
UNLIMITED MESSAGING (WITH PHOTOS, FILES, AND MORE)
-Reach people instantly with messages, files, images, links, and gifs
-Quickly respond or react to threaded conversations with emojis
-Create or join public and private chat channels
MAKE, RECEIVE, AND MANAGE PHONE CALLS
-Effortlessly make or receive calls with your business number
-Get voicemail and call recording with transcripts
-Use call delegation to make/receive calls on behalf of others
-Set up auto-receptionists to autonomously answer and route calls
AND MORE….
-Safe driving mode while on the road and works with Apple Carplay
-Siri Shortcuts to customize your own voice commands to start, join, and listen to a list of upcoming meetings
-Use your iOS app to start your meeting or for direct share in Zoom Rooms
-Join Zoom Webinars as a view-only participant or panelist
-Works over wifi, 5G, 4G/LTE, and 3G networks
ZOOM LICENSE INFORMATION:
-Any free or paid license can be used with the app
-Zoom Phone is an add-on to paid Zoom licenses
-A paid Zoom subscription is required for certain product features
Follow us on social @zoom!
Have a question? Contact us at http://support.zoom.us.

bluejetty:00024593:ios.description:
Your complete headache & migraine diary.
Track migraine symptoms, monitor headache patterns, and manage treatments with this intuitive headache tracker designed for simplicity.
The perfect migraine tracker for understanding your pain patterns. Generate reports for your doctor directly from your headache migraine diary!
KEY FEATURES OF HEADACHE MIGRAINE DIARY
HEADACHE TRACKER ESSENTIALS:
- Track headaches and migraines with simple taps
- Monitor all migraine symptoms in your diary
- Log treatments in your headache & migraine diary
- Add detailed notes to your migraine tracker
- Visualize patterns in your headache tracker
MIGRAINE TRACKER ANALYTICS:
- Review headache trends in your diary
- Identify migraine triggers and patterns
- Analyze statistics from your headache & migraine diary
- Track improvement with your migraine tracker
- Recognize changes in headache frequency
HEADACHE & MIGRAINE DIARY SHARING:
- Generate PDF reports from your headache tracker
- Export CSV data from your migraine diary
- Share insights with healthcare providers
- Keep a comprehensive headache & migraine diary
PERSONALIZE YOUR MIGRAINE TRACKER:
- Create custom symptoms for your headache diary
- Define personal pain scales in the migraine tracker
- Add unique treatments to your headache & migraine diary
- Customize your headache tracker experience
- Build your personalized migraine diary
STAY CONSISTENT:
- Daily reminders for your headache & migraine diary
- Achievement system in your migraine tracker
- Secure with Face ID/Touch ID
- Private headache tracker just for you
Start your headache & migraine diary today - the migraine tracker that puts you in control of your health journey.
We value your privacy. Your journal entries are just yours, only accessible with your device.
Consult with your doctor if you are experiencing any symptoms of an illness.
This software is not a replacement of a medical treatment. It is intended for informational purposes only and comes with no warranty.
You can read the terms of use and privacy policy here:
http://adamcziko.com/migraine-tracker-privacy-policy-and-terms-of-use/

The subscription is automatically renewed after each subscription period.
Want to get to know more about your current subscription, or you want to cancel it?
You can get all the information by visiting the following page:
https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039

NiCE Employee Engagement Manager (EEM) empowers you, the frontline agent, to self-manage your schedule and activities in the contact center with exceptional visibility, flexibility and control. Download the NiCE EEM app to experience the following benefits:
Self-Service Scheduling, 24/7 
Use the NiCE EEM mobile app as a personal assistant for your contact center scheduling needs. View your hours and shifts with precision, anytime and anywhere, whether in the contact center or "on the go" outside.
Greater Schedule Control 
Adjust your schedule with outstanding responsiveness and control, using EEM's in-app approval flow. No more long wait times and email exchanges with supervisors or administrators to get your schedule change requests reviewed and approved. Get it done quickly! 
Better Work-Life Balance 
NiCE EEM can offer schedule change opportunities based on your own preferences. In EEM, you can add extra hours to your schedule, swap or trade shifts during the day and into the future; or you can give up hours/shifts on short notice. Take advantage of schedule change opportunities that are optimized for you! (Note: schedule change opportunities are made available based on the staffing operation's specific processes and needs at the subject time.)
Terms of Use:
https://eemmobileapps.nicewfm.com/privacy-doc/EEM App TOU clean.html
NOTICE: If you are not sure of your contact center granting the use of NiCE EEM, please first check with an administrator at your organization that NiCE EEM has been deployed in the contact center.

bluejetty:00029542:ios.summary:
HFG Entertainments proudly presents “ESCAPE ROOM: MYSTICAL TALES”, and invites you to join this adventure journey of a point-and-click game.
The mystical tales of the game's challenge await you; are you up for it? You are in the appropriat
bluejetty:00029542:ios.description:
HFG Entertainments proudly presents “ESCAPE ROOM: MYSTICAL TALES”, and invites you to join this adventure journey of a point-and-click game.
The mystical tales of the game's challenge await you; are you up for it? You are in the appropriate condition. Put yourself in an extreme circumstance from which you want to escape the room. Think outside the box and resolve hidden object games and mysteries behind you if you want to get through a difficult situation. Act wisely to locate the exit.
Try out your own skills! There are many enigmatic stages in the game, each with a number of exits. You need to use hints, Adventure puzzles, and the discovery of hidden rooms to get out of there. Enjoy an hour of brainteasers.
Each level has a unique set of puzzles and anime & realistic, stylized theme games, so you'll never get bored playing it. Our Mini-games have gorgeous interactive graphics that are colorful and adorned with visually appealing game-play elements. Make up your mind to enter a fun and logical game. Use observation, analysis, and logical thinking to get out of the enigmatic room.
Don't be hesitant to try our game if you love playing room escape games! Very amusing and smooth! We guarantee that playing with us will be an unforgettable experience! You must discover a way out of that place by looking for helpful hidden objects, using detective skills, and deciphering riddles and puzzles. Utilize your abilities to gather the necessary items in the fantasy world so that you can solve the puzzles and free yourself.
Start your mission and tackle complex mysteries involving hospitals, airplanes, trains, magic, theft, and various room escapes. It will be fascinating and fun. As you play different brain teasers, try to solve the clues to find the key, steal the artifacts, and find the exit door. Solve the puzzle-adventure games, and take part in a fantastic escape room experience.
Game features:
*Discover all the 50 levels of secrets!
*Daily rewards are available for free coins.
*Step by step hints features available
*Suitable for all gender age groups
*Exciting search for hidden objects
*Experience with unique riddles & puzzles
*Save your progress so you can play on multiple devices!
Available in 25 languages---- (English, Arabic, Catalan, Chinese (simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Czech, Danish, Dutch, French, Finnish, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Malay, Polish, Portuguese(Brazil), Portuguese(Portugal), Romanian, Russian, Slovak, Spanish, Swedish, Thai, Turkish, Vietnamese)

"With the Municipal Mobility Plan, the government implemented strategies that improve the quality of life and promote sustainable mobility in the City of Mérida.
Download the En Bici app to start pedaling today!
1. Open the app and find the closest En Bici bike on the map.
2. When you find your bike, unlock it by scanning the QR code above the rear wheel smart lock, or the QR code on the handlebar.
3. Once unlocked. Enjoy your trip on two wheels toward your destination!
4. Finish your trip by parking at any En Bici Station.
5. End your trip by following the instructions in your app 
6. Block the bike by manually blocking the lock. You will hear a ""click"".
7. Always lock the bikes inside an En Bici Station to avoid penalties.
Enjoy the rest of the day knowing that you have contributed to improving Mérida while you worked out and saved money!
Visit https://merida.gob.mx/movility/muevete-merida.php
Contact us at info@enbici.co"

bluejetty:00080353:ios.description:
The AR Drawing by Tayasui app is an invaluable tool for artists looking to trace and sketch various designs. It provides an efficient and user-friendly platform for creating drawing and sketch art. With its step-by-step drawing lessons and the ability to trace selected images using tracing paper under the camera, it's an excellent resource for learning and practicing the art of tracing. Transforming sketches into art is made easy by using AR Drawing by Tayasui app to trace images, whether it's cartoons, buildings, objects, or eyes, onto tracing paper.
Using this you may learn and practice drawing. Also make tracing an image easy. Just select an image from the app or gallery apply filter to create image traceable. The image will appear on screen with camera open. Place phone about 1feet above and look into the phone and draw on paper.
The user can adjust the thickness and style of their lines, as well as use the eraser tool to correct any mistakes. They can also add additional elements or details to their sketch if desired. Once the user has finished their sketch, they can save it or share it with others. The app may also have features such as filters or color adjustments to further enhance the finished sketch.

bluejetty:00024066:ios.description:
Drawing is one of the most popular pastimes for children. That's why we decided to support young artists and created an exclusive Draw & Play application. The adorable characters come to life as the child draws them. We've also added a whole category of cute monsters and musical instruments to make your little one even more interested! 
The app is designed by experts in preschool development to develop imagination, attention, and fine motor skills. It has an intuitive design, user-friendly interface, voice prompts, and animations – everything needed to let even the smallest kiddies play.
Now, in addition to their favorite characters, young users can color in kind monsters who like to jam. The new characters play musical instruments, which stimulates creative thinking and sparks interest in music. A variety of drawing tools and special designs create a supportive space for children to express their creativity. And the sound effects and the ability to play with the drawn characters will definitely attract the attention of children!
Draw & Play is:
• filled with a large selection of pictures and characters to draw
• bursting with new packs with monsters and musical instruments
• designed using a unique teaching method
• a tool to develop fine motor skills
• a lifesaver in keeping your child busy anytime, anywhere
“Draw & Play” is a smart choice, both for those who are just getting acquainted with the world of educational games, and for those with children who are already in kindergarten or preparing for it.
You gain partial access to app content in the free version. To gain full access, make an in-app purchase.

We are Bini Bambini – a company that has been developing children's educational games aimed at comprehensive child development for more than 10 years.
We are parents like you, who also once wondered where to start with early childhood education. With the expertise of educators, designers and developers, we have created apps that turn learning into a fun adventure.

bluejetty:00142653:ios.description:
TejTips brings you daily betting tips for Football, NBA and NHL, built on statistics, match analysis and AI-powered predictions.
WHAT YOU GET
• Free betting tips every day
• Football, NBA and NHL predictions
• AI-powered match analysis
• Detailed stats and form trends
• Ready-made accumulators with selected odds
• Community 1X2 votes on every match
TEJMENTOR – AI ACCUMULATOR GENERATOR
TejMentor builds accumulator suggestions for Football, NBA and NHL. It takes the matches analysed by TejTips, scores each one with its statistics (form, head-to-head, predictions) and picks the combination with the highest overall confidence for the odds range and dates you choose.
FREE AND PRO
Every match comes with a free tip. Extra PRO tips can be unlocked with coins or by watching an ad. TejTips PRO unlocks all PRO tips, all accumulators and TejMentor, with no ads.
PLAY RESPONSIBLY
TejTips provides information and analysis only. We do not accept bets and we cannot guarantee results – every bet involves risk. TejTips is intended for adults aged 18 or over. Never bet more than you can afford to lose. If betting stops being fun, contact a gambling support service in your country.
TEJTIPS PRO SUBSCRIPTION
• TejTips PRO is available as an auto-renewing monthly or yearly subscription. Prices are shown in the app and may vary by country.
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase.
• The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Renewal is charged within the 24 hours before the current period ends.
• You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings.
• If a free trial is offered, any unused part of it is forfeited when you buy a subscription.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://tejtips.com/privacy-policy-app
