bluejetty:00099415:ios.description:
Do you often find your iPhone running out of storage?
Optimize storage - simply tap to clean up storage.
Tidyfoto is an iPhone cleaner that helps you effortlessly free up space and keep your device running smoothly. Powered by AI, it cleans up cluttered photos and videos, compresses large videos, and intelligently categorizes your photo library.
Why Do So Many Users Trust Tidyfoto?
► Clean up automatically
No need to sort through your gallery — let the iPhone cleaner do the work for you. It automatically identifies the best photos, allowing you to clean up blurry and duplicate ones with just a few taps while keeping the very best photos that preserve your best memories.
► Compress videos
Running low on storage but don’t want to lose your favorite videos? Tidyfoto lets you compress large video files without noticeable quality loss, helping you save valuable space while keeping every special moment perfectly intact.
► AI Smart Photo Organizer
- No extra effort! AI automatically identifies and categorizes your photos, making it easy to find photos of people, pets, clothing, landscapes, food, and more. No need for manual tagging, category management has never been so easy.
- We've captured every city you've visited. Categorizing photos based on their location makes it easy to revisit your travel memories.
► Easy storage management
- Easy to use: With our intuitive interface, you can easily free up space manually or with AI assistance.
- Performance optimization: Improve your iPhone's speed and responsiveness with Tidyfoto. Our advanced AI technology frees up gigabytes of storage in seconds.
- Secure and Private: Your personal data is safe with us. Tidyfoto does not store your personal information.
Decluttering your phone has never been this simple! With Tidyfoto, you can enjoy a smooth, efficient, and effortless cleanup that saves time and keeps your device organized. Download Tidyfoto today and enjoy a cleaner, faster, and perfectly organized iPhone!
Subscription service conditions:
- The price will be differed from country to country according to the Price Matrix.
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Privacy Policy: https://www.tinymobikit.com/tidyfoto/Privacy_Policy.html
Terms of Service: https://www.tinymobikit.com/tidyfoto/Terms_of_Service.html 
If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us at ubfeedback2025@outlook.com

1. Happy Anniversary

5. Anniversary Quotes & Messages

bluejetty:00166153:ios.summary:

Features
View the l
bluejetty:00166153:ios.description:
Find My lets you view the location of your Apple devices, locate items you’ve attached AirTag to, keep track of Find My network accessories, and share your location with friends and family in a single, easy-to-use app.
Features
View the location of your iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Mac, AirPods, devices in your Family Sharing group, AirTag, or Find My network accessories on a map, and get directions to their locations in Apple Maps.
When you can’t find your nearby device, AirTag, or Find My network accessory, play a sound to pinpoint its location. Get the distance and direction to your AirTag or AirPods Pro 2 with Precision Finding.
Keep track of personal items with AirTag and Find My network accessories and share these items with up to five other people. Everyone in the group can use Precision Finding to pinpoint the location of a shared AirTag when nearby.
If your missing device, AirTag, or compatible third-party accessory isn’t nearby, the Find My app can still help you track it down using the Find My network. It’s all anonymous and encrypted to protect everyone’s privacy.
If you lose an item, you can temporarily share its location with others — including airlines — to help you find it. Simply share item location in the Find My app. Sharing automatically stops when you are reunited with your item and expires after seven days. Share Item Location recipients can open shared links directly in the Find My app to play sound and, on supported devices, use Precision Finding to location lost items when nearby.
Put your Apple devices in lost mode to lock the screen and display a message, or erase them remotely to protect your data. AirTag and Find My network accessories can also display your contact information to anyone who finds them.
Use the People tab to share location with friends and family so you can keep in touch, coordinate, or know when a family member has arrived home safely. You now have a new option to share location for a custom duration — either for a number of minutes, hours, or days — or set a date and time for when sharing will stop. This makes it easy to share location while attending an event, or for a long weekend getaway. You can also pause location sharing until the end of the day for specific people, so you can shop for an anniversary present or show up for a surprise party without spoiling the reveal.
If you’re on an adventure without cell service or Wi‑Fi, you can use Find My on iPhone 14 or later to share your location over satellite.
On Apple Watch, a new unified Find My app replaces the Find Devices, Find Items, and Find People apps. The new Apple Watch app’s map-centric user interface makes it even easier to locate friends and family, devices, and items. The Find My app offers access to key actions, including getting directions, finding devices and items when nearby, prompting a device to play a sound, or viewing contact information. You can now also use Precision Finding in the Find My app to help locate your paired iPhone or AirTag (2nd generation).
Some features are not available in all countries or regions.

bluejetty:00083897:ios.name: Bible Solitaire - Daily Pray
bluejetty:00083897:ios.summary: In today’s digital world, Bible Solitaire - Daily Pray stands out as a unique and creative game, offering believers a spiritually enriching experience. By combining the timeless wisdom of the Bible with the beloved game of Solitaire, it cre
bluejetty:00083897:ios.description:
In today’s digital world, Bible Solitaire - Daily Pray stands out as a unique and creative game, offering believers a spiritually enriching experience. By combining the timeless wisdom of the Bible with the beloved game of Solitaire, it creates a space not only for relaxation and entertainment but also for strengthening faith and fostering prayer.
Bible Solitaire helps players navigate the busyness of life and find peaceful moments of reflection. Each game session becomes an opportunity to connect with God, with every card flip and move serving as a way to practice and deepen faith. Players enjoy the excitement of the game while feeling inspired, comforted, and uplifted by biblical teachings.
How to Play:
- Tap or drag cards onto a card of a different color with a higher number.
- Move cards from A to K onto the Foundation piles.
- Complete the hand by collecting all four suits.
- Kings can be placed in empty columns, but no other cards can go there.
- Click the Deck to discover more moves.
Game Features:
- Daily Prayer: The game includes daily prayers, allowing players to dedicate their wins and joys to God while seeking His help.
- Track Mood: Players can record their moods and reflections, expressing both joys and struggles in life.
- Bible Revisiting: The Bible 365 allows players to read the Bible daily and check in on the calendar.
- Postcards to God: Players can send postcards to God, expressing praise and gratitude.
- Daily Quiz: Players can answer three questions about God each day to receive His blessings.
- Hint Feature: The Hint feature offers not just game tips but biblical wisdom and guidance to help players overcome challenges.
- Undo Feature: The Undo button allows players to reset and make new choices when they make a mistake, giving them a fresh start.
In essence, Bible Solitaire is not just a game—it’s a spiritual journey filled with hope, love, and faith. It invites players to find peace and purpose as they engage in a meaningful experience of devotion and prayer through the game’s cards.

bluejetty:00166652:ios.name: Border Wars: Army Games RTS
bluejetty:00166652:ios.summary: Commander, you are needed to take control of your soldiers in the new army games. You are able to command troops ranging from pistol wielding units to snipers, tanks, machinegun jeeps and artillery. Inspired from some of the best military g
bluejetty:00166652:ios.description:
Commander, you are needed to take control of your soldiers in the new army games. You are able to command troops ranging from pistol wielding units to snipers, tanks, machinegun jeeps and artillery. Inspired from some of the best military games on mobile which will challenge your skills in battle simulator.
Players of battle simulator and military games will love the trench warfare like style of each mission with warpips like strategy games. You can deploy your troops like trench battles but also manage money like classic RTS games. The gameplay is styled to play like ww2 and ww3 strategy games with trench warfare like mechanics.
Fight on the borders of your country in a battle simulator of infantry units. Or command missions in the forests and fields of your country with trench defense. You must protect your home from the enemy in battles that take place in the harsh weather of the desert and finally you must command your troops in tank games where large tank battles take place in the city.
The goal of each mission in the military games is to destroy the enemy base or survive until reinforcements arrive. To win you will need to manage your money carefully and perform strategic advancement to win all the campaign missions. Mini warriors can be called to the battlefield by pressing their button from the soldier panel. Money is earned by killing enemy soldiers. Make careful use of tanks and artillery to win the battlefield. At the end you will have to fight the enemy general and defeat him by destroying the boss tank.
A lot of work and effort was put in developing this project so that it can be enjoyed and played like classic ww2 games and modern ww3 games combined. The gameplay of both these military games combined makes this a fun and one of the more challenging campaign games. I hope you will enjoy playing this and if you do please leave feedback here as it encourages me to add even more campaign missions to the game.

Buckle up and get ready for an epic battle, because they are getting closer and hungrier! Brace yourself for an impact! Hope you’ve built your train right and can repel all those zombies. Use the best strategy to protect survivors from mutant hordes: rack that brain of yours or it will become someone’s dinner.

Level up your heroes, place them accordingly and choose the best units for the upcoming battle! Remember: each of them has their own unique ability, which can turn the tide of the battle in one single tap. Keep zombies on their toes. Don’t play favorites – everyone in such a diverse cast counts as a stepping stone to victory! There’s plenty of coins to collect and much more money to earn while you fight! - Endless fun! Take on waves of zombies one after the other!
- Unlock and discover new epic monsters! From small and fast zombies to huge boss fights with angry mutants!
- Collect and upgrade all the heroes on your team! Upgrade their unique stats and skills!
- Raise your tower! Create an unstoppable fortress!
- Manage your base and grow your income!
- Combine your units abilities for maximum destruction on the battlefield!
- Take the command in your hands or sit idle with auto-battle commands!
Ready to take on the challenge? Do not waste your time, download and play!

bluejetty:00133157:ios.description:
Marvel HQ is the ultimate destination for kids ages 3-8 to explore the Marvel Universe, offering access to a wide range of comics, videos, activities, and more.
Marvel HQ is a treasure trove of heroic content. This massive app offers a vast array of activities, videos, comics, and creative tools. Whether coding with Hulk, watching thrilling episodes of Spidey and His Amazing Friends, reading Marvel stories, or revealing and encouraging artistic talents. Kids can even take care of, play with, and nurture their very own Groot. There's always something new to discover.
UNLOCK A WORLD OF LEARNING with Marvel HQ:
Race with Spidey and His Amazing Friends, tackle coding challenges with Hulk, and navigate asteroid fields with Rocket and Groot to enhance PROBLEM-SOLVING and CRITICAL THINKING skills.
Explore fascinating facts about your favorite heroes and villains, sharpening your child's COGNITION, KNOWLEDGE and MEMORY.
Dive into digital comics and learn-to-read Super Hero stories with actor support, boosting literacy and promoting independent READING.
Encourage creativity by coloring Marvel characters and mastering drawing skills with our powerful tools and instructional videos, fostering ARTISTIC DEVELOPMENT and self-expression.
FEATURES 
• Safe and age-appropriate 
• Designed responsibly to let your child enjoy screen time while developing healthy digital habits at a young age 
• FTC Approved COPPA Safe Harbor Certification by Privo.
• Play pre-downloaded content offline without wifi or internet 
• Regular updates with new content 
• Apple Family Sharing for easy subscription sharing with other family members 
• No in-app purchases for subscribers
SUPPORT 
For any questions or assistance, please reach out to us at support@storytoys.com
ABOUT STORYTOYS: Our mission is to bring the world's most popular characters, worlds, and stories to life for children. We make apps for kids that engage them in well-rounded activities designed to help them learn, play, and grow. Parents can enjoy peace of mind knowing their kids are learning and having fun at the same time.
PRIVACY & TERMS 
StoryToys takes children's privacy seriously and ensures that its apps comply with privacy laws, including the Child Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA). If you would like to learn more about the information we collect and how we use it, please visit our privacy policy at https://storytoys.com/privacy. 
Read our terms of use here: https://storytoys.com/terms.
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS 
This app contains sample content that is free to play. However, LOTS MORE fun and entertaining games and activities are available if you purchase a monthly or yearly subscription. While you are subscribed you can play with EVERYTHING. We regularly add new stuff, so subscribed users will enjoy ever-expanding play opportunities.
• Subscriptions are billed monthly or annually according to the rate of the selected subscription plan. 
• You can change your mind at any point. Cancelling can be done through your iTunes settings. 
• Your subscription will auto-renew at the cost of the chosen package unless you cancel it 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. Subscription fees are charged to your iTunes account. 
• After purchase, you can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings. 
• When you purchase a subscription, you forfeit any unused portion of a free trial period. 
• You can use your subscription on any device registered with the same Apple ID that you subscribed from.

bluejetty:00087059:ios.description:
This is your official guide to Mt Washington Alpine Resort, all at your fingertips. 
• See which runs are groomed and which closed. Locate yourself on the trail map — not a hard-to-read GPS map.†
• Share your location on the mountain with friends, and see your friends' locations on the trail map.†
• Record your runs and log vertical feet and distance. If you have an Apple Watch, record your runs as a workout and see your workout in the Health app. Display your tracks and replay your runs on the trail map. Email images to friends, post them to social media, or view them in Google Earth. Store your logs on iCloud and view them on all your devices. Send your logs to a leaderboard and compare vertical and distance with others at the resort.†
• Find up-to-date information about the mountain, including snow conditions, weather, and webcam images.
• Get up-to-the-minute lift status information.
• Quickly find information about lessons and other programs and amenities.
• Easily locate and contact key places at the resort with the built in directory.
• Learn about events from the events calendar.
• Get the latest news via social media posts.
† Location and Logging services require a GPS-equipped device. Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

The routine's simple interface, complete with video and timer, allows you to easily follow along and understand each exercise.

FOX 17 West Michigan News gives you up-to-the-minute local news, breaking news alerts, 24/7 live streaming video, accurate weather forecasts, severe weather updates, and in-depth investigations from the local news station you know and trust.
Connect to your community through our local news app. We're celebrating what makes our community great, giving you context to understand local issues and sharing solutions to help you solve problems.
LOCAL NEWS:
• Get up-to-the-minute breaking news alerts and stories.
• Tap 'Top News' to read the most important news of the day as curated by our local news teams.
• Tap 'Most Recent' to read the news stories published most recently.
• Get full support for Dark Mode and Light Mode based on your device preference.
LOCAL VIDEO:
• Watch our 24/7 live streaming news channel.
• Watch video on demand clips from recent newscasts.
• You're in control over what you want to watch and when.
LOCAL WEATHER:
• Get daily video weather updates from your trusted local weather team.
• Stay up to date with hourly and daily weather forecasts.
• View interactive weather radar to help you track rain, snow and storms.
• Get weather conditions and forecasts for your location.
We're committed to continually improving your experience in our app. Please let us know how we're doing by leaving a review in the App Store.
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00020007:android.description:
⭐ Stickman Combat Legend is the simplest stickman fighting game!!! 
This battle game will allow you to become one of the heroes of the Superhero team, fighting villains and protecting the entire planet. Enter the arena and battle for your life. If you enjoy playing games, this is the game for you because of its quick handling and wonderful features.
Players may select their Stickman Super Heroes, who they love most, upgrade their ultimate power as much as possible, compete in the tournament of all maps, and rise to the top of the global standings.
👉 FEATURES
🤖 Single-player mode: Engage in infinite fights against various opponents across several maps.
🤖 Versus mode: The game will be more enjoyable with two players. Even you may play with a friend while simply utilizing one device.
🤖 Tournament mode: The best group of players will compete in a tournament to determine the last winner.
🤖 Simple control with a single joystick - Select the level of play mode: easy, normal, hard & super hard.
🤖 A variety of weapons to pick from, such as a rifle, infinity glove, even ice cream...
🤖 Minimalistic visuals provide a delightful experience.
👉 HOW TO PLAY
⚔️ All you have to do is drag and drop your weapon to move about, then shoot, fire, or hurl it to eliminate the enemy. 
⚔️ Winning combat earns you coins, which you may use to unlock more and more skills & weapons for your Stickman Hero.
⚔️ Be careful! If your Stickman falls into the water, you will be sent to the "game over" screen, returned to the home screen, and the level will be restarted from the beginning.
Download Stickman Combat Legend right NOW to enjoy the finest shadow fight of stick man!!!

bluejetty:00062405:ios.name: Lexulous Word Game Lite
bluejetty:00062405:ios.summary:

Played on 15 x 15 board, Lexulous is an uber new way to learn wonderful words while giving yourself a chance to test your
bluejetty:00062405:ios.description:
Enjoy your favorite word game with cool new features! Download Lexulous and experience word mania like never before!
Played on 15 x 15 board, Lexulous is an uber new way to learn wonderful words while giving yourself a chance to test your vocabulary.
Lexulous is all about making words from the letter tiles. Each player has to create a word in their respective turn. It’s very simple:
◆ Pick up suitable letters from your tile rack of 8 tiles. 
◆ Place them wisely on the board to form words that score the highest points. 
◆ Check the word validity from the in-built Dictionary. 
◆ Click on Play to submit your move! And there’s your score!
Utilize four premium squares to score double or triple points. Even if you don’t use them ensure you block out your opponent’s! 
And yes, if you use all 8 letters from your rack in one turn you get 50 bonus points!
The game comes with a unique Analyzer mode. After you finish a game, the AI tells you which were the top scoring words that you missed out. This helps you prepare well for your upcoming word wars!
◆ NEWBIES ◆ Quick start your word game journey by practicing in ‘Offline’ mode:
◆ Set your opponent. (Solitaire, Pass n Play, Computer)
◆ Select Game level. (If playing against the AI opponent)
◆ Set your preferred game dictionary (US, UK, Italian, French).
◆ Start Playing!
◆ Improve your skills and then match players across the world!
Lexulous teases your brain and gives you a chance to test your word knowledge. Each turn is like a new word puzzle.
Invite and play with your friends and loved ones! Bond with your folks over a game of words. Beat ace word players. All you need is a zeal to win and notch up your level gradually. 
What are the latest features at Lexulous?
◆ Introducing the exclusive ‘Live’ mode. We handpick the best opponents across the world for you. Each player has only 5 minutes to play all their turns.
◆ Connect with both your Facebook account and Lexulous account across any device easily. Sync all your games within one app. Download, Sign In and start playing.
◆ In-game dictionary to help you out with instant definitions.
◆ Now supports four languages dictionary: UK English, US English, French, Italian.
◆ Swap and Shuffle the letters in tile rack.
◆ Instantly uploads average statistics with the Global Ranking. Get a detailed report on your scores, number of Bingo words played and many more.
◆ Chat with fellow gamers and never stop the interesting convo developing in between. You may also share images! Let the bonding grow.
◆ Invite and share Lexulous across every platform. Refer via email, Facebook, WhatsApp, Twitter and many more in your device with just one click!
◆ Smart tile feature to place your letters swiftly with just a touch.
◆ Analyze your finished game. Let your mistakes become pillars of success.
Go Pro and become our elite member. Get exclusive features and benefits with our Pro subscription:
◆ Ads-free experience.
◆ Priority support access.
◆ Full analysis of games.
◆ No quitter badge.
Play and be a socially active gamer. Let the world know who is the ultimate champion of words!

=================

bluejetty:00046123:ios.description:
Point Savvy keeps score on game night so everyone can keep playing.
FIVE CROWNS, DONE RIGHT
• See who's winning at a glance: this round's wild card, the standings and how far behind each player is.
• Enter scores on big, calculator-style keys, with "Went out" and a card counter that adds up the hand.
• Prefer the classic score grid? It's one switch away.
• The winner is crowned automatically after the Kings round.
SPADES, FULLY SCORED
• Bids, tricks, bags and nil handled for two teams.
• Play to 250, 300 or 500.
SEVERAL GAMES AT ONCE
• Start a new game whenever you like. Every game in progress waits on Play to resume or cancel.
EVERY GAME REMEMBERED
• History of every finished game, a leader board, and CSV export.
EASY ON EVERY EYE
• High-contrast colors, large tap targets, your own text size, and VoiceOver support.
• Optional "read scores aloud" after every round.
• Keeps the screen awake during a game.
POINT SAVVY PRO (OPTIONAL, ONE-TIME)
• Player stats: wins, averages and best games.
• Share a results card with the group chat.
• Tips are welcome and keep Point Savvy ad-free.
Five Crowns is a trademark of PlayMonster LLC. Point Savvy is not affiliated with or endorsed by PlayMonster.

bluejetty:00060748:ios.developer: SKEELO EDITORA, PRODUTOS E SERVICOS DIGITAIS LTDA
bluejetty:00060748:ios.summary:
Já somos mais de 10 milhões de pessoas utilizando o Skoob para organizar suas leituras e ler cada vez mais.
O Skoob é um “Assistente literário” e uma “Rede social para leitores”.   Como Assistente Literário, o Skoob oferece dezenas de fer
bluejetty:00060748:ios.description:
Já somos mais de 10 milhões de pessoas utilizando o Skoob para organizar suas leituras e ler cada vez mais.
O Skoob é um “Assistente literário” e uma “Rede social para leitores”.   Como Assistente Literário, o Skoob oferece dezenas de ferramentas que organizam seus livros em uma estante virtual, assim, você saberá exatamente
quais os livros já leu, quer ler, está lendo, favoritos, desejados… etc. Além de funcionalidades para que você fique motivado em suas leituras, cumprindo metas, desafios, participando de ranking entre amigos… 
O Skoob também é a maior Rede Social para leitores em português, são mais de 10 milhões de pessoas escrevendo notas de leitura, fazendo avaliações, comentários e muitas recomendações. 
Algumas Funcionalidades: 
- Crie sua lista de leituras (lidos, estou lendo, quero ler, desejados, troco... etc) 
- Veja resenhas, avaliações e comente as atividades dos seus amigos. 
- Descubra e explore a lista de lançamentos das principais editoras. 
- Compartilhe notas e a progressão da sua leitura. 
- Encontre livros similares aos seus livros favoritos. 
- Crie uma meta de leitura para o ano.
- Barcode Scanner, para adicionar livros mais facilmente. 
- Descubra quanto tempo é necessário para terminar um livro 
- Desafios que incentivam a ler mais… 
ATENÇÃO: É importante lembrar que o Skoob NÃO é um leitor de Ebooks, com tantas funcionalidades é muito normal algumas pessoas pensarem assim. 
DIVIRTA-SE!! O Skoob é o melhor e mais completo aplicativo para quem deseja ler mais e organizar suas leituras.

NotePlan lets you manage everything in one
bluejetty:00126580:ios.description:
Having trouble planning your day, managing your to-do list, and organizing your notes? Always jumping between apps and losing track of what to do and where you put things?
Say hello to NotePlan!
NotePlan lets you manage everything in one place: your tasks, notes, and calendar.
Perfect for project managers, designers, researchers, writers, students, or anyone who wants to be organized and efficient.
QUICKLY PLAN YOUR DAY WITH MARKDOWN
• Plan your day by seeing your calendar, notes, and tasks in a single view
• Create tasks and notes quickly with Markdown
• Add #tags to organize tasks and notes
• Use @mentions to find people
• Reschedule to-do items easily
• Create flexible recurring tasks
• Work faster with autocomplete
BUILD YOUR NETWORK OF NOTES
• Create your own network of notes
• Organize any way you want to: from simple folders over P.A.R.A. to a Zettelkasten system
• Bi-directional notes: link your calendar and your notes in any direction, automatically
• Cross-reference and link notes easily
STAY ON TOP OF THINGS WITH REVIEW
• Search all tasks and notes, instantly
• See all open tasks with the click of a button
• Get a list of overdue to-do items
• See upcoming tasks at a glance
• Create custom filters with your own queries using status, #tags, @mentions, or even text
SEAMLESS INTEGRATION WITH YOUR CALENDAR
• Create events and reminders right in NotePlan
• Support for iCloud, Google, and Exchange calendars
• Time-block tasks on your calendar simply by typing
AVAILABLE ON MAC, IPHONE & IPAD
• Sync everything between your Apple devices
• Use any sync method you like: CloudKit or iCloud Drive
• A single subscription for all your devices
OPEN, PRIVATE & FAST
• All your notes are stored in plaintext so you're never locked in
• Your information is private and cannot be accessed
• Enjoy lightning speed thanks to local files and native apps
ANY THEME YOU WANT
• Choose from a variety of built-in themes
• Work with light or dark versions
• Create your own custom theme
SHORTCUTS FOR MAXIMUM SPEED
• Extended Markdown syntax support with customization options
• Move around without ever leaving the keyboard
• Find everything with the Global Command Bar
NotePlan is developed independently and prioritizes user features and requests. We have long-term roadmaps and listen to customers to improve the apps.
- - - - -
Price may vary by location. Subscriptions will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account. Your subscription will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. After purchase, manage your subscriptions in App Store Account Settings.

bluejetty:00159543:ios.description:
MAMMA-MIYA: The Empathetic LifeOS for Moms
You’re doing it all — but it never really feels done.
Your mind is full, your day is packed, and you barely have time to breathe.
MAMMA-MIYA is the all-in-one planning and well-being app built from thousands of women’s lived experiences — designed to calm the chaos, lighten your mental load, and help you reconnect with yourself.
Because life isn’t meant to be a blur.
MAMMA-MIYA helps you clear the clutter, find your rhythm, and live days that feel as full and rich as the years they become — so you can feel peace and purpose every day, as both a mother and a woman.
What Makes MAMMA-MIYA Different?
My Day — Ease overwhelm with beautifully organized daily views for tasks, routines, and events. Prioritize your top 3 depending on what each day feels like — and check them off for that satisfying sense of accomplishment.
Brain Dump — Free your mind by offloading floating thoughts, lists, to-dos, and photos in one safe space. Schedule them into your calendar when you’re ready.
Hats — Balance your many roles with purpose by tagging tasks and events as mom, partner, professional, friend, and more. See insights into where your time and mind-space really go — and which “hat” you might be missing.
Commons — Discover ready-to-use routines and lists from other moms — practical, proven, and made for real life.
Auto-Rescheduler — Plans change? We’ve got you. MAMMA-MIYA automatically moves incomplete tasks forward — or lets you delegate and reschedule with ease.
Self-Care Section — Nurture yourself with 100+ personalized, bite-sized ideas, a daily gratitude journal, and gentle breathing reminders. Because caring for yourself is part of caring for everyone else.
Sync & Insights — Connect seamlessly with Apple HealthKit to integrate your period, fitness, sleep, and even weather data — helping you plan around your body and energy, not just your calendar.
AI Miya (Your Evolving Co-Pilot) — Right now, she helps you with simple things like meal plans, family budgets, kid activities, and gift ideas. But she’s learning from every mom who uses her — evolving toward the smart, empathetic co-pilot designed to truly understand and support your daily life.
Loved by Moms in 127 Countries
“When life is a hurricane, MAMMA-MIYA helps me feel confident in the chaos.”
— Steph H., USA
“I’ve spent years trying every planner — paper, Google, ToDoist. I’m now in love!”
— Rachel C., Australia
“Essential for prioritizing my time and energy.”
— Bindu, India
Featured In
Economic Times, Moneycontrol, Tennessee Tribune, Financial Express, YourStory, and FemTech India
Selected for Apple Entrepreneurship Camp 2020
Join thousands of moms finding calm, clarity, and confidence — every day — through MAMMA-MIYA.
Download now and start thriving, not just surviving.

This is not a simple habit tracker.
It’s a structured program designed to reset your routines, build willpower, and help you stay consistent, even when motivation fades.

This isn’t passive self-help.
It’s a discipline system.
Start your 66-day challenge today.

You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew from your iTunes Account settings. Your iTunes Account will be charged for renewal when the purchase is confirmed.

bluejetty:00182815:ios.description:
Completely free puzzle game without any ads or in-app purchases! A true adventure for you to enjoy!
Step into the Unknown in this 3D Point-and-Click Adventure!
A desperate letter drops into your mailbox from an expedition camp in Egypt. The sender, Leopold, brings dire news: your brother, Harley, has vanished. 
While searching for your missing colleague William, Harley unearthed an uncharted, ancient pyramid. Armed with a strange relic, he stepped inside to finish what William started—and never came back. The rest of the expedition team is paralyzed by fear and blocked by ancient, deadly contraptions. No one dares to go further. They need the expert. They need you, Professor Scartaris.
You travel to Egypt, secure the relic key from the camp, and step into the suffocating darkness of the tomb. But you quickly realize this is no ordinary resting place. There is no pharaoh. There are no grand inscriptions. Whoever built this place wasn't honoring the dead; they were hiding something. And as you delve deeper, following the trail of frantic notes Harley left behind, a chilling realization sets in: you are not alone in here.
Will you find him? You must descend deeper into the pyramid, navigate its labyrinth of rooms, and solve its ancient mystery. What was William warning him about? What did Harley unleash? 
This game serves as the thrilling introduction to the Legacy series—a collection of games heavily focused on atmospheric exploration, compelling narratives, and brain-teasing puzzles.
Key Features:
• Intricate Puzzles & Riddles: Face a massive variety of challenges, from deciphering ancient symbols and manipulating light to repairing complex mechanical contraptions designed to keep intruders out.
• Immersive 3D World: Explore a beautifully rendered, fully 3D environment. Inspect ancient relics up close, look around every corner, and discover hidden compartments.
• A Gripping Mystery: Piece together the tragic story of Harley, William, and the pyramid's true purpose by finding discarded letters and environmental clues. 
• Built-in Hint System: Never stay stuck for long. If an ancient riddle is proving too difficult, the integrated hint system will gently guide you in the right direction. 
Join the Community!
Follow the development of the next title here: 
https://www.instagram.com/nosignalproductionss/

This game serves as the thrilling introduction to the Legacy series—a collection of games heavily focused on atmospheric exploration, compelling narratives, and brain-teasing puzzles.

Key Features:

• Intricate Puzzles & Riddles: Face a massive variety of challenges, from deciphering ancient symbols and manipulating light to repairing complex mechanical contraptions designed to keep intruders out.
• Immersive 3D World: Explore a beautifully rendered, fully 3D environment. Inspect ancient relics up close, look around every corner, and discover hidden compartments.
• A Gripping Mystery: Piece together the tragic story of Harley, William, and the pyramid's true purpose by finding discarded letters and environmental clues. 
• Built-in Hint System: Never stay stuck for long. If an ancient riddle is proving too difficult, the integrated hint system will gently guide you in the right direction.

bluejetty:00127275:ios.description:
SmartSafe is the ultimate solution for safeguarding your private photos and videos, keeping them hidden from prying eyes. 
When it comes to personal privacy, there's no room for compromise—just 100% proven protection. 
Plus, with SmartSafe's "free up space" feature, you can securely store your media while freeing up valuable space on your device. 
Download now and you'll get advanced security features seamlessly integrated into a sleek and sophisticated design. 
Security and access to the application: 
- Face/Touch ID 
- 4 or 6 digits PIN 
- Dot Lock passcode 
- Album lock 
Import and export options: 
- Import from Camera Roll 
- WiFi transfer 
- AirDrop 
- Built-in photo/video camera 
- Camera on Force touch 
- Save photos into SmartSafe from other apps 
Recovery and backup: 
- Restore access to the application 
- Reset passcode for protected albums 
- Backup up to 100GB (see plans) 
- Sync content between all your devices 
File management: 
- Free up space on your device 
- Adjustable photo grid 
- Remove after import from CameraRoll 
- Recycle bin. Restore if deleted by accident 
- Playback of mov, mp4, m4v 
- Photo viewer of png, tiff, tif, jpeg, jpg, gif, bmp, heic 
- Fully support of Live Photos format 
Photo and video viewer: 
- Multiple slideshow intervals 
- Repeat and shuffle 
- Swipe down to exit photo viewer 
- Gorgeous slideshow transitions 
Appearance: 
- Album covers 
- Home screen icons 
- Colored themes 
Subscription terms: 
Membership subscription unlocks all features to manage your personal content within the application. 
Information about the auto-renewable nature of the subscription: 
- Length of subscriptions: 1 month or 1 year with 7-day trial 
- Price of subscription depends on backup plan and starts from: one month - $3.99 US dollars, one year - $29.99 US dollars 
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase 
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the period 
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, depending on the chosen plan 
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase 
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable 
- You can cancel your subscription via this url: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039 
Privacy policy: https://mprapps.com/privacy.html 
Term of use: https://mprapps.com/smartsafe_tos.html

bluejetty:00073166:ios.summary: Amazon Shopping offers app-only benefits to help make shopping on Amazon faster and easier. Browse, view product details, read reviews, and purchase millions of products. Amazon delivers to 100+ countries in as quickly as 3-5 days. Whether
bluejetty:00073166:ios.description:
Amazon Shopping offers app-only benefits to help make shopping on Amazon faster and easier. Browse, view product details, read reviews, and purchase millions of products. Amazon delivers to 100+ countries in as quickly as 3-5 days. Whether you’re buying gifts, reading reviews, tracking orders, scanning products, or just shopping, the Amazon Shopping app offers more benefits than shopping on Amazon via your desktop. 
Never miss a delivery
Get real-time tracking and delivery notifications so you know where your package is and when it arrives. 
Know exactly what you’re purchasing
Full 360° product view lets you see items from every angle. “View in you room” makes sure it fits by using your phone’s camera and VR so you can see it in your space. 
We’ll notify you when items go on sale
Just tap the heart icon to save items to Your Lists and we’ll alert you of price drops so you don’t miss a deal. 
Never forget your password
Save time by staying securely signed in. If you prefer to sign out, use facial or fingerprint identification to sign back in. 
Connect with us when it works best for you
Live chat support is open 24 hours, 7 days a week. Once you’ve started a chat, it stays that way for 24 hours so you don’t have to start your support session from the beginning. 
We’ll find that item for you
Not sure of an item’s brand or where to but it? Just tap the scan icon in the search bar, take a picture of the item or its barcode, and we’ll find it for you. 
In order to provide a rich experience and enable features such as voice shopping, notifications, visual search, customer reviews, and authentication this app may request permission to access contacts, camera, microphone, notification, touch id, photos and Bluetooth.
Amazon Shopping is available in English, Spanish, German, and Simplified Chinese. In addition to International Shopping, you can change your settings in this single app to shop Amazon.ca, Amazon.co.uk, Amazon.de, Amazon.fr, Amazon.com, Amazon.it, Amazon.es, Amazon.cn, Amazon.co.jp or Amazon.in.
For customers located within the European Union, United Kingdom or Brazil: By using this app, you agree to Amazon’s Conditions of Use applicable for your country. Please also see the applicable Privacy Notice, Cookies Notice and Interest-Based Ads Notice for your country. Links to these terms and notices can be found in the footer of your local Amazon homepage.
For all other customers: By using this app, you agree to the applicable Amazon Conditions of Use (e.g. www.amazon.com/conditionsofuse) and Privacy Notice (e.g. www.amazon.com/privacy) for your country. Links to these terms and notices can be found in the footer of your local Amazon homepage.
If your device supports TrueDepth technology, the app will use your device camera to detect your facial movements only while using certain features such as virtually try-on products like sunglasses. All information processed using this technology remains on your device and is not otherwise stored, processed or shared by Amazon.

bluejetty:00023482:ios.description:
Loyal Transportation is a transportation app booking service that enables you to get transport or airport transfer at your finger tips. Whether you travel anywhere in the Niagara region, Loyal Transportation is at your service. Book your first ride today!
The application works in St. Catharines (st kitts), Welland, Niagara Falls, Thorold, Ridgeway, Fort Erie, Stevensville, Chippawa, Port Dalhousie, Port Colborne, AS WELL AS in New Smyrna Beach and Daytona Beach, Florida. Hamilton, Toronto, Buffalo, Orlando, Daytona Beach airports are also covered when you book a Loyal T
How Loyal Transportation app works
- Simply confirm your pickup and destination point
- Get driver's car and vehicle information
- Tap to request a ride
- Track your travel progress in real-time on your way.
- Relax and enjoy your ride
Loyal Transportation: high technology
Once you have requested your ride or airport transfer, you can check the distance between you and your car driver, as well as your movements to the destination point on the map.
Loyal Transportation: safety
All our drivers are certified and have permits to take rides in both Canada and the US. We are focused on providing best-in-class transport in Niagara region to all our clients.
Loyal Transportation: other benefits:
- best transfer service in the US/Canada
- the possibility to estimate your rides
- quick car service - our smart algorithm always assigns the closest driver to pick you up, which saves a lot of time.
Loyal Transportation: advantages:
- You know the price of the trip before you book a vehicle. No surprises!
- Personalized service.
- Our drivers get excellent training.
- A wide fleet available in Niagara area.

bluejetty:00153723:ios.description:
Wild Hive is a bee colony roguelite driven by a ruthless honey market. Grow your hive, hatch a swarm of worker bees, and sell the honey they make on a realistic stock market. The honey quota climbs every year, and the year you miss it, your run is over.
You must send your bees foraging flowers in procedurally-generated locations, from the safety of Bluebell Woods to the rich, risky Alpine Meadows. Bee careful! They might not return home.
Then sell the harvest when the honey price peaks on the stock market.
Under the picture-book art is a deep engine builder. Silo upgrades, Royal Seals, and stock market bets stack into a colony that runs seamlessly, until the wasps come to tear it apart. Workers charge, mercenaries hold the line, and when the last defender falls they go for the Queen. If she dies, so does the colony. Wild Hive offers endless replayability.
Key Features
- Hatch, feed, and put to work a swarm of cute little bees (with huge personality!)
- Grow your hive and configure it with unlimited possible combinations.
- Buy Royal Seals in the shop once a year: permanent modifiers that bend the rules of your run.
- Trade shares in rival hives and lease out your own bees on the RAX (Royal Apiary Exchange).
- Settle 5 biomes, from fishing the Mountain Lake to catching apples in the Juicy Orchards.
- Unlimited levels and 7 tiers of difficulty to unlock. Each one rewrites the rules against you.
- 6 Queen bees to unlock and play as. Each Queen has unique attributes and powers.
- Or ignore the quota entirely in Endless mode and grow the biggest hive you can.
This app contains a free-to-play version of the game. There is an in-app purchase to unlock the full Wild Hive experience.

bluejetty:00188009:ios.description:
The Bank of San Francisco App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact Bank of San Francisco customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the Bank of San Francisco App, you must be enrolled as an Bank of San Francisco Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00184394:ios.description:
FreeCell brings you the fun, challenging, traditional FreeCell gameplay you know and love, with a beautiful, modern design.
Crisp, clear, and easy to read cards, simple and smooth animations, tap or drag controls, and subtle sounds make gameplay a joy in either portrait or landscape orientation. Select from a variety of relaxing backgrounds or upload your own from your photo album for a truly custom experience.
We kept FreeCell true to the spirit of the classic card game: the goal is to build up the four foundations by suit, in ascending order from Ace to King. Nearly all FreeCell deals are solvable, but they require patience, focus, and skill.
Perfect for card game players of all skill levels. Our easy-to-follow animated tutorial will have beginners winning in no time.
FreeCell by Brainium is the most user-friendly, visually stunning, and satisfying FreeCell solitaire you've ever played. 
Features:
• Classic FreeCell rules
• Portrait or landscape orientation
• Auto-play option speeds up obvious moves
• Crisp, beautiful, and easy to read cards
• Simple, intuitive game interface
• Single tap to place a card or drag and drop
• Auto-save and resume
• Smart hints show potentially useful moves
• Customizable backdrop
• Game Statistics to track progress
• Unlimited undos
• Fun and challenging achievements
• Auto Light and Dark Mode
• Show/Hide the battery and time status bar
• iPhone and iPad support
More Fun and Free Card and Logic Games from Brainium:
• Solitaire (Classic Patience or Klondike Format)
• Mahjong
• Sudoku
• Blackjack
• Spider Solitaire (Classic Spider and Spiderette)
• Pyramid Solitaire

bluejetty:00135134:ios.summary:

Longplay presents a beautiful view of the album artworks of the (ne
bluejetty:00135134:ios.description:
Do you have an album collection of dozens to thousands of albums? Does the next song of an album already start playing in your head when one finishes? Longplay is for you.
Longplay presents a beautiful view of the album artworks of the (near) complete albums in your music collection. It let's you rediscover forgotten favorites or just play the music you love, and explore it with various smart sort options:
- Orderliness: by artist, then by album
- Addiction: by amount of time spent listening
- Brightness: by the primary color of the album artwork
- Negligence: by the time it’s been since you’ve last listened to the album, weighted by the rating
- Recency: by date added
- Memory: by last played
- Stars: by the rating you’ve provided for each song
- Random: a new order, every time you tap it
You can organize your albums into collections, which sync across your devices.
Infinite album shuffle let's you stay in the flow, with smart shuffle depending on your current collection or sort order.
It comes with a home screen widget that displays the top albums by your nominated sort order. On the larger widget, tap an album to play it, on the smallest it doubles as a "Feeling lucky" button to start playback of one of them.
It supports CarPlay, Siri, Shortcuts, and Spotlight.t supports CarPlay, Siri, and Shortcuts.
It works well with Apple Music, music purchased from iTunes or synced manually.
---
Important: Longplay does not ship with any music included, it is instead a player for your music library - be it from Apple Music, iTunes or your synced music. It provides a filtered view of just the albums of which you have all or most of the songs, as well as your playlists; thus focusing on your album collection without any singles or albums where you only have very few songs.
---
Tap an item to play (or pause). Long tap for additional options, such as adding to your album queue or to a collection.
It works with libraries big and small, and besides regular albums it also handles compilation albums and playlists.
Comes with Shortcuts actions to play a random top album by a defined sort order, or a random album, optionally filtered by artist or genre. All of that with Longplay's logic that makes sure that it's an album for which you have all or most songs.
It is compatible with iPhone, iPad and iPod Touch. Fully VoiceOver accessible.

bluejetty:00041604:ios.name: Lushair: Scalp & Hair Tracker
bluejetty:00041604:ios.summary:
Lushair works with the Lushair One and Lushair Pro scanners. Take close-up photos of your scalp at home and see how your scalp and hair change from one scan to the next.
SCAN AT HOME
Connect to your scanner over its own Wi-Fi and follow th
bluejetty:00041604:ios.description:
Lushair works with the Lushair One and Lushair Pro scanners. Take close-up photos of your scalp at home and see how your scalp and hair change from one scan to the next.
SCAN AT HOME
Connect to your scanner over its own Wi-Fi and follow the guide on screen. You scan five spots across your scalp: the front hairline, both temples, the part line and the crown. A Lushair One scan takes about two minutes. A Lushair Pro scan uses three kinds of light and takes about four.
SEE YOUR READINGS
Each scan gives you a hair score and readings for your scalp, your hair and your follicles: oil, flakes, redness, hair thickness, follicle density, hairs per follicle and white hair. Every reading comes with the photos it was read from and a short explanation in plain words.
TRACK CHANGE
Progress shows your score and each reading over time, so you can see what moved since your last scan.
FOLLOW A ROUTINE
Lushair builds a care routine from your scans and from what you tell it: the products you use, what works for you, what does not, and anything you are allergic to. Check off your steps each day and get a reminder when your next scan is due.
ASK
Ask questions about your scans and get answers based on your own readings. Ask uses a third-party AI service, and Lushair asks for your permission before your first question.
YOUR ACCOUNT
Sign in with a code sent to your email or your phone. There is no password to remember. You can delete your account, your scans and your photos from inside the app at any time.
WHAT YOU NEED
A Lushair One or Lushair Pro scanner, sold separately at lushair.ai. Lushair runs on iPhone and iPad.
PLEASE NOTE
Lushair is for cosmetic tracking and general wellness. It does not diagnose, treat or prevent any disease or condition, and it is not medical advice. Talk to a doctor about hair loss or any scalp problem, and before you start, stop or change any medicine.
Questions or feedback: support@lushair.ai
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://business.lushair.ai/privacy

bluejetty:00043883:ios.description:

特点描述：
【私有化部署】：
用户可以将系统部署在企业自有服务器或我们官方云服务器上，确保用户信息、通信内容、文件等数据完全处于自主可控范围。
【无限网盘】：企业级网盘，收藏不限速，容量无限制，分类清晰明确；
【高强度加密】：
采用MTProto 2.0端到端加密方案，并在此基础上二次混淆加密，无惧黑客攻击，即便管理员也无法查看信息，确保通信安全。端到端的公钥加密方案，使用商用密认证高强度加密算法及国际加密算法。数据在传输过程中以密文形式存在，即便管理员也无法查看信息，确保通信安全。
【信息防泄漏，安全私密全面提升】：
提供远程销毁功能等多种防护模式，确保私密信息不外泄。
对话截图提醒：当用户对聊天内容进行截图时，系统会自动通知对方，让对方知道聊天内容被截图了。
群成员匿名聊天：群组中的成员可以匿名发表言论或参与讨论。这种功能通过隐藏成员的真实身份信息，提供了一层隐私保护，使得群成员的发言不与其个人身份直接关联。
副密码锁：两个密码登录都可以进入app，但是副密码看不到关键数据，这就意味着别人知道副密码之后依然考不到敏感数据，可以保护用户的数据安全；

bluejetty:00145185:ios.description:
Owned and built by women. Privacy, respect, and integrity are not just product features - they are core to how we operate. Your data is not sold to third parties and is used only to provide you with the information you need to understand yourself better.
Moody Month is a hormone tracking app designed to support positive mental health throughout menstrual cycles, perimenopause, pregnancy, and postpartum.
We are supported by a dedicated team of female health specialists, providing insights that help you transform your body's hormonal signals into a guide for better mental health.
The Moody Month app gives you:
- Daily hormone forecasts based on where you are in your cycle, pregnancy or postpartum.
- Predictions for periods, ovulation and mood and symptom trends.
- Customized forecasts to plan your week ahead.
- Recommendations on foods to eat and techniques to optimize your hormonal health.
- Programmes to support specific symptoms such as PMS, stress, sleep, bloating and more.
- Simple features for symptom logging and audio and text-based journaling.
- A library of hormonal health articles, movement and mindfulness videos and nutritional tips.
- A space to share where you’re at with your friends, so you can show up on tougher days.
- A way to invite your partner in, so they understand what you're going through and know how to support you - no explanation needed.
Moody Month also integrates with leading health apps like Apple Health, Fitbit, Garmin, and Oura. Connect your wearable device to see how your health data corresponds with your menstrual cycle.
Moody Month Membership
Moody Month offers two auto-renewing subscription options (monthly and annual), as well as a lifetime option:
- The subscription options will automatically renew unless canceled in your Apple Account Settings at least 24 hours before the trial or subscription period ends. You can go to your Apple Account settings to manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew. Your Apple Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed.
- The Lifetime option is paid for by a one-off upfront payment and gives you unlimited access to the Moody Month Membership forever.
Your body, your data, your choice. More info about our terms of service here:
Terms of service: https://moodymonth.com/terms-of-use
Privacy policy: https://moodymonth.com/privacy-statement

bluejetty:00161943:ios.name: Access by KAI
bluejetty:00161943:ios.summary:
The Access by KAI application is the official application from PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) which makes it easy for users to access various kinds of services related to train travel in Indonesia.
TICKET RESERVATIONS
Access by KAI pro
bluejetty:00161943:ios.description:
The Access by KAI application is the official application from PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) which makes it easy for users to access various kinds of services related to train travel in Indonesia.
TICKET RESERVATIONS
Access by KAI provides various menus for ordering train tickets starting from intercity train tickets, local train tickets, LRT Jabodebek train tickets, KCI train tickets, Airport train tickets and Fast Train tickets, all of which can be accessed in one application.
The Connecting Train menu in the Access by KAI application is useful for users who want to schedule connecting trains. The system in the application will find a combination of connecting train schedules as desired
MANAGE TICKET BOOKING
Users of the Access by KAI application can manage previously purchased train tickets. Passengers can add their tickets to the Access by KAI application purchased on external channels via the Check & Add Ticket menu. If you have added the ticket, you can change the schedule, cancel the ticket, transfer the ticket or print the e-boarding pass. With this feature in the Access by KAI application, passengers no longer need to bother going to the station.
LOYALTY PROGRAM
Railpoin is PT Kereta Api Indonesia's loyalty reward program as a form of our gratitude to our loyal customers. Railpoints will be obtained from every purchase of a train ticket, and can be exchanged back for a train ticket or exchanged at a favorite merchant. Be a premium member and enjoy the benefits!
ENTERTAINMENT & LIFESTYLE
Entertainment is a form of activity or method designed to provide entertainment or pleasure to people. Like watching movies, listening to music, and much more.
Entertainment and lifestyle are closely related because entertainment can be part of a person's lifestyle.
The KAI Access application provides several features to support these activities such as:
Trip planner is a feature to assist users in planning their trips. As well as providing information and also organizing trips. With the help of a trip planner, users can easily plan trips in a more organized manner, get relevant information and save time.
PPOB is an online payment system that allows users to make payment transactions electronically in a faster and more efficient way. The PPOB feature is already available at Access by KAI with products being sold such as credit purchases, data packages and electricity tokens.
Railfood is a food and beverage ordering service that is integrated with the Access by KAI Application to make it easier for customers to order food and drinks before or when customers travel by train.
The food/drink menu served is a selection of typical train culinary delights and regional specialties.
EoB and Premium Entertainment are additional entertainment features for watching movies streaming in the Access by KAI application without internet quota which can be accessed while traveling using the train's WIFI network.
Premium Entertainment is an additional paid entertainment feature for watching movies in streaming which can be accessed anywhere and anytime.
INTERMODA INTEGRATION
Access by KAI offers convenience in traveling by train and offers integration with other modes of transportation such as taxis and buses. So that users can plan their trips by train as well as order other modes of transportation
Download the ACCESS by KAI application right now, to be able to access the convenience of traveling by train.

• 내 차 번호만 입력하면 맞춤 규격의 제품을 추천해 드려요.
• 국산부터 수입까지 다양한 브랜드의 엔진오일을 비교할 수 있어요.

• 공임비가 포함된 패키지로 추가 결제 걱정이 없어요.
● 타이어 | 이제 타이어도 제품부터 가격까지 비교하세요
• 내 차 번호만 입력하면 장착점에서 타이어 가격을 먼저 제시해요.

listings.description:
◆ 누적 다운로드 500만 회 돌파 ◆

맡기기 전에 비교하세요!
내 차 수리와 정비, 어떻게 해야 할지 몰라서
아무 데나 가서 알아서 해달라고 하시나요?

이제 그냥 맡기지 말고,
카닥에서 비교하고 선택하세요!

카닥은 믿을 수 있는 투명한 정보로 
여러분의 합리적인 선택을 도와드립니다.

● 외장수리 | 견적 비교로 시작하세요
• 사고 사진 1장만 올리면 1시간 내 5개의 견적서가 도착해요.
• 1 · 2급 공업사와 공식 센터만 입점해 있어요. (덴트샵은 없어요!)
• 비교만 해보셔도 됩니다. 영업 전화가 절대 없어요. 
• 공업사의 과실로 문제가 생긴다면 카닥이 최대 1년까지 A/S를 보장합니다.

● 엔진오일 | 제품 비교로 시작하세요
• 내 차 번호만 입력하면 맞춤 규격의 제품을 추천해 드려요.
• 국산부터 수입까지 다양한 브랜드의 엔진오일을 비교할 수 있어요.
• 만, 말레, 보쉬 등 프리미엄 필터 제품만 사용해요.
• 공임비가 포함된 패키지로 추가 결제 걱정이 없어요.

● 타이어 | 이제 타이어도 제품부터 가격까지 비교하세요
• 내 차 번호만 입력하면 장착점에서 타이어 가격을 먼저 제시해요.
• 타이어 제품과 가격을 비교하고 직접 선택할 수 있어요.
• 원하는 업체와 날짜에 바로 예약할 수 있어요.
• 비교만 해보셔도 됩니다. 영업 전화가 절대 없어요.

● 배터리 | 방전되기 전에 미리 케어하세요
• 내 차 번호만 입력하면 맞춤 규격의 제품을 추천해 드려요.
• 교체 후 1년 또는 2만 km 이내 문제 발생 시 안심 보증

● 정비소 후기와 실제 수리 사례
• 17만 건의 수리 후기가 정비소 선택에 도움을 드려요.
• 정비소의 실제 수리 사례를 통해 그 실력을 확인해 보세요.

이제 그냥 맡기지 마세요.
정비소, 가기 전에 카닥에서 비교하세요!

―
 [제휴 정비소 모집]
전국 수리/경정비 제휴 정비소를 모십니다.
카닥과 함께 매출을 증가시키고 싶은 사장님, 편하게 문의주세요!

아낌없는 피드백과 응원에 항상 감사드립니다.

bluejetty:00061684:ios.description:
Smart-ID is the easiest, most convenient and safest way to authenticate yourself online – check your online bank account, access e-services and confirm transactions.
Smart-ID allows you to give signatures equal to handwritten signatures (except Basic level), which complies with EU regulations about qualified electronic signatures.
Smart-ID is currently available for:
- Estonian, Latvian, Lithuanian residents
- Estonian e-residents
- Belgium residents
EASY 
Get started by downloading Smart-ID app.
Follow the steps in the app to confirm your identity and complete the registration process. Once you’ve done that, you’re good to go – no other confirmation needed! 
CONVENIENT
Your Smart-ID is always within an easy reach!
You can use Smart-ID in as many smart devices as you want and gain access to your online accounts across all of them any time, any place. Using Smart-ID is free and totally unlimited.
SAFE
Smart-ID app does not store your identity or PIN codes. The app is used for key management: it creates your private keys while account registration and later mediates authentication and signature requests. User identity is managed securely by the service provider. A technology has been used in this product for which Cybernetica AS has filed a patent application or a patent has been granted.
Try out Smart-ID, visit portal.smart-id.com!

bluejetty:00179773:ios.description:
WatchMaker, the #1 watch face platform in the world, with millions of smartwatch users, is finally available on iPhone and Apple Watch!
Personalize your Apple Watch with over 150,000 watch faces and powerful complications.
Features exclusive to WatchMaker:
• Access a collection of over 150,000 watch faces
• Discover new designs from creators around the world
• Create your own watch faces or customize existing designs
• Share your watch faces with friends and the WatchMaker community
• Display weather data and forecasts
• One-tap widgets including battery (watch and phone), Wi-Fi and more
• Countdowns for birthdays, holidays, Christmas and special events
• Personalize your Apple Watch with unique faces for every style and occasion
Compatible with all Apple Watch models running supported versions of watchOS, including Apple Watch Ultra 3, Ultra 2, Ultra, Series 11, Series 10, Series 9, Series 8, Series 7, Series 6, SE (3rd generation), SE (2nd generation), SE (1st generation), Series 5, Series 4, Series 3, Series 2 and Series 1.
Apple Watch Series 3 and older: some watch face styles may not work correctly due to watchOS limitations.
Live Watch video faces are limited to 2 seconds and work only when the Always On Display feature is turned off.
Privacy Policy: https://getwatchmaker.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://getwatchmaker.com/terms
Requested Access
Photos
Required to save watch faces to your device and set them as Apple Watch faces.
Notifications
Required to receive updates, new content and app news.
Calendar
Used to display calendar events and information on watch faces.
Apple Health (HealthKit)
Used to display health and fitness data in complications, including active energy, activity, flights climbed, heart rate, steps and distance.

bluejetty:00076962:ios.name: STAGE+ Classical Music Live
bluejetty:00076962:ios.summary:
Immerse yourself in the world of classical music with STAGE+, the ultimate streaming experience from Deutsche Grammophon. Experience your favorite artists closer than ever before—live, in 4K, and with outstanding Dolby Atmos sound.
STAGE+
bluejetty:00076962:ios.description:
Immerse yourself in the world of classical music with STAGE+, the ultimate streaming experience from Deutsche Grammophon. Experience your favorite artists closer than ever before—live, in 4K, and with outstanding Dolby Atmos sound.
STAGE+ is more than just a streaming app; it's your personal VIP access to the most prestigious concert halls and opera houses in the world. Whether it's symphonies, operas, piano recitals, or exclusive documentaries, we bring the magic of classical music directly to your device.
WHAT'S ON STAGE+
• Over 50 exclusive live streams per year from global cultural hotspots.
• A vast archive with thousands of video concerts and opera productions.
• Access to the entire catalog of Deutsche Grammophon, Decca, ECM, and Hyperion.
• Weekly new releases of audio and video content.
• Exclusive insights: interviews, documentaries, and behind-the-scenes footage.
STATE-OF-THE-ART TECHNOLOGY
We know classical music fans don't compromise. That's why we offer:
• 4K Video Quality: Crystal-clear images for an immersive experience.
• Hi-Res & Lossless Audio: Hear every detail in lossless quality.
• Dolby Atmos: Three-dimensional sound that puts you right in the middle of the action.
• Offline Mode: Download content to enjoy on a plane, train, or on vacation without an internet connection.
SPECIALIZED SEARCH & METADATA
Forget chaotic search results. Our database is specifically optimized for classical music. Filter precisely by:
• Composer (from Bach to Glass)
• Work & Opus
• Conductor & Orchestra
• Soloist & Instrument
• Era & Genre
WHY STAGE+?
Our curators put together new recommendations for you every week, so you're always discovering new gems. Whether you're a long-time connoisseur or a curious newcomer, STAGE+ provides the context and quality you deserve.
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
Try STAGE+ now for 30 days free! After the trial period, enjoy monthly or yearly flexibility. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Bring the stage into your life—with STAGE+ Classical Music Live.
Supported formats: 4K, Dolby Atmos, Lossless Audio, Hi-Res.
Available on: iPhone, iPad, Apple TV, and Mac.
Terms & Conditions: https://www.stage-plus.tv/terms 
Privacy Policy: https://www.stage-plus.tv/security-and-privacy

Battle Strategy: Tower Defense
We are here again with a challenging, amazing, cool war game in military style. This Tower Defense (TD) needs your all concentration and focus. In this strategic game, you need to protect the base using tower defense (TD) and destroy your enemies as hard as you can.  
 So:
• Make your own strategy 
• Adjust weapons  
• kill all enemies and attackers 
• and protect of your tower 
Battle Strategy: Tower Defense (TD) game needs quick thinking, careful planning and doesn't excuse mistakes, bad defense can defeat your tower. In some special cases, you may have to change your previous strategy and use a new one. It could be a little scary and dangerous. 
If you like to war, defense and you’re good at designing strategies, don’t waste time, install and show yourself.  
pay attention: 
• Level up your weapons 
• Make a true strategy in its deadline 
• And upgrade items continuedly

Requirements:  
• Wise strategy making 
• Quick plan designing 
• have talent in war controlling  
• Correct detection of the enemy's path 
• Use the right type of weapons 
• Good defense strategy 
• Tower Defense (TD) 
Try to pass all the stages with three stars to surpass your competitors. As you go on, it’s become harder and more complicated. So normally you need better strategy to defense your territory. 
Tower Defense (TD) is most important path and you should not let enemies in by a wise strategy. tower is yours so enemies want to Dominate your territory, here, everything depends on way of Tower Defense (TD).  
As you know, Tower Defense (TD) in this kind of war games, requires precision, patience and strategy.  
Use means, to defense tower. Upgrade means continuously and adjust them by your strategy.  
When you play Battle Strategy: Tower Defense (TD), you will learn: 
• How to reconnect with your intuition and instincts 
• How to consider a good strategy in wars 
• How to Tower Defense (TD) 
Meaning: 
What Is a Tower Defense Game (TD Game)? 
A Tower Defense game (also abbreviated as TD Game) is a strategy game where a single player defends a location or goods from the opposition by building structures that impede the opponent's movement

bluejetty:00062655:ios.name: Saturn Calendar
bluejetty:00062655:ios.summary:
SATURN CALENDAR - THE CALENDAR FOR YOU & FRIENDS
Saturn is a calendar for you and the people who matter most. Other calendars were designed for your work life. Saturn is different. It's built around your friends, your family, and your plans
bluejetty:00062655:ios.description:
SATURN CALENDAR - THE CALENDAR FOR YOU & FRIENDS
Saturn is a calendar for you and the people who matter most. Other calendars were designed for your work life. Saturn is different. It's built around your friends, your family, and your plans.
YOUR CALENDAR
• See your day at a glance — events, to-dos, and what's coming up, all in one screen.
• Connect Google Calendar so everything stays in sync.
JUST SAY IT
• Type or say "Dinner with Dylan on Tuesday at 7" and it's on the calendar.
• Add events, to-dos, and reminders using text or voice.
• We help figure out the details and get invites out so you can go from idea to event faster.
COMPARE CALENDARS
• See when your friends and family are free — without their email.
• No more texting "when are you free?" Just look.
• Find overlapping availability and make a plan in seconds.
SHARED CALENDARS
• Create a shared calendar for a trip, a household, a rec league — anything.
• Add events, invite people, and keep everyone on the same page.
• One shared source of truth, no group chat required.
THE CALENDAR FOR SNAPCHATTERS
• Connect your Snap and your friends, birthdays, and Bitmojis are already here.
• Snapchat and Saturn are better together.
THE CALENDAR FOR STUDENTS
• Rotating periods, block schedules, A/B days, lunch waves, advisory, flex blocks — Saturn handles your school's format automatically.
• Already in over 20,000 US high schools, so your bell schedule could be ready to go.
• Bring it to college — Saturn grows with you from your first semester through graduation.

bluejetty:00147548:ios.description:
Discover the world of hobbies through the relaxing and enjoyable game, "Find The Difference - Hobby"!
This captivating mobile game invites you to immerse yourself in a visual journey, exploring the fascinating hobbies and interests of people from all walks of life. With a unique collection of beautifully crafted photos, you’ll find yourself uncovering the differences between seemingly identical pictures, all while learning about the diverse passions that people cherish.
"Find The Difference - Hobby" offers a unique twist on the classic "find the difference" game, focusing on various hobbies. From gardening and painting to cooking and hiking, each set of pictures showcases a different hobby, highlighting the intricate details that make each interest special. As you progress, you'll encounter a plethora of engaging images, each telling a story about a hobbyist's world, allowing you to appreciate the subtleties and nuances of their passions.
Game Features:
No Timers: "Find The Difference - Hobby" is designed to be a stress-free experience. There are no timers to rush you, so you can take your time to carefully observe and find the differences at your own pace. This game is perfect for those moments when you just want to relax and unwind.
Relaxing Gameplay: With its soothing background music and gentle sound effects, "Find The Difference - Hobby" provides a calming atmosphere. The game’s simple rules ensure that players of all ages can easily enjoy finding the differences without any frustration.
Offline Play: Whether you’re on a long flight, commuting, or just in an area with no internet connection, you can always enjoy "Find The Difference - Hobby".
Special Design and Unique Style: "Find The Difference - Hobby" stands out with its special design and unique artistic style. The carefully curated photos and illustrations are not only a delight to the eyes but also crafted to offer a pleasant and immersive experience. Each picture invites you to delve deeper into the world of hobbies.
As you delve into "Find The Difference - Hobby", you’ll find each level introducing new hobbies, each depicted through stunning photos. The game encourages players to appreciate the diversity and creativity involved in different activities. From the meticulous details of a model train set to the vibrant colors of a handcrafted quilt, every difference you find brings you closer to understanding the passion behind each hobby.
Why You’ll Love "Find The Difference - Hobby":
Educational Fun: Learn about various hobbies while having fun. Each set of pictures provides insight into the different ways people spend their leisure time and express their creativity.
Brain Exercise: Sharpen your observation skills as you find the differences between the photos. This game is not only relaxing but also a great way to keep your mind active.
Family-Friendly: "Find The Difference - Hobby" is perfect for players of all ages. Gather your family and friends for a fun, collaborative experience as you work together to find all the differences.
Join the Fun:
Download "Find The Difference - Hobby" today and start your journey through the captivating world of hobbies. With hundreds of levels to explore, you’ll never run out of new and interesting photos to enjoy. Find the differences, appreciate the details, and discover new hobbies along the way. Whether you’re a casual gamer looking for a relaxing pastime or a puzzle enthusiast seeking a new challenge, "Find The Difference - Hobby" is the perfect game for you.
Immerse yourself in a world where every photo tells a story and every difference you find brings you closer to the heart of a hobby. Start finding the differences and see how many hidden details you can uncover. "Find The Difference - Hobby" – where every picture is a new adventure waiting to be discovered. Download now and let the journey begin!

bluejetty:00139612:ios.description:
Lucky Sweater is a circular closet trading app. 
On Tuesdays, we swap!
We’re a secondhand community platform for swapping out items you don't use anymore for new faves, for free. Just pay for shipping to swap your item.  Trade your way to a closet that shifts with your identity, size, and style.
List items in your closet to trade, sell, or gift, share looks for style inspiration and outfit tracking, and have fun getting dressed alongside our growing community of secondhand style enthusiasts. 
How it works: 
- Join our community groups: Slow Fashion, Curated Thrift, Me Made, Vintage, Outdoor Gear, Kids Slow Fashion, and Gender Swap. 
- Help others know what you're looking for by adding your "in search of"s (ISOs) to your profile, including your unicorn ISO.
- List items in your closet to trade, sell, or gift to other members of the community. 
- Every Tuesday there’s a new Swap Drop, with more chances to find your dream ISO or fill a crucial closet gap
- Save or Super Save the items in circulation that you love.
- Start trading when people save items in your closet — that’s a Save Match!
- Get ready to send your traded item to its new life with easy in-app shipping. We encourage reusing packing materials, and adding a thank you note when life allows.
- Sustainers get access to all community groups, 5 Super Saves per week, 3-hour early access to the Weekly Swap Drop, item protection on all trades shipped in-app, and more perks brewing!
Who we are: 
Lucky Sweater is a community-first, trade-forward, buy-curious experimental space for exploring fashion as a tool of creative self-expression, and we’d love to share closets.
Lucky Sweater is for:
People who find meaning in getting dressed. 
Humans on a quest to curate an intentional closet. 
Folks who value quality and craft over quantity. 
Secondhand style enthusiasts looking to build community with others on the hunt for THAT. PERFECT. THING. 
Makers, menders, up-cyclers, thrifters, closet-curators, capsule collection-devotees, and everyone in between. 
Those who want their beloved but no longer worn items to be treasured by someone who *gets it*
Community-minded humans who believe in the circular economy, kind communication, and keeping well-made clothes out of the landfill — joyfully. 
Lucky Sweater might not be for you if:
You’re mostly looking to sell stuff quickly.
You’re here to “flip” items or turn a profit.
You’ve never felt emotionally connected to an article of clothing.
You don’t want to respectfully engage with others or follow group guidelines.
And that’s okay! We’re not for everyone. But if you're someone who lights up at the idea of trading a beloved item that’s no longer serving you to someone who’ll truly appreciate it and give it new life? Welcome, you’ve found your people.
Recent App Updates: 
We just launched Search by YOUR Measurements for our Sustainers — Because sizes are made up and meaningless! Brought to you by the LS community, who takes care to add at least 3 accurate measurements to all 20K+ items available on the app. 
Our newest group, Curated Thrift, just launched! Picture a curated secondhand store, on your phone. This group keeps trades flexible with a fluid brand list, ensuring more of our favorite pieces stay in circulation and out of landfills. 
Buy & Sell across all groups (even ones you’re not in) during our end of the month Buy & Sell Days!  
—
Lucky Sweater Sustainer Subscription
A Lucky Sweater Sustainer subscription unlocks access to all community groups, 5 Super Saves per week, 3-hour early access to the Weekly Swap Drop, item protection on all in-app trades, and more perks. A subscription is not required to use the app.
New subscribers may be eligible for a 1-week free trial. Prices may vary by region and are shown in your local currency at checkout.
Privacy Policy: https://luckysweater.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
