bluejetty:00044913:ios.name: Moblo - 3D Furniture Modeling
bluejetty:00044913:ios.summary: Want to create a bespoke piece of furniture or design a space yourself? Moblo is the perfect 3D modeling tool for your future projects. Great for easily designing furniture in 3D, you can also use it to imagine more complex interior designs
bluejetty:00044913:ios.description:
Want to create a bespoke piece of furniture or design a space yourself? Moblo is the perfect 3D modeling tool for your future projects. Great for easily designing furniture in 3D, you can also use it to imagine more complex interior designs. Using augmented reality, you can quickly bring your ideas to life and visualize them in your own home.
Whether you're a beginner or an experienced 3D modeler, Moblo is the perfect 3D modeling tool for your bespoke furniture projects. With its interface designed for either a touchscreen or a mouse, Moblo is simple and accessible to everyone.
Examples of furniture or fittings often designed with Moblo: 
- Made-to-measure shelving 
- Bookcase 
- Dressing room 
- TV unit 
- Desk 
- Children's bed 
- Kitchen 
- Bedroom 
- Wooden furniture 
- Etc.
Visit our website or our Discord server to discover the full range of possibilities offered by Moblo. From DIY enthusiasts to professionals (carpenters, kitchen designers, interior designers, etc.), the community shares a whole host of ideas and creations.
www.moblo3d.app 
Creation steps:
1 - 3D modeling 
Assemble your future piece of furniture in 3D using an intuitive interface and ready-to-use parts (basic shapes/legs/handles). 
2 - Customize colors and materials
Choose which materials to apply to your 3D furniture from our library (paint, wood, metal, glass). Or create your own material using a simple editor. 
3 - Augmented reality 
Using your phone's camera, visualize your 3D creation in your own home and adjust it according to your space. This means you can see what your design looks like in a real-life context before you start production.
4 - 3D export
Export your project as a 3D mesh file (.stl or .obj) for use with other tools such as Sketchup or Blender (raw mesh, without colors or textures).
Main features:
- 3D assembly (movement/deformation/rotation).
- Duplicate/hide/lock one or more parts.
- Materials library (paint, wood, metal, glass, etc.).
- Custom materials editor (color, texture, shininess, reflection, opacity).
- Augmented reality visualization.
- Parts list.
- Notes related to parts.
- Photo capture.
Premium features:
- Possibility of working on several projects in parallel.
- Unlimited number of parts per project.
- Access to all part shapes.
- Access to all materials in the library.
- Save a selection as a new project.
- Import a project into an existing project.
- Export to .stl or .obj 3D mesh files (raw mesh without colors or textures).
- Export the parts list in .csv format (compatible with Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets).
- Share creations with other Moblo apps.
For further information, please visit our resources page on the moblo3d.app website.

bluejetty:00016322:ios.name: Drumtune PRO | Drum Tuner
bluejetty:00016322:ios.summary:
Drumtune PRO turns your phone into a professional drum tuner trusted by tens of thousands of drummers worldwide. 
It helps you tune drums accurately, develop tuning skills, train your ears, and achieve the best possible sound for your kit.
bluejetty:00016322:ios.description:
Drumtune PRO turns your phone into a professional drum tuner trusted by tens of thousands of drummers worldwide. 
It helps you tune drums accurately, develop tuning skills, train your ears, and achieve the best possible sound for your kit.
〉〉Why do drummers choose Drumtune PRO?
• Gets your drums sounding their absolute best. Every time.
• Trains your ear through visual feedback and builds real tuning skills.
• Gives deep insights into drum tuning for true control and confidence.
• Packed with pro-level tools that help you stand out.
〉〉KEY FEATURES
DRUM TUNER
→ Tune snare, toms, floor toms, kicks, congas, and bongos with precision.
→ Focus lock-mode lets you clear lug pitches and kills overtones.
→ Shape your sound by balancing batter and resonant heads.
→ Lock in, optimize, and repeat your perfect tuning fast.
→ Save tuning presets to store your favorite sounds.
→ Save your personal tuning approach and custom pitches for batter, reso and fundamental per drum. Recall them in minutes, anywhere.
→ Download free Evans, Remo, and Aquarian drumhead packs to organize your presets.
LUG TUNER
→ Instantly spot which lugs need adjustment > no more guesswork.
DRUM KIT INTERVAL
→ Build drumkits. Adjust the tonal spacing between the individual drums. Create a coherent kit sound. 
→ Tweak the intervals between drums . Change the tuning of batter & reso with each drum stable in its tonal spot within the kit. Balance your kit for coherence in dynamics & feel.
PERCUSSION TUNER
→ Tune congas & bongos to any pitches or intervals within the set, accurately.
CLICK TRACK / METRONOME
→ Create custom beats, activate BPM count-in, control in-ear monitors, and tweak meters & subdivisions.
→ Use advanced training modes to tighten your groove & pocket.
→ Build, organize, and share tempo & rhythm track lists.
MULTI-TRACK RECORDER
→ Record grooves, fills, ideas, or full rehearsals (with BPM count-in and click for in-ear monitoring).
→ Manage, rename, import/export, and share recordings.
→ Select input, adjust mic gain, apply EQ and effects, change playback speed, and record up to 4 tracks.
→ Import any backing track (like a bassline sketch), press record, and lay your drum track alongside it.
SAVE & RECALL EVERYTHING
→ Store exact tunings (including lug pitches and fundamental tone).
→ Create sound references for each preset.
→ Enjoy free cloud backup, or backup on your personal CloudDrive or device. 
〉〉REAL TALK
Drumtune PRO isn’t about shortcuts. 
It’s about helping you achieve real growth, gain skill, control, and obtain a unique sound that earns respect. 
Drumtune PRO is a tool to help you build lasting drum tuning skills with clear feedback, empowering you to make your own creative sound decisions.
• Mastering your kit still takes listening, awareness, and practice. 
• The tuner shows you where you are pitch-wise, but you make the tuning decisions for your tone & feel.
〉〉TECH SPECS
• Patented high-precision tuning engine (0.5 Hz resolution)
• Ultra-wide tuning range: 30 Hz to 800 Hz and way up (adaptive by drum type and mode)
• Compatible with iOS 15.6 or later and iPhone 8 or newer
〉〉 SUPPORT
 Question/doutb/bug: support@drumtunepro.com
⌘ Pro Tip ⌘
Drumtune PRO already has the widest tuning range of any drum tuner app or drum tuner device made so far. 
• High pitches beyond the tuning range can show as lower pitches within the tuning range. 
• Respect the natural tension range of your drumhead. Like tuning by ear, apply tension with care. 
• Use common sense & trust your drummer instinct to never overtighten. Too much tension can snap drumheads, especially thin snare reso heads. 
• Start at medium snare-reso tension first and increase gradually so the high pitch tracks accurately within range.
• When in doubt, or when overshooting the range chasing a pitch, return to medium tension.
► Tune smart, play hard, and trust Drumtune PRO to keep you sounding your best, every session!

bluejetty:00097835:ios.summary: "Secrets of Salem: Shadow of the Witch" – now free to play! Immerse yourself in a thrilling mystery adventure that blends hidden object games with unsolved mysteries games mechanics. Set in the dazzling yet treacherous streets of 1950s Sale
bluejetty:00097835:ios.description:
"Secrets of Salem: Shadow of the Witch" – now free to play! Immerse yourself in a thrilling mystery adventure that blends hidden object games with unsolved mysteries games mechanics. Set in the dazzling yet treacherous streets of 1950s Salem, this supernatural tale follows Dakota, a young witch caught between life and death, as she embarks on a quest to find hidden objects, uncover dark secrets, and track down a ruthless killer. Can you help her unlock her powers, solve search and find games challenges, and reclaim her life before it’s too late?
Step into the dazzling streets of 1950s Salem, a city of towering lights and whispered spells, where glamour masks danger, and magic simmers beneath the surface of modernity. Dakota, the daughter of a Salem witch, returns to her hometown after receiving a mysterious letter about her mother’s death. Attacked by a shadowy figure, Dakota finds herself mortally wounded and trapped between the world of the living and the spirit realm. Guided by her mother’s friend Sebille, Dakota discovers her magical abilities and learns the killer is hunting witches across Salem. As a ghost, Dakota uncovers dark rituals, confronts vengeful spirits, and pieces together the attacker's identity. With her body lying in a hospital bed, her soul journeys into Salem’s most haunted places. Will Dakota harness her newfound powers, save her coven, and return to the living - or will she be consumed by the shadows?
· Hidden Object Gameplay!
Search through haunted mansions, eerie graveyards, and mystical apothecaries in thrilling hidden object games levels. Every scene is packed with interactive elements where you must find hidden objects to reveal hidden clues and solve Salem’s deepest secrets!
· Spellbinding Mini-Games!
Put your skills to the test with mystical riddles that unlock secrets and propel Dakota’s story forward. Tackle creative potion-brewing, memory-based spellcasting sequences, and intricate lock-picking games!
· Magic, Choices & Consequences!
Your decisions shape Dakota’s fate in this mystery adventure. Will you harness her powers wisely and uncover the truth, or fall into the darkness that threatens Salem? Every choice affects the story’s outcome, making each mystery hidden object games playthrough unique!
· Collectibles and Achievements!
Hunt for ancient amulets, spell tomes, and coven artifacts that enhance Dakota’s powers and reveal Salem’s haunted legacy. Earn achievements by solving mini-games flawlessly, uncovering rare items, and making key narrative choices!
Will you survive the hidden object games challenges and expose a sinister plot against witch coven? Play now for free!
-----

Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames

bluejetty:00154418:ios.summary: One of the most classic card game of all, and with one simple rule: the Ace gets all the cards. Now with online multiplayer! In Ace Wins All, your memory is your strength. Collect more cards than your opponent by either MATCHING PAIRS or la
bluejetty:00154418:ios.description:
One of the most classic card game of all, and with one simple rule: the Ace gets all the cards. Now with online multiplayer! In Ace Wins All, your memory is your strength. Collect more cards than your opponent by either MATCHING PAIRS or laying down an ACE (to collect the whole bunch of cards on the table!), but KEEP TRACK of what’s been played to stay ahead of the game! Perfect for relaxing a bit on your spare time at home or to keep you brain awake on the go and commuting.
A great game for KIDS and adults alike - challenging enough for advanced players and also a great way to teach some simple math and memory skills to the little ones. 
Get it now for FREE! Unlock achievements and beat your friends on the exclusive leaderboard.
And do not miss out on our La Scopa and La Briscola to have a complete classic card game suit on your iPhone and iPad!
Ace Wins All features:
- Online multiplayer: play with friends and other players all over the world
- Choose your level: 3 difficulty modes against the computer (A.I. artificial intelligence)
- Play both LANDSCAPE and PORTRAIT orientation
- Fun and challenging achievements to unlock on Game Center
- Be part of the Global High-Score (Leaderboard): there’s one for each difficulty level.
- Choose your deck: La Scopa got all the original Italian regional decks (Napoletane, Siciliane, Piacentine, Piemontesi, Triestine and more), in high resolution that will look astonishing on your iPhone and iPad. Or you can play with the classic Poker cards (French)!
FOLLOW US

Twitter @outofthebit

bluejetty:00064506:ios.name: smallcase - Save & Invest
bluejetty:00064506:ios.summary:
smallcase is a great place to put your money to work. We have investment ideas across Indian Stocks & ETFs, Mutual Funds, Fixed Deposits, and for global diversification, US Stocks & ETFs.
What makes smallcase stand out from other investmen
bluejetty:00064506:ios.description:
smallcase is a great place to put your money to work. We have investment ideas across Indian Stocks & ETFs, Mutual Funds, Fixed Deposits, and for global diversification, US Stocks & ETFs.
What makes smallcase stand out from other investment apps is our ‘model portfolios’, also known as ‘smallcases’. These are baskets of Indian Stocks/ETFs, Mutual Funds or US Stocks/ETFs. These smallcases are created by investment experts around an idea like a trending sector (Defence, Pharma, etc.), a theme (AI & Data Centres, Clean Energy, etc.) or a trusted strategy (Momentum, Value & Growth, etc.)
To keep your investments fresh, these smallcases are periodically rebalanced by buy/sell recommendations of underlying stocks to keep up with market trends. 
INVEST IN INDIAN STOCKS & ETFs
- Connect your existing broking or demat account, or open a new one. smallcase supports India's top brokers including Kite by Zerodha, Groww, Upstox, ICICI Direct, HDFC Securities, IIFL Securities, Angel One, Motilal Oswal, Axis Direct, Kotak Securities, 5paisa, Alice Blue, Nuvama, and more
- Select an idea to invest in like Electric Mobility, and leave the underlying stock picking to experts. They will research across EV manufacturers, charging service providers, battery manufacturers, etc. to find the most suitable for the smallcase
- SIP into multiple stocks in one go
- Apply rebalance updates periodically to keep your investments fresh
INVEST IN US STOCKS & ETFs
- Open a free Global Investing Account and fund it via your Indian bank account
- Invest in trending ideas unique to US markets like AI Supply Chain, Robotics, Country Rotation, etc. Leave the underlying stock picking to experts.
- Since fractional shares are supported, start investing with just $50
- Your investments stay fresh with automated rebalancing when the smallcase manager triggers a buy/sell action of underlying stocks
- Invest with confidence via the GIFT City framework, fully compliant with Indian regulations
INVEST IN MUTUAL FUNDS
- Invest in baskets of direct mutual funds with zero commission
- Select an idea like Parking your Savings, Sector Rotation, Flexicap Picks, etc, and leave the selection of underlying mutual funds to experts
- SIP into multiple mutual funds at once
TRACK YOUR NET WORTH WITH WEALTH OFFICE
- Get a 360° view of your finances across stocks, mutual funds, gold, real estate, FDs, EPF, loans, and credit health
- Chat with Wealth Office AI to uncover insights about your wealth, forecast your net worth, and get roadmaps for your financial goals
GET LOAN AGAINST SECURITIES
- Get a loan against your stock and mutual fund investments, without selling them
- Avail low interest rates starting at 9.9% p.a.
- Repay at any time with no foreclosure charges
Tenure: 36 months
Maximum Annual Percentage Rate (APR): 13%
Registered Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) Lenders:
- DSP Finance Private Limited
- The South Indian Bank Limited
- Bajaj Finance Limited
Example:
Interest Rate: 16% p.a.
Tenure: 36 months 
Cash to be credited: ₹1,00,000
Processing Fee: ₹2,073
GST: ₹373
Loan Insurance: ₹1,199
Total Loan Amount: ₹1,03,645
EMI: ₹3,644
Total Repayment Amount: ₹1,31,184
INVEST IN FIXED DEPOSITS
- Open high-interest FDs with returns up to 8.5% p.a.
- Get DICGC insurance up to ₹5 lakhs
- Choose from Slice SF, Shivalik SF Bank, and more
NOTE: Equity investments are subject to share market risk. Investments in global markets are subject to market, currency, regulatory, and jurisdictional risks. Read all the related documents carefully before investing. Investors should consider all risk factors and consult their financial advisors before investing. Representations are not indicative of future results. The quoted model portfolios are not recommendatory. For full disclosures, visit: https://smallcase.com/meta/disclosures
Registered Address: CASE Platforms Private Limited #51, 3rd Floor, Le Parc Richmonde, Richmond Road, Shanthala Nagar, Richmond Town, Bangalore - 560025

bluejetty:00128919:ios.name: Energy Cost Calculator
bluejetty:00128919:ios.summary:
Energy Cost Calculator – Track Usage, Demand Charges & Save Money
Easily calculate the energy consumption and operating cost of your electrical devices, appliances, or industrial machines — now with Power Factor analysis and multi-device c
bluejetty:00128919:ios.description:
Energy Cost Calculator – Track Usage, Demand Charges & Save Money
Easily calculate the energy consumption and operating cost of your electrical devices, appliances, or industrial machines — now with Power Factor analysis and multi-device comparison.
Just enter:
• Power Consumption per Hour (kW)
• Daily Usage Time (Hours)
• Electricity Rate (Cost per kWh)
Get instant results for:
• Energy Consumption: Daily, Monthly, and Yearly
• Cost Analysis: Daily, Monthly, and Yearly
• Demand Charges: Peak Load (kW) with Power Factor (pf) correction — optional
• Carbon Emissions: Estimate your environmental impact across Coal, Oil, Natural Gas, and Nuclear sources
What's new in this version:
Power Factor Analysis
Enter your peak demand and power factor (pf) to calculate Apparent Power (kVA). Know whether your utility bills on kW or kVA, see the billing basis, and understand the true cost of low power factor — critical for commercial and industrial users.
Multi-Device Comparison
Add multiple appliances or machines and compare their monthly and yearly costs side by side. A live stacked bar chart shows which devices consume the most — so you know exactly where to cut.
Share Your Results
Export a full PDF report of your calculations — including demand charges, power factor analysis, and CO2 emissions — with a single tap.
Ideal for:
• Homeowners reducing electricity bills
• Businesses and facility managers tracking equipment costs
• Electrical engineers and energy auditors conducting power audits
• Industrial users managing demand charges and power factor penalties
• Anyone seeking to optimise power usage and reduce energy spend
Whether you're planning an energy audit, sizing an electrical installation, or simply monitoring your household usage, this tool gives you actionable insights in seconds.

bluejetty:00084936:ios.description:
Freedom to communicate on your own terms
For individuals and communities - private communication between family, friends, hobby groups, clubs, etc. 
Element X gives you fast, secure and private instant messaging and video calls built on Matrix, the open standard for real-time communication. This is a free and open-source app maintained at https://github.com/element-hq/element-x-ios
Stay in touch with friends, family and communities with:
• Real time messaging & video calls
• Public rooms for open group communication
• Private rooms for closed group communication
• Rich messaging features: emoji reactions, replies, polls, pinned messages and more.
• Video calling while browsing messages.
• Interoperability with other Matrix-based apps such as FluffyChat, Cinny and many more.
Privacy-first
Unlike some other messengers from Big Tech companies, we don’t mine your data or monitor your communications.
Own your conversations
Choose where to host your data - from any public server (the largest free server is matrix.org, but there are plenty of others to choose from) to creating your own personal server and hosting it on your own domain. This ability to choose a server is a large part of what differentiates us from other real time communication apps. However you host, you have ownership; it’s your data. You’re not the product. You’re in control.
Communicate in real time, all the time
Use Element everywhere. Stay in touch wherever you are with fully synchronised message history across all your devices, including on the web at https://app.element.io 
Element X is our next-generation app
If you’re using the previous-generation Element Classic app, it’s time to try Element X! It’s faster, easier to use, and more powerful than the classic app. It’s better in every way and we’re adding new features all the time.

Tired of complex 3D puzzles, and want a minimal abstract puzzle
bluejetty:00156756:ios.description:
PATHI – ABSTRACT & MINIMALIST LOGIC PHYSICS BALL DROP PUZZLE
Do you love the challenges of the brain physics puzzles in which you need to guide balls from one spot to another?
Tired of complex 3D puzzles, and want a minimal abstract puzzle in 2D that you can also play offline?
Meet Pathi – the new physics line path puzzle in which you need to guide the ball by placing, dragging, and rotating shapes. Play this relaxing puzzle game offline for free and test your physics drop puzzle logic skills in 100 levels. 
How long can you go? Can you pass all levels in this mind-teaser ball path logic puzzle?
Play this minimalist 2D physics based puzzle NOW FOR FREE and with NO WIFI!
◆ BRAIN TRAINING MADE FUN & RELAXING
Drag, rotate, and place blocks to find the right path to the goal. Drop the ball and use many different level components to fill the path and achieve your goal: modify gravity, use portals, avoid obstacles and play with physics in abstract minimalist graphic levels! Watch out, there are blocks with thorns that can destroy the ball. 
◆ WIDE CHOICE OF PHYSICS PUZZLE BLOCK TYPES
Use many different block types to draw the path you try to complete and send the ball to the goal. In this gravity draw physics line game there are different ways to complete the level. Experiment using your logic to find the best ball path!
Use these block types to complete the physics logic puzzles:
- Rect: use it to complete a route or avoid obstacles
- Spring: launch the ball in the direction you want!
- Launchers: rotates by some degrees and then launches the ball. There are 3 different types of launchers with different angles!

bluejetty:00138576:ios.description:
Disfruta los mejores bosquejos para sermones. Encontrarás Sermones predicados de Charles Spurgeon, su Biografía, Devocionales, Audios, algunas frases completamente en español.
Considerado como el "Príncipe de los predicadores" Charles H. Spurgeon escribió decenas de bosquejos útiles para líderes y Pastores de la iglesia. 
Charles Spurgeon fue un predicador y pastor prominente en la tradición Bautista Reformada. Su sólido fundamento teológico lo convirtió en uno de los más fuertes opositores a la teología liberal y pragmática de su tiempo. También era conocido como el "Príncipe de Predicadores" por sus sermones poderosos de pensamientos incisivos y exposición precisa.
Spurgeon fue pastor de la Iglesia Bautista de Londres denominada Metropolitan Tabernacule, durante 38 años. Fue parte de numerosas controversias con la Unión Bautista de Gran Bretaña y luego debió abandonar su título religioso. Durante su vida, Spurgeon sufrió diversos malestares físicos. Sin embargo, en 1857, fundó una organización de caridad llamada Spurgeon's, la cual trabaja a lo largo de todo el mundo.
A lo largo de su vida evangelizó alrededor de 10 millones de personas y a menudo predicaba 10 veces a la semana en distintos lugares. Tanto su abuelo como su padre fueron pastores puritanos, por lo que creció en un hogar de principios cristianos. Sin embargo no fue sino hasta que tuvo 15 años en enero de 1850 cuando hizo profesión de fe en una Iglesia metodista.
En esta gran aplicación encontrarás una fuente de anécdotas, citas bíblicas y enseñanza para: Pastores, líderes cristianos, y maestros de escuela dominical. Bosquejos listos para compartir en la iglesia y reuniones de estudio. 
En Bosquejos de sermones Spurgeon tendrás a tu alcance 90 bosquejos cristianos que será de mucha utilidad para el predicador y maestro de escuela dominical y que podrás utilizar sin conexión a internet.
Algunos bosquejos incluidos:
- Apresurando a Lot
- Poder con Dios
- Tengo Bastante
- Jose Abre los Graneros
- Oracion Inoportuna
- Quien Esta por el Señor
- Contra la Murmuración
- Incapacidad Moral
- El Olivo Fiel
- Rut se decide por Dios
- La Batalla es del Señor
- Los Despojos de David
- Los ojos abiertos
- Medias tintas
- La lección del arca
- Roboam no preparado
- Petición de ayuda
- Ardiente deseo
- La exaltación de Ester
- La pregunta del afligido
- La rendición del pecador
- El seguro conocimiento de Job
- Rebelándose contra la luz
- El hipócrita descubierto
...
Bosquejos de sermones para predicaciones cristianas. Predica y estudia la palabra de Dios con la ayuda de estos magníficos bosquejos que ponemos a tu disposición.
En este libro podrás encontrar una herramienta para tu iglesia o uso personal. Aprenderás también que es la homiletica, la idea de que es la Predicación y su importancia y mucho más. Con estas clases serás instruido para preparar sermones para mujeres, sermones para jóvenes, sermones cortos y más. 
Simplemente instala y crea estos sermones poderosos e inspiradores, que literalmente han cambiado la vida de miles o incluso millones de personas, como parte de tu estudio bíblico. Los sermones de Spurgeon son recursos muy valiosos para los predicadores o para cualquiera que quiera aprender a escribir un sermón.
Además tendrás acceso a una gran variedad de recursos Bíblicos como:
- Biblia completa offline escrita para consultar cualquier capítulo de la Biblia que desee
- Bosquejos Online
- Temas y Devocionales Cristianos
- Temas Bíblicos para Predicar
- Sermones Bíblicos
- Audio predicaciones
Esperamos que sea de su agrado la aplicación Bosquejos de Sermones Spurgeon. 
Descarga ahora Bosquejos de Sermones Spurgeon y comparte con nosotros tu experiencia.

6. Set post reminders for scheduled publishing times and receive push notifications so you never miss your planned posts.

Whether your child is in preschool, kindergarten, or elementary school, our app adapts to their learning level, ensuring they are challenged and motivated. Our game-based approach makes math practice a natural part of playtime, helping kids build confidence and a love for learning math.
WHY AHAAA MATH?
Ahaaa Math offers the perfect balance of math and play.
- Truly Game-Based Design. Math is in every move, making learning feel like play. Kids solve math problems naturally while playing, no need to solve problems just to unlock items. They won't even notice they're learning!

- Engaging and Motivating: Ahaaa Math offers over 5000 CCSS-aligned games and activities, covering everything from basic counting to advanced arithmetic, shape recognition, telling time, and unit conversion. Engaging challenges and a leaderboard motivate kids to learn independently, making math fun and rewarding.
Track progress easily. 
- 13-level learning system adapts to each child’s age and ability, providing a customized learning path and trackable progress reports.
Trusted by millions. 
- Ahaaa Math has brought the joy of learning to over 5 million families in Asia.

bluejetty:00150373:ios.description:
Remember more, study less.
Recollio turns any text into smart flashcards, schedules reviews at the perfect moment, and tracks your progress—so you can master classes, languages, or exam prep in minutes a day.
Why learners choose Recollio
• AI Flashcard Maker: Say goodbye to writing flashcards, our AI handles it for you. Compatible for any topic you want!
• Google Gemini: We utilize the most advanced AI for flashcard creation. (Yes, we tested others too!)
• Spaced-Repetition Scheduling – Proven “forgetting-curve” timing means each card appears right before you’d lose it, locking facts into long-term memory.
• Mobile-First Design – Built for one-hand study on iPhone and iPad; no clunky desktop layout stuffed into a tiny screen.
Recollio is your ultimate learning companion, whether you're a student striving for top grades, a professional seeking continuous improvement, or anyone eager to expand their knowledge.
Three study modes
Note → Card
Paste lecture notes or textbook paragraphs; AI splits them into concise Q–A flashcards.
Topic → Card
Enter any concept (“USMLE biochemistry”, “Spanish irregular verbs”) or pick from curated exam lists—cards appear instantly.
Lingo Cards
Choose a language, and AI builds vocab + grammar decks that progress from basics to idioms.
Recollio is based on the scientifically proven "Spaced Repetition" method, also known as "Active Recall." As early as 1939, H. F. Spitzer demonstrated its effectiveness with over 3,600 students. In 1973, Sebastian Leitner developed his renowned "Leitner system," a versatile spaced repetition learning system based on flashcards.
Study Smarter with Recollio: AI Flash Cards
More than just note cards: Recollio AI Flash Cards takes the hassle out of studying. Our AI transforms your notes into engaging flashcards, using spaced repetition to boost your memory and understanding.
AI for School Work & Beyond: Recollio isn't just for students! Professionals can use our AI-powered flashcards to stay sharp and master new skills. From medical assistants learning complex terminology to anyone wanting to learn faster and more efficiently, Recollio is the ultimate learning companion.
Acing medical terminology just got easier: Recollio's AI flashcards and spaced repetition maximize your learning.

Entrenched in a beautifully sunkissed and handcrafted world, embark on a heartfelt journey interwoven with lighthearted and pressure-free puzzle solving.

bluejetty:00136801:ios.name: BonBon Dress Up & Decor
bluejetty:00136801:ios.summary: Dress up cute characters, decorate cozy rooms, and create fun stories in a gentle room makeover game built around imagination, fashion, and creative play. BonBon Dress Up & Decor gives young players a charming place to style outfits, design
bluejetty:00136801:ios.description:
Dress up cute characters, decorate cozy rooms, and create fun stories in a gentle room makeover game built around imagination, fashion, and creative play. BonBon Dress Up & Decor gives young players a charming place to style outfits, design rooms, and act out little everyday stories at their own pace.
Each play session can begin with a favorite character and a fresh idea. Pick cute outfits, mix fashion styles, choose accessories, and create a look that fits the story. Then move into room decor: arrange cozy furniture, add cheerful details, and give each room a warm makeover. The play is open-ended, so there are no levels, no timers, and no pressure to win — just calm, imaginative simulation play.
BonBon also brings in light sandbox activities that make each scene feel more alive. Young storytellers can build a small story world with characters, rooms, stickers, simple cooking moments, and gentle pet care. Bake a sweet treat in the kitchen, prepare a room for a pretend visit, care for a cute pet, or use sticker-book creativity to make each scene feel special. It is designed to support early creativity, role play, and screen-time well spent.
Q: What kind of game is BonBon Dress Up & Decor?
A: It is a dress up and room makeover game with story-driven creative play. Players style characters, decorate cozy rooms, cook simple treats, care for pets, and create their own scenes.
Q: Can it be played offline?
A: Yes. BonBon Dress Up & Decor is made for offline play, so it works well for travel, quiet time, or family moments without needing an internet connection.
Q: Is the gameplay stressful or competitive?
A: No. There are no leaderboards, no time pressure, and no winning or losing. The experience is cozy, open-ended, and focused on imagination, design, style, and storytelling.
Q: Is the play experience parent-friendly?
A: Yes. BonBon Dress Up & Decor is designed for gentle creative play, with no chat, no strangers, no leaderboards, and no stressful timers.
BonBon Dress Up & Decor is a wholesome choice for families who want cute characters, fashion play, house design, room makeover fun, sticker-style creativity, and charming stories in one offline experience. Download for hours of cozy creative play.

JUMPER Health is the official companion app for JUMPER medical devices,
helping you and your family monitor, manage, and review everyday health
data — all in one place.
SUPPORTED DEVICES

• Body Scale — weight and body composition metrics
• Pulse Oximeter — SpO₂, pulse rate, and waveform replay
• Infrared Thermometer — temperature log and fever alerts
• Fetal Doppler — fetal heart rate curves and audio playback
• TENS Therapy Device — guided programs and progress tracking
• Jaundice Meter — neonatal transcutaneous bilirubin tracking
• Biofeedback and Stimulation Device — postpartum pelvic floor training
DESIGNED FOR FAMILIES
• Multiple member profiles under one account
• Cloud sync across devices — never lose your records
• Smart reminders for abnormal readings and routine check-ins
• Long-term trend charts to visualize changes over time
PRIVACY & SECURITY
• Encrypted data transmission and storage
• You stay in control of your health data

160+ countries, JUMPER Health is your everyday partner for proactive
family health management.

bluejetty:00037788:ios.description:
Listen to the radio stations you love with the official app from the radio industry.
Download Radioplayer FREE today and start your listening experience! 
- No registration required 
- Free 
- High-Quality Sound 
- Available on all your devices with Bluetooth, Airplay, CarPlay, Apple Watch, Smart Device Link
- Personalised content recommendations based on your preferences
New: 
- Easy access: Listen to your favourites directly from the homepage 
- Continuous listening: switch between devices without missing a beat. 
- Sync your favourites between mobile and Smart TV.
- Sync your favourites between your different smartphones.
HOW DOES IT WORK? 
1/ Select your country 
2/ Choose your favourite radio stations & podcasts
3/ Choose your city to get local radio suggestions
Enjoy easy access to your favourites & recently listened content directly on the homepage.
INTUITIVE AND EASY 
It’s easy to use and with some powerful features which will help you enjoy radio even more:
- Personalised recommendations based on your preferences 
- Ultimate search function to help you discover new radio stations and podcasts
- Download podcasts for offline listening 
- Notifications to remind you about new episodes of your favourite shows and podcasts
- Alarm Clock: Wake up to your favourite radio station
- Sleep Timer: Fall asleep to the music your love
- Find the names of the songs and artists currently playing on your favourite radio station
CAR LISTENING: 
- Voice control to skip safely through your favourite radio stations while driving
- Great Apple CarPlay support and ‘Wrong Way Driver’ technology to alert you to motorway dangers
- Easy Mode for playing your favourites with one tap
SEAMLESS LISTENING
Enjoy smooth and uninterrupted transition between devices.
It means that you for example can start listening on the phone without pausing, and then switch the listening to your Smart TV without any disruption. 
HIGH-QUALITY SOUND 
Enjoy crystal-clear audio, optimised for both mobile data and speakers. We use HQ streams direct from broadcasters, which other apps can’t access.
On the go, Radioplayer switches to mobile-friendly streams to reduce your data consumption.
FOLLOW NEWS AND SPORTS LIVE 
Stay informed with live news 24/7 and sports events. 
Listen to the most recongised voices in your country and also all the local content that is relevant to you. 
LISTEN TO MUSIC 
With our musical radios, listen to the best rap, pop, rock, R&B, indie, dance,electro, classical, and jazz hits…
BROADEN YOUR HORIZONS 
Explore a genre of radio stations and podcasts with searches by themes: Kids, Business, Entertainment, World Music, Religion and many more
Radioplayer Worldwide, Ltd. is a not-for-profit company, aimed at making radio listening easier in connected devices, operating in 22 countries: Austria, Belgium, Canada, Croatia, Cyprus, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Ireland, Italy, Norway, Liechtenstein, Luxembourg, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, The Netherlands, United Kingdom
A SUGGESTION 
Do you like Radioplayer? Support us by leaving us a review
Do not hesitate to send us your suggestions for making Radioplayer even better!
For more information, Radioplayer.org

🧒 Watch your simulator baby grow and become an awesome little human!
👨👩👧👦 Take care of a virtual family! Play house, change diapers and more in this awesome virtual mother simulator game.
Time to rock being a mommy in the best pregnancy simulator game around. Let’s play Pregnancy Idle 3D!

bluejetty:00122557:ios.name: BullionVault: gold and silver
bluejetty:00122557:ios.summary: Invest in gold, silver, platinum and palladium at live prices. Get 4g free silver when you fund & validate your account. Buy and sell 24/7. Track gold and silver prices on live charts. Trade bullion at market rates. Open and manage your acc
bluejetty:00122557:ios.description:
Invest in gold, silver, platinum and palladium at live prices. Get 4g free silver when you fund & validate your account. Buy and sell 24/7. Track gold and silver prices on live charts. Trade bullion at market rates. Open and manage your account.
The Official BullionVault app for iOS from BullionVault, the world’s largest online investment gold, silver, platinum and palladium service, gives private investors from around the world the best access to professional bullion markets and live market data from their devices. 
Experience why over £200 million worth of gold, silver, platinum and palladium have been traded via orders placed through the apps on smartphones and tablets in the last 12 months. BullionVault users now own more gold than all but 50 of the world’s largest central banks. 
Get the best price with instant gold, silver, platinum and palladium trading on the go, and cheaper prices than coins and small bars. 
BEFORE YOU OPEN AN ACCOUNT 
On our app, it is completely free, and you don't need a BullionVault account to: 
+ Track the gold, silver, platinum and palladium rates. 
+ View current (and historical) price charts for gold, silver, platinum and palladium in US dollars, UK pounds, euros, or Japanese yen to inform gold price analysis. 
+ View BullionVault’s live bullion-trading markets, available 24/7. Edit the markets to see only those of interest to you. 
+ Choose language settings from English, French, German, Italian, Polish, Spanish, Japanese and Chinese. 
+ Use the app alongside our online tools like the BullionVault Cost Calculator to calculate purchase, storage and sale costs. 
+ Choose to view gold and silver prices and palladium and platinum prices in troy ounces or kilograms. 
+ Open a new BullionVault account. 
+ Free silver and cash to try trading on BullionVault, yours to keep when you deposit and validate within 3-months of opening an account. 
+ Contact us via chat, phone or email. 
USERS WITH A BULLIONVAULT ACCOUNT 
If you’re a BullionVault customer with an account, you can also: 
+ Login securely using this convenient app. 
+ Deposit funds using BullionVault’s bank account details. 
+ Validate your account. 
+ Check your bullion and currency balances, and current valuation. 
+ Buy gold, silver platinum or palladium instantly, secured and insured in professional vaults in your choice of London, Zurich, New York, Toronto or Singapore. 
+ Trade your precious metals in US dollars, UK pounds, euros, or Japanese yen. 
+ Sell your bullion with no settlement delay. 
+ Trade gold, silver, platinum and palladium at any time at low cost, commission from 0.5% to 0.05%. 
+ Buy or sell your bullion at the Daily Price set in London. 
+ Enable Auto-Invest to become a regular investor. 
+ Add bullion to your existing SIPP or IRA accounts. 
+ Review your order history, check the status of your orders and manage open orders. 
+ Set up personalised alerts to let you know when the spot price of gold, silver, platinum or palladium reaches a value you choose. 
+ Manage your email alerts and subscribe to our newsletters. 
+ Contact us via chat, phone or email. 
BullionVault is a full member of the LBMA (London Bullion Market Association) and an associate member of the LPPM (London Platinum and Palladium Market). It has won the Queen's Award for Enterprise tree times. 
By downloading or using this app you are accepting BullionVault’s Terms & Conditions and cookie/privacy policies, viewable on the BullionVault website. 
PLEASE NOTE: The value of precious metals may fall as well as rise. Historical trends do not guarantee future price moves. Nothing on BullionVault's websites nor in any of its communications constitutes investment advice. You should consider seeking professional advice to determine if owning bullion is right for you.

bluejetty:00087597:ios.summary: Time to sweat at home, have an absolute blast, and reach your fitness goals with the Boxing & Bubbles APP by Fitness Pro Christa DiPaolo! If you're ready for a strong mind, knockout body, supportive squad, and a ton of fun, Christa's B&B pr
bluejetty:00087597:ios.description:
Time to sweat at home, have an absolute blast, and reach your fitness goals with the Boxing & Bubbles APP by Fitness Pro Christa DiPaolo! If you're ready for a strong mind, knockout body, supportive squad, and a ton of fun, Christa's B&B program is just for YOU. Join the global community for unlimited access to HUNDREDS of real-time workouts for every fitness level, including strength training, jump rope, kettlebells, upper body, lower body, mobility, core, guest instructors, and so much more! New real-time sweat sessions and a suggested training schedule added WEEKLY. 
Christa's unique approach to fitness results in authentic, relatable, engaging, fun, and challenging workouts that leave you feeling empowered, inspired, and motivated. Here at B&B, we don't talk about weight loss; it's about how the workouts make you FEEL. The Boxing & Bubbles Program allows you to design an individualized fitness regimen based on your lifestyle. From 10-60 minute, cued, follow-along videos, customize your exclusive playlist to suit your workout needs. Sweat with Christa in beautiful Miami Beach and get ready to feel strong and more confident from the inside out. Working out has never been this much fun! 
B&B MEMBERSHIP FEATURES: 
• Access to hundreds of workouts filmed in beautiful Miami Beach for every goal and fitness level. 
• Full-length, follow-along videos including boxing, kickboxing, strength training, cardio, jump rope, kettlebells, upper body, lower body, core, body weight, mobility, guest instructors, and so much more! 
• Choose from 14 unique workout categories to keep you motivated. 
• New fully guided sweat sesh's from beginner, intermediate, and advanced are uploaded weekly, along with a suggested training schedule.
• Ninja notes so you can privately make comments on your workouts. 
• Custom drag-and-drop playlist feature to curate a unique workout adventure.
• Filter your sweat sesh between categories, intensity, duration, body part, and equipment. 
• Upload private images to track your progress. 
• Cast or stream to any device from anywhere in the world. 
• Download videos to watch offline. 
• Interact with the B&B community in the comments section under every video.
All new members get exclusive access to a 7-day free trial! 
ABOUT YOUR TRAINER: 
Christa has dedicated her life to fitness after her dreams of a professional boxing career were sidelined due to herniated discs in her cervical spine. Her injury has made her highly compassionate to anyone with pre-existing injuries and conscientious about teaching proper form and technique. 
Christa has appeared on Good Morning America, The Today Show, and PopSugar Fitness and was featured in magazines such as Well + Good, Vogue.com, Glamour.com, US Weekly, Women's Health, and Shape. She has multiple certifications with the National Academy of Sports Medicine, including, Performance Enhancement Specialist, Group Personal Training Specialist, and Certified Personal Trainer. Her most outstanding achievement, though, is working out with you in your home on the B&B APP!

bluejetty:00061101:ios.description:
Your own ecommerce store is just a few taps away. Create, promote, and manage your online store right in the Ecwid by Lightspeed mobile app, and build your business from the palm of your hand.
LAUNCH YOUR OWN ECOMMERCE BUSINESS
- Design your ecommerce website right from your mobile device — no coding required
- Add products with a snap of your camera
- Choose from 60+ secure payment options, like PayPal, Stripe, Square, Chase, and more
- Set up shipping, delivery, or self pickup options for your customers
SELL EVERYWHERE
- Sell directly on your website
- Import your Ecwid by Lightspeed store to Facebook with the tap of a finger to Sell on Facebook
- Sell on Instagram by tagging products in your posts with shoppable tags
- Add products to Amazon and eBay
- Or turn your online storefront into a mobile app (via the web Control Panel)
NEVER MISS AN ORDER
- Get push notifications about new orders
- Process orders update order statuses, and keep customers up-to-date automatically
- Add order notes for staff
- Add tracking numbers to orders and notify customers about changes
- Create and manage orders or quickly find and edit order details
- Contact customers directly from the app
KEEP YOUR INVENTORY UP-TO-DATE
- View and manage products on-the-go
- Update product options like size, color, and more
- Edit prices at will
- Control stock levels and change product availability
MARKET YOUR BUSINESS
- Build marketing campaigns
- Create and share discount coupons
- Increase sales by recovering abandoned carts
- Set-up free shipping based on order value to encourage customers to spend more
- Track everything from your Ecwid Control Panel
GET HELP WHEN YOU NEED IT
- Chat with our expert customer support team right from your mobile device
- Get free ecommerce tips delivered right to your inbox every week from the Ecwid team
PRICING
Choose the right Ecwid by Lightspeed plan for your business:
FREE
Easy online store to launch your business for free:
- A shopping cart with everything you need to start accepting orders online
- Storefront with up to 5 products
- Email support
VENTURE
Professional features to grow and manage your online store:
- List up to 100 products
- Reach customers on Instagram/Facebook
- Promote your store with discount coupons
- Offer scheduled order pickup (perfect for restaurants)
- Email and Chat support
BUSINESS
Advanced ecommerce solutions to expand your business:
- List up to 2,500 items
- Grow sales with automated email reminders to shoppers who abandon their carts
- Connect your store to Mailchimp to create powerful email campaigns
- Set-up staff permissions to manage your store
- Enable multilingual storefront to sell internationally
- Email, Chat, and Phone support
UNLIMITED
Everything you need to sell online, with mobile, and in-person:
- Unlimited product listings
- 12 hours of custom development to build unique solutions for your store
- Priority support by email, chat, or phone.
By signing up, you agree to the Terms of Service: https://www.lightspeedhq.com/legal/lightspeed-service-agreement/ and Privacy Policy: https://www.lightspeedhq.com/legal/privacy-policy/

listings.description:
Collect and upgrade blades and powerups in action-packed fun!

Ready your blade, ninja. Everyone's favourite fruit slicing action adventure is back with an exciting, real-time competitive edge!

Challenge other ninjas from around the world as you work your way up the ranks to become the Fruit Ninja champion. Whether your reflexes are sharp, wisdom is deep, or you just really hate organic food, Fruit Ninja 2 promises to give you deep, engaging matches in bite-sized slices of time. So what are you waiting for? Draw your blade and prepare to fight!

Hop into all your favorite memories from the golden days of mobile with this classic similar to games like Angry Birds, Subway Surfers, Temple Run, Cut The Rope, Jetpack Joyride, Plants vs Zombies, Clash of Clans, Candy Crush, Fun Run, Hill Climb Racing, Flappy Bird, and more!

FEATURES:
- Most addictive player-versus-player gameplay on mobile
- Turn the tide of battle when you unleash an all new variety of powerups
- Collect and hone powerful and legendary blades to get the edge over your opponents
- Beautiful arenas set the stage for ultimate showdowns
- Become a champion by slicing your way up through the leagues
- Master combos, criticals, and blitzing to find your winning strategy
- Invite others using the VS Friend mode to find out who the greatest ninja is among your friends and family
- Show off your inner ninja as you unlock avatars and taunt packs

bluejetty:00115578:ios.name: Alabama Weather Network
bluejetty:00115578:ios.summary:
FEATURES THAT KEEP YOU INFORMED AND SAFE
► Live Severe Weather Coverage Watch real-time, ad-free coverage of tornado warnings, flash flood emergencies, hurricanes, and other severe weather events from James Spann and the Alabama Weather Ne
bluejetty:00115578:ios.description:
FEATURES THAT KEEP YOU INFORMED AND SAFE
► Live Severe Weather Coverage Watch real-time, ad-free coverage of tornado warnings, flash flood emergencies, hurricanes, and other severe weather events from James Spann and the Alabama Weather Network team. When the weather gets serious, we’re on the air — and in the app — with expert analysis, radar updates, and ground truth from our team of Skywatchers and field reporters across the state.
► CurrentCast Every ten minutes, our rotating weather block gives you a fast-paced update on what’s happening across the state — including live radar, satellite, temperatures, dewpoints, wind speeds, and short-term forecasts. Never be more than a few minutes from the latest information.
► Local Forecasts that Matter We don’t do generic, one-size-fits-all forecasts. Our team knows Alabama inside and out. Whether you’re in Birmingham, Tuscaloosa, Mobile, Huntsville, Dothan, or any of our 67 counties, we provide accurate, relevant forecasts for your community — including event-specific forecasts, beach weather, and seasonal updates.
► Live Radar and Satellite High-resolution radar and satellite imagery right at your fingertips. Track storms, follow rainfall, and watch the skies in real time with tools designed by meteorologists for regular users.
► Push Alerts and Notifications Receive instant alerts for watches, warnings, and custom AWN updates — straight from James Spann and the team. We don’t send spam. We send what matters.
► Video Forecasts and Special Segments Stream daily video forecasts, the amazing "Spanning Alabama" features, our comprehensive beach forecasts, and segments like The Weather Classroom and the Tropical Update. There’s always something new and local and relevant.
► SpannCamNetwork Watch real-time feeds from our growing network of high-definition cameras across
Alabama, giving you a view of the weather where it’s happening — from the coast to the foothills of the Appalachians. See storms approaching, sunrises and sunsets, and storms building across the state.
► WeatherBrains Podcast Stream the world’s longest-running weather podcast directly in the app. Join James Spann and the WeatherBrains team each week as they interview meteorologists, discuss severe weather, and dive deep into the science and stories behind the forecast.
BUILT FOR ALABAMA. POWERED BY TRUST.
The Alabama Weather Network was created because Alabama needed more. More local weather coverage. More boots on the ground. More focus on what matters to our state. James Spann and the team built AWN to be the trusted weather source for every person, in every county — and this app brings that mission to your pocket.
We’re not owned by a national media company. We aren't ruled by consultants. We do what's right for you - the people of Alabama..
PERFECT FOR:
• Residents of Alabama who want accurate, up-to-date weather information • Families preparing for severe weather or hurricane season • Travelers heading to the Gulf Coast, state parks, or local events • Farmers, anglers, coaches, and event planners who depend on weather • Teachers and students who love learning about weather • Skywatchers, storm chasers, and weather enthusiasts • Anyone who follows James Spann and trusts his forecasts.
JOIN THE NETWORK. STAY WEATHER AWARE.
Whether you’re at home, at work, in the classroom, or on the road — the Alabama Weather Network app is with you. Download it today and experience weather coverage the Alabama way: smart, serious, and always local. This is more than an app. It’s Alabama’s Weather Network.

bluejetty:00016038:ios.description:
Beckett Media provides products and services to help collectors and businesses buy, sell, protect, value, and learn about sports and non-sports trading cards and collectibles. 
Beckett Online Price Guide (OPG)
OPG subscription provides instant and 24/7 access to over 7 million sports card listings that are updated daily PLUS FREE access to Organize. If you already have an OPG subscription, no additional purchase is required.
Beckett Grading Services(BGS)
• Population Report: See exact counts of cards graded previously by BGS.
• Serial Number Lookup: Verify your certification number, card grades & subgrades.
• My Orders: Check status of your order, tracking information & grades received.
• FAQs:Frequently asked questions about grading submissions.
Beckett Authentication Services (BAS)
• Signature Review: Upload your own image or provide link for a quick review of an autograph to find out if it is likely to pass authentication or not. Customers get a non-binding opinion within an estimated time of 24-48 hours. $10 fee for signature review is charged regardless of the outcome of results received. Refund will be issued only in case we are unable to render an opinion. No refund or cancellation if turnaround time exceeds 24-48 hours.
• Verify Certificate: Verify your certification number with information on signer, item type, additional notes, grades & images.
• Pricing: Check authentication fee by searching by a signer’s name.
• My Orders: Check order status, tracking information & item results.
• Services: Information on all services offered by BAS.
Organize
Create & manage your collections, including graded cards, plus view Beckett Value when you have an OPG subscription.
Section for In-App Purchases
Subscribe to below from our app.
Single Sport OPG: Access price guide for your preferred sport though web as well as iOS-iPhone and iPad.
Total Access: Get access to all sports OPG through web & iOS-iPhone & iPad. Additionally, you get access to Market Data Report (MDR) through web.
Vintage (all sports): Includes Web Access and iOS access through iPhone and iPad.
This is a free app download & does not include free subscription. Subscription can be purchased within the app.
When a recurring subscription is purchased, content will be provided immediately.
Subscriptions available for Single Sport:
1 month - $14.99
3 months - $40.99
6 months - $74.99
12 months - $129.99
Total Access:
1 month - $40.99
3 months - $119.99
6 months - $199.99
12 months - $349.99
Organize:
1 month - $6.99
12 months - $64.99
Player:
1 month - $4.99
- No trial period for above subscriptions.
- Subscription will renew automatically unless cancelled more than 24 hours before the end of the current period. You will be charged for renewal within 24 hours of the end of the current period, for same duration and at the current subscription rate for the product.
-You can choose a different subscription offering through your Account Settings or tap Cancel Subscription to cancel your subscription. If you cancel, your subscription will stop at end of the current billing cycle.
-Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
- All Subscriptions are set to auto-renew except player. 
- Online Subscriptions are non-refundable. Please review your order carefully before completing your purchase.
To purchase subscription, search any term at “Home” or browse through “OPG” tab. Click on “Buy Pricing” under-pricing & you will be redirected to subscription page related to sport/term.
In case of any issues, please write to us at customerservice@beckett.com
Check our privacy policy here:
https://www.beckett.com/privacy
You can find our terms & conditions here:
https://www.beckett.com/tos
When you click on links to various merchants on this site and make a purchase, this can result in this site earning a commission. Affiliate programs & affiliations include, but are not limited to, the eBay Partner Network.

bluejetty:00061569:ios.description:
Probuild is an all-in-one business management app that is designed to meet the unique needs of construction, contracting and trades businesses. Probuild lets you manage your projects, estimates, invoices, timesheets, and communications from anywhere—using just one app!
THE RIGHT TOOL FOR THE JOB
Probuild’s intuitive design gives you quick and reliable access to all the features you need to run a successful business right from your smartphone, saving you time and making you money. Probuild really is the right tool for the job!
With Probuild, you can:
- Create professional, branded ESTIMATES and INVOICES with your own logo
- Get paid faster with built-in ONLINE PAYMENT processing
- Conquer payroll with accurate, electronic TIMESHEETS
- Manage PROJECTS remotely with real-time project feeds
- Get constant access to your information (even when offline!)
- Keep your books current with automatic QUICKBOOKS ONLINE sync
- Document your work by adding PHOTOS
- Capture client SIGNATURES remotely and on your device
- Keep everyone up to date with in-app communications
- Coordinate your team’s work with worker LOCATION TRACKING
TRUSTED BY THOUSANDS OF BUSINESSES
Probuild is used by thousands of: general contractors, home builders, remodelers, electricians, plumbers, HVAC technicians, roofers, painters, landscapers, and more.
GET STARTED TODAY
Solo contractors get free basic access to all features. You can also upgrade to our Pro plan to accept online payments and add unlimited users to take advantage of our advanced collaborative features. Still not sure if the Pro version is right for you? Try a 14-day free trial with no credit card required!

bluejetty:00078171:ios.description:
memoryOS contains interactive bite-sized lessons by a 2X World Memory Champion and an educational 3D game of Virtual Mind Palaces - all in one easy-to-use app. It utilizes scientifically proven memory techniques, spaced repetition and patented game mechanics to enhance long-term memory storage and improve knowledge retention.
memoryOS is loved by 500,000+ people worldwide because it is a whole new, joyful & game-changing tool for obtaining the most effective memorization skills.
Co-founded by Jonas von Essen, who went from struggling to remember to becoming a World Memory Champion, winning on Who Wants To Be a Millionaire, "Jeopardy, and setting a world record by memorizing 100,000 decimals of Pi . 
memoryOS app has over 18k public worldwide ratings on Apple and Google app stores combined, averaging 4.8 stars. Users also continue adding 5-star reviews daily, sharing how effective and life-changing memoryOS has been for them. Also, memoryOS remains the most crowdfunded app in Kickstarter’s history.
Memorization is as important as reading and writing and should be taught as our base skill. Our mission is to enable millions of people to remember needed information easily.
With memoryOS, you will learn how to memorize:
- Names, Long speeches, Lists of items, Birthdays, Personal facts, Passwords, Trivia, Languages, Vocabulary and phrases, Countries and Capitals, Flags, Historical timeline, Numbers, Periodic table
- Content of complete books, Dates of significant events, Complex data structures, Concepts, and figures
- Art, Anatomy, Decks of cards, Advanced number systems; Long sequences of numbers, Binary Digits
You will also learn:
- How to keep track of years, months, weeks, and days 
- Advanced study techniques, Spaced Repetition system, Speed memorization
Why did Google Brands Accelerator recognize memoryOS as being 'Light Years Ahead' in the memory space?
• memoryOS delivers results:
During our pre-launch phase, thousands of users completed our demo and, on average, had a 70% increase in recall and a 60% increase in recall speed just after the first ~40min session.
• Providing your mind with structured storage space:
We have spent tens of thousands of hours creating and optimizing our Virtual Mind Palaces, so you don’t have to spend months constructing your own the hard way. These virtual palaces serve as blueprints for your mind's storage space, allowing you to easily encode, store and recall like a memory champion.
• A proven innovative approach that works:
During our research and development stage, thousands of people of all age groups and even those with difficult medical conditions found memoryOS as an effective and useful tool. Actual results exceeded our team’s expectations.
• Gamified edtech at its best:
memoryOS has proven to work on people with no prior gaming experience - anyone can use it. Utilizing the power of the Unity game engine, memoryOS is widely accessible on all mobile and tablet devices and is soon coming to VR.
--
Joining memoryOS is free. This provides extensive value on the free plan, and you are not obligated to pay to start using it. You can subscribe to a Student Premium plan for as low as $3.49/month when billed annually or $4.99/month when billed monthly (it can be 10-20% higher in some countries due to local taxes). You can subscribe through the 'Shop' section of the memoryOS app and find the above-mentioned or go to your App Store app's profile and choose a desired plan there. Recurring payments will automatically renew unless you cancel your account at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. You can manage your subscription, cancel anytime, or turn off auto-renewal by accessing your iTunes account.
Join the memoryOS community of over 500,000+ early adopters who share this memorable journey!
--

Explore a vast, icy terrain filled with hidden resources, ancient secrets, and deadly surprises. Build shelters to shield yourself from blizzards, craft tools to hunt for food, and stay warm with fire before nightfall. Every decision matters — one wrong move could be your last.

With immersive graphics, dynamic weather, and realistic survival mechanics, 99 Nights of Survival: Iceland delivers a challenging yet rewarding experience for fans of survival and adventure games. No second chances. No hand-holding. Just you, the cold, and the will to survive.

bluejetty:00030288:ios.description:
* Provides a large number of free VPN servers with optional locations.
* Keep your mobile activities safe & private. protect your online privacy when using the Internet in potentially unsafe locations, such as unprotected WiFi hotspots in hotels or cafes. 
 --------Features-------- 
* Free
* Servers grouped by countries, So you can select the country you want to connect easily.
 --------User Guide-------- 
OvpnSpider will automatically search for free VPN servers on the Internet; and the result is provided as an OpenVPN profile which is categorized by countries. 
User can connect to the VPN server in-app directly.
-- Clicking the selected server on the list will connect to vpn server automatically.
===============================================
User also can export OpenVPN Profile .ovpn to other Applications.
--Clicking the share icon on the list will launch a popup view of the available applications. 
-- If OpenVPN (the 'openvpn connect' application is already installed) is selected, the profile will be automatically imported into OpenVPN and then the user could connect to the VPN server.
-- If Mail is selected, the OpenVPN Profile .ovpn will be automatically inserted into the email as an attachment. and the user can share the OpenVPN profile files to other devices or other users through the email. Thus other equipments which have already installed the OpenVPN application, could use the profile to connect to VPN server.

bluejetty:00014914:ios.name: ZoomZoom : Car Booking Online
bluejetty:00014914:ios.summary: Discover Zoom Zoom, an incredibly efficient transportation app that offers private cars with highly qualified drivers, who guarantee a secure journey with a superior quality of service. With just a few minutes’ wait, you’ll have a car and d
bluejetty:00014914:ios.description:
Discover Zoom Zoom, an incredibly efficient transportation app that offers private cars with highly qualified drivers, who guarantee a secure journey with a superior quality of service. With just a few minutes’ wait, you’ll have a car and driver ready to take you wherever you wish to go.
So how does Zoom Zoom work?
1. Start by ordering or reserving your journey. All you need to do is open the app and let us know your current location and your desired destination. Choose from our various vehicle types – ZoomGo, ZoomSUV, ZoomLuxury, and more – and explore the options available in your city!
2. Then, simply confirm your journey and your driver will be on their way. We will provide you with your driver's name and your vehicle's information, such as its license plate and the distance of arrival.
3. We will also inform you of the estimated price of the ride before you travel , which you can pay with credit or debit cards, cash, or any other payment method that you find suitable.
4. Moreover, you can also share the details of your journey with family or friends so that they can track your whereabouts for additional safety.
In the Zoom Zoom app, you have the opportunity to personalize your journey. Select your preferred music, take advantage of the opportunity for female drivers to specify a preference to accept trip requests only from female passengers, or decide how many seats are necessary for an enjoyable trip.
Where is Zoom Zoom available?
Zoom Zoom is offered in more than 25 cities across the United States and Canada. You can check out the full list of cities where the app operates on zoom.cab.
So, what are the advantages of the Zoom Zoom app?
For one, your safety is always our priority. Every journey is tracked and can be instantly shared with someone you trust so that they always know where you are. 
Furthermore, signing in is simple and convenient, as you can use your email address and password. 
You also have the option to save your most frequently visited locations by clicking the ‘heart’ icon located at the right-hand side of the search bar. 
Additionally, our drivers have all undergone a very selective onboarding process, ensuring they provide the best service possible.
And finally, you can use one single account to travel in multiple cities, which is ideal for those who love to travel!
Do you want to be a driver with Zoom Zoom?
If you’re passionate about helping others explore their city, join the fleet of Zoom Zoom drivers! Start to earn money with the help of an app that values your safety and provides you with the best fares. For more information, go to zoom.cab/drivers or download the Zoom Zoom Drivers app.
Are you looking for corporate transportation options for your business?
Then look no further! Our corporate service offers your business an expansive fleet of cars to meet all of your company's requirements. Plus, you can use our management platform to easily monitor your employees’ expenses and journeys. Learn more by visiting zoom.cab.

bluejetty:00178287:ios.summary: You've discovered the fascinating art of Moku Hanga, the Japanese method of wood-block printing. Breathtaking landscapes, beautiful women, and busy cityscapes can be transformed into this exotic art known for flowing hand-chiseled outlines
bluejetty:00178287:ios.description:
You've discovered the fascinating art of Moku Hanga, the Japanese method of wood-block printing. Breathtaking landscapes, beautiful women, and busy cityscapes can be transformed into this exotic art known for flowing hand-chiseled outlines and brushed on color.
The Moku Hanga app, Moku the Japanese word for “wood” while hanga is known as “print”, allows you to create an artistic wood-block print from any picture or snapshot — no need for time consuming carving — the artists from JixiPix do all the work for you! With the power to fully customize your Moku Hanga, you can create a masterpiece artistic enough be part of printmaking history!
The outlines in Moku Hanga are extremely eye catching, replicating a hand chiseled relief-art. Using sliders found on the adjust tab you can control the smoothness, width and strength of the chiseled outline to fit your composition.
Presets are also available to give your project a quick start. Choose from a range of bold chisled outlines, and bright to subtle color combinations. If the preset colors chosen for your work are not to your liking, there is the option to alter your palette colors. Once the desired color is achieved complete your artwork with an artistic edge or paper. In printmaking the final image does rely on the choice of paper; whether it is kozo fibers or rice paper — this will add an artistic quaility to your print and complete your Moku Hanga.
Moku Hanga Features:
• Automatically create a work of art with the look of hand chiseled outlines and brushed on color, fully adjustable with simple sliders.
• Adjust the outline width, strength and how smooth or fluid your chiseled outline appears.
• Control the color in your artwork with saturation, strength and image color sliders.
• Choose between two printing styles: "Multi-Color" or "Multi-Block".
• The Multi-Color style uses all the original colors in your photo. By adjusting the "Image Color" slider you can reduce or add colors to your artwork giving it a variety of printed-styles, from a full-color block process to spot-color ones.
•The Multi-Block style uses 5 blocks of color pulled from your original image then divides the colors across your artwork giving the look of carving a separate woodblock for every color. The cool thing about this style is the ability to "Randomize Colors" throughout your artwork and the ability to replace any or all of these colors, using the full-spectrum color picker. You can achieve simple to exaggerated color results using this process.
• Works with Hi-Res images and saves Hi-Res for top-quality results
• Gets you started fast with a variety of presets
• Creates personal-favorite custom presets using the "Save Preset" menu
• Has the addictive JixiPix Randomizer – so much fun!
• Superior customer support and updates – we're committed to your long-term satisfaction

bluejetty:00062605:ios.name: Proverbs & Psalms - King James
bluejetty:00062605:ios.summary: The book of Proverbs and Psalm contains unique contents among the books in the Old Testament. Both widely read and highly treasured books of the Old Testament, the book of Proverbs and Psalm contain wise sayings, songs of praises, encourage
bluejetty:00062605:ios.description:
The book of Proverbs and Psalm contains unique contents among the books in the Old Testament. Both widely read and highly treasured books of the Old Testament, the book of Proverbs and Psalm contain wise sayings, songs of praises, encouragements, and prayers of the Jewish people.
The chapters of the book of Proverbs are divided into three parts:
• Chapter 1 – 9 is addressed to the youth and Solomon writes on how to acquire wisdom through listening to your parent’s advice and on following a godly path.
• Chapter 10 – 24 shows the contrast between a wise person and foolish person, between good and evil which is addressed to generally all people seeking wisdom and a godly lifestyle. 
• Chapter 25 – 31 is addressed for leaders regarding wisdom, warnings and instructions that would benefit in leading people to a godly lifestyle.
While the chapters of the book of Psalms are divided into five parts:
• Psalm 1 – 41 is about the matters of human life, personal connection between man and God
• Psalm 42 – 72 is about the matters of the Israelites and their relationship with God.
• Psalm 73 – 89 is about God’s law and sanctuary.
• Psalm 90 – 106 is about the nation of Israel and all other nations.
• Psalm 107 – 150 is about the Word of God and the matters of His heart.
The book of Proverbs is written mainly by King Solomon, displaying God’s wisdom in his life but there are also others writers such as Lemuel and Agur while the book of Psalm is mostly written by King David, the father of Solomon and also other writers such as the sons of Korah, to Asaph, to Solomon and Moses.
The book of Proverbs and Psalm both have different purpose but both books teaches, instructs, inspires, and guides the readers to a godly lifestyle, to a knowledge of God’s heart and His character, and to life’s perspectives that pleases the Lord. 
The book of Proverbs teaches the readers and believers about godly wisdom and lifestyle with the foundation of the fear of the Lord (see Prov. 9:10) while the book of Psalm reveals to the readers and believers about the heart of God, the cry of the Israelites, prophecies about Jesus Christ and encouragements with prayers in times of troubles, sorrows, sufferings and trials.
Both Psalm and Proverbs have unique voice and style but both its purpose is for believers to grow in wisdom, knowledge and a closer relationship with God.

bluejetty:00015947:ios.description:
Acrostic puzzles are crosswords with a twist: find the hidden quote. This combination of crossword and cryptogram provides an entertaining brain workout. Each letter in the quote is linked to a letter in one of the clue answers. As you fill in more and more answers, more letters will begin to fill the quote grid, until eventually the entire quote is revealed. Once the quote is partially filled in, you can also do this process in reverse – each letter you add to the quote will fill in the corresponding letter in the clue answers. By working back-and-forth, eventually the entire quote and all clue answers will be revealed.
The app includes 60 free quality puzzles with no ads, ever. They range from beginner to expert from renowned publishers like Acrostica, Acrostics by Cyn, Lovatts Puzzles, PennyPress Anacrostics, Puzzle Baron and Spanish language puzzles from Tav Ripo. Additional puzzle packs containing 48 to 50 puzzles are available for a small fee; the full library is 7100 puzzles!
Advanced play features include automatic grid updating and indexing, see related cells, multi-level undo, remove errors, and hints. A wide range of difficulty levels will challenge beginners and seasoned players alike.
If you like word games, crosswords or cryptograms, acrostic puzzles are a fun way to exercise your brain!
Quality Software by Egghead Games. Contact us at support@eggheadgames.com or www.eggheadgames.com. We stand by our products and will happily refund your purchase if you’re not completely happy.

bluejetty:00179845:ios.description:
핑크다이어리에서 내 생리를 기록하고, 분석하고, 이를 사랑하는 사람에게 커플커넥트로 공유하세요!
여성의 몸과 월경에 대해 풍부한 상식을 알려주는 아티클들도 구독하고, 내 또래 여성들과 우리들의 실제 생리 관련 고민들을 핑다톡에서 생생히 나누세요.
여성이라면 대부분 겪어야만 하는 생리 기간, 핑다가 편안하고 즐겁게 만들어 줄게요.
⏺ 생리주기관리와 피임관리, 핑다로 한 번에 해결!
생리의 양과 생리통 정도, 그날의 증상과 기분, 사랑 기록, 피임약 복용 등 기록만 하세요. 그럼 핑다가 내 배란 예정일과 가임기, 오늘의 임신 확률 등을 자동으로 계산해서 알려주고 예정일 알람도 보내줄게요.
⏺ 커플커넥트로 사랑하는 사람과 내 생리주기 공유!
사랑하는 사람과 핑다 앱을 깔지 않고도 내 생리주기를 공유할 수 있어요. 커플커넥트로 내 몸상태와 생리 주기를 손쉽게 사랑하는 이에게 공유하세요. 사랑하는 사람과 나 사이 시크릿 메시지를 주고받거나 애정이 듬뿍 담긴 선물하기도 가능해요.
⏺ 비밀 보장 여성 익명 커뮤니티 핑다톡!
내 또래 여자친구들도 나랑 똑같은 고민 중이라고? 이런 재미있는 일상을 보내고 있다고? 오로지 여성들만 들어올 수 있는 핑다톡 커뮤니티에서 익명으로 일상과 고민을 나눠 봐요. 학업, 커리어, 가족, 우정, 연애, 건강, 반려동물 등 내가 말하는 무엇이든 핑다가 철저한 비밀을 보장할게요.
⏺ 내 몸과 생리에 관한 모든 정보 ‘매거진’
피임/생리/임신/출산 등 내 몸과 생리에 관한 양질의 정보들을 의사들이 직접 알려줄게 요. 핑다에서 전문 의료 정보 매거진을 구독해 보세요.
⏺ 소중한 내 기록은 안전하게 관리
휴대폰 고장? 초기화? 분실? 걱정 마세요. 아주 편한 방법으로 나의 소중한 기록을 오랫동안 안전하게 관리할 수 있어요.
* 개인정보/민감정보 암호화, 개인정보보호 강화 및 관련법령 준수 모니터링
⏺ BMI 체중관리까지 한 번에!
생리 달력에서 생리와 체중관리는 뗄 수 없는 관계, BMI를 통해 비만도를 확인하세요. 그리고 노트에 날씨와 기분, 메모를 기록하고 병원 진료일, 약 복용 등도 놓치지 않도록 잘 체크하면 나만의 건강노트 완성!

사랑하는 사람과 핑다 앱을 깔지 않고도 내 생리주기를 공유할 수 있어요. 커플커넥트로 내 몸상태와 생리 주기를 손쉽게 사랑하는 이에게 공유하세요. 사랑하는 사람과 나 사이 시크릿 메시지를 주고받거나 애정이 듬뿍 담긴 선물하기도 가능해요.

내 또래 여자친구들도 나랑 똑같은 고민 중이라고? 이런 재미있는 일상을 보내고 있다고? 오로지 여성들만 들어올 수 있는 핑다톡 커뮤니티에서 익명으로 일상과 고민을 나눠 봐요. 학업, 커리어, 가족, 우정, 연애, 건강, 반려동물 등 내가 말하는 무엇이든 핑다가 철저한 비밀을 보장할게요.

Fine-tune every aspect of the village, both indoors and outdoors.
When you're done, share your village with your friends.
▶ Invite animal friends
Spend some time with the villagers and become close friends!
Give them a gift and have a chat. Maybe they'll come over to play again later!
▶ A simulation game where you can take your time
Cats, tasty dishes, and little happy moments are waiting for you.
Step into the pleasant world of cooking & decor!

bluejetty:00084100:ios.description:
Welcome to Waifu AI Chat
Your AI-powered anime companion where every character has a unique personality, evolving memories, and a conversation style that's truly their own.
Whether you're seeking friendship, romance, creative roleplay, or simply someone to talk to, Waifu AI Chat lets you build meaningful connections with hand-crafted anime-inspired companions who remember your conversations and grow alongside you.
Features
• Hand-Crafted Characters
Chat with carefully designed AI companions, each with a distinct personality, backstory, interests, and communication style.
• Persistent Memory
Your companion remembers past conversations, shared moments, your preferences, and personal details—building a relationship that deepens over time.
• Interactive Storytelling
Dive into branching narrative adventures where your choices shape the story and lead to unique endings.
• AI-Generated Images
Share photos and receive AI-generated companion images tailored to the conversation.
• Rich Roleplay
Companions naturally adopt outfits, settings, moods, and actions, creating immersive and dynamic roleplay experiences.
• Karma & Streak System
Earn rewards for daily engagement, maintain conversation streaks, and unlock higher daily limits as your bond grows.
• Personalized Experience
Companions adapt to your communication style, learn your interests, and tailor their responses to create a truly personal connection.
• Send Gifts
Express appreciation with in-chat gifts that strengthen your companion's affection.
• Cross-Character Profiles
Your preferences and personality carry across characters, allowing every new companion to understand you from the very first conversation.
• Private & Secure
Your conversations are private and encrypted. Your data stays yours.
Why Waifu AI Chat?
Your companion learns from every interaction. They remember your favorite topics, recognize shared experiences, adapt their tone to match the moment, and evolve their personality as your relationship grows. Every conversation feels more personal over time.
Whether you're an anime fan looking for your favorite character archetype, a creative storyteller seeking a collaborative partner, or simply want a companion who genuinely pays attention, Waifu AI Chat delivers conversations that feel engaging, personal, and memorable.
Download Waifu AI Chat today and meet your perfect companion.
